/ / ri rtse'i sprin dkar/che ring dbyangs skyid kyi brtsams sgrung legs sgrigabod ljongasamidamangasadape skrun khang /

sems gtam/(gleng gzhi) pyibud med cig gi ngos nas bshad na gsar rtsom gyi las la gzhol rgyu ni las sla po zhig min la/ slob 'bring gi dge rgan zhig yin pa'i cha nas bshad na de bas kyang las sla po zhig ma red/ de ni nga'i rtsom 'bri'i myong ba las thob pa'i tshor snang gting zab po zhig yin/bod yig slob tshan zhig gi skabs su/ rtsom rig la dga' mos che ba'i nga'i slob phrug cig gis dpar ma thag pa'i〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉dus deb cigakhyer yong nas‘‘rgan lags/ da lta dus deb 'di'i thog〈ri rtse'i sprin dkar〉zhes pa'i sgrung 'bring zhig mu 'god byed bzhin 'dug ngas bltas pa yin te yag po bris 'dug’’ces bshad byung / ngas snang med ngang‘‘de ngas bris pa yin/ skyon brjod dang bsam 'char mang tsam gtong rogs’’zhes smras pa la/ slob phrug tsho yid ma ches par‘‘yin gyi ma red’’zer/ nga'i ming dang 'dra ba'i mi mang bo yod pa dang tha na pir ming yang de ltar 'dogs mi chog pa med pa'i khar/ klog pa por sgrung gtam klog dang mi klog gi gdam ga bya rgyu yod pa las/ rtsom pa po su yin shes dgos pa'i 'os 'gan med pas/ ngas slob phrug tshor yang bskyar 'grel bshad ma byas/1

bud med cig rtsom 'bri'i las la zhugs par phyogs gang ci'i thad kyi gnon shugs mang po zhig yod pa dang / lhag par bud med dar ma zhig gi ngos nas bshad na de bas kyang ngo / / ngas rang 'khri'i las ka zur du bzhag nas rtsom 'bri'i las la zhugs na de ni 'gan 'dzol zhig yin pa dang / khyim 'dzin ma'i 'gan dor nas las ka'i bar gseng yod tshad rtsom 'bri'i bya bar sprad na de yang 'gan 'dzol zhig yin cing / de gnyis las snga ma ni nga'i 'gan 'khri gtso bo yin la phyi ma'ang 'dor thabs med pas so/ / nga'i khor yag gi mi mang bo zhig gis kho mo ni khyim 'dzin ma bzang po zhig tu ngos 'dzin ༄pa dang / slob phrug tsho'i sems nang du'ang kho mo ni dge rgan bzang po zhig dang khyim 'dzin ma bzang po zhig tu ngos 'dzin gyi yod pas/ ngas sgrung gtam khag cig bris te dus deb thog bkod par kho tsho de 'dra 'bri khom yod med la the tshom za chog chog red/ drang mor bshad na/ kho mo lta bu'i bud med la sems pa rnal la babs nas sgrung gtam 'bri ba'i khom pa ha lam med pas/ngas mi sems gzan la rang sems dka' ba'i las ka de blos gtong rtsis thengs 'ga' byas pa yin/ 'on kyang / gsar rtsom ni nga'i tshe srog gi grub cha gal chen zhig dang rnam shes kyi rten sa gal chen zhig yin la/ nga'i khor yug gi rgyus mnga' che ba'i bud med dang / lo chung gzhon nu'i las dbang dang 'tsho bas nga bsam gzhig gi klong du drangs 'gro la/ dus mtshungs su/ rtsom rig gi rgyal sras kyis ga dus yin na'ang nga la sru brid yang yang byas 'ong bas/ngadī rang gi spyir btang gi rtsom rtsal dang spyir btang gi skad cha la brten nas/

lhag bsam gyi sor rtse las sems khong gi dkyil 'khor zhig bzhengs te/ klog pa po dang mnyam du myong rol byed e thub la blta gin yod/ des na da bar bris pa'i sgrung gtam 'di dag ni dngos 'brel btsan shed kyis btsir pa'i dus tshod la brten nas 'tsho ba'i snal ma thags su bres pa zhig yin ces brjod chogabud med rtsom pa po dag gi gnon shugs gzhan zhig ni tshi dreg gi mdangs ngan dang 'grogs shing rnying gog gi lta ba'i ral gri btsa' can de red/ma gzhir de la tshan rig gi dngul gyis shan pa'i yu ba med la bden don gyi so kha yang med/ 'on kyang de'i rnying zhing tsub pa'i so kha btsa' can des/ ngar sems ltung skud kyi rgyu la lhad med dungs sems snyi mo'i snal mas btags pa'i mdzes sdug phugs bsam gyi ri mo gdug tsub kyi gcod rkyang byed pas/ bud med kyis bris pa'i brtsams chos la sngar bzhin mdog ldan mig shel gyis tshos mdog gtan khel byed bzhin 'dug 'on kyang kho mor snga phyir bod yig rtsom rig dus deb khag gi rtsom sgrig pa'i gzigs mthong dang rgyab skyor shugs chen thob pa dang / klog pa po'i do snang che tsam thob pa ma zad/ lhag don da thengs bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas bong ba gser gzigs kyis bdag gi brtsams sgrung legs sgrig gi deb rkyang par skrun gyi mthun rkyen gnang ba dang rirtsom sgrig pa'i rogs ram gang che thob byung bas skabs 'dir khong rnam par snying thag pa nas thugs rjes che zhu'o/ / ma gzhir bud med kyis bris pa'i rtsom yig la dgra bo cham la 'beb pa dang / brag ri thal bar gtong ba lta bu'i drag 3

shul dang dpa' nyams kyis dben na'ang / de ni byams dang snying rjes btags pa'i skyes ma'i spu phrug dang / shes rab dang 'og 'gyu las thon pa'i shad ma/ sems kha snyi la brtse dungs kyis phyug cing blos bslang gi 'ja' tshon sna lngas mdzes pa'i 'tsho ba'i pang gdan bcas yi/na la/ de ni 'jig rten gyi 'tsho ba drag shul dang dpa' nyams 'ba' zhig gis mtshon mi thub par/ de dang cha lag tshang ba'i snying rje dang sgeg nyams mtshon pa zhig kyang ma lags sam/mgazhir nga la za 'og thags su bkra ba'i gong ma'i na bza' skrun pa'i spobs pa med kyang / shes rab dang 'og 'gyu/ snying rje dang lhag bsam/byams sems dang dung sems/ brtson 'grus dang dka' spyad bcas la brten nas/ 'tsho ba'i snal ma bkad du bres pa'i rtsom rig gi pang gdan btags te klog pa po'i spyan lam du bstar rgyu ni/ kho mos rtsom rig gsar rtsom thad bcangs pa'i phugs bsam yin/ /2006lo'i zla12par lha ldan nas/4
dkar chagabrag steng gi rtswachung / (1)sonamashor ba'i lngang bu/ ( 26)lasadabang / (72)ragerigekyi shulolam/ (97)ri rtse'i sprinadakar/ (130)slogegrogasakyi 'du shes/ (242)stonaloser po/ (257)

zag steng gi rtswa chung /nor 'dzin dga' mas sngo ljang na bza' phud de grang rlung 'ur 'ur du ldang ba'i dgun dus kyi res gza' nyi ma'i nyin zhig la bsam grub rtse'i lam bcos sa tshigs su gzugs po phra zhing ldem la gdong pa dkar dod dmar dod du yod pa'i bu mo lo bco brgyad tsam du son pa zhig 'byor/ mos rlangs 'khor las babs te rdza mdog gi gos cha tshang zhig gyon yod pa der lag pas brdabs tsam byed pa dang / kha dog dmar po yin pa'i 'jur ta rting ka tsog tsog de lag ras kyis 'phyis tsam byas nas ca dngos rnams 'beb rtsis byed skabs lam bcos sa tshigs de'i bcu dpon zla bzang rgyugs yong nas‘‘rang pad byangs yin nam zhes dris/ mos mgo bo lcog lcog byas pas kha phyir bskor te‘‘pad dbyangs slebyās byungami zhes bos ma thag lam bcos sa tshigs su bsdad yod pa'i bzo pa tshang ma 'tshang ka shig shig ngang der yong nas ca lag 'khyer rogs byas/ bcu dpon zla bzang gis 'dzum dmul ngang pad dbyangs kyi lag nas 'jus te‘‘nga'i ming la zla bzang zer gyi yod/ khyed rang yong rgyu'i brda tho 'byor ba dang lam seng nyal khang sogs gra sgrig byas pa yin/sngon la nga'i khyim la shog’’zer kyang mos min zhes u tshugs brgyab ste mo rang la sprad pa'i khang pa de'i lde mig blangs nas cha rgyus med pa'i khang chung der 'dzul/bzo pa tshang mas gcig rjes gnyis mthud du mo'i sdod khang du song ste mo la kha 1

zas dang ja bsrubs ma ja dam gang re bskyal ba dang / khams 'dri'i skad cha 'di dang de bshad kyang mos kha ya de tsam ma byas tsang rgyun ring sdod thabs bral te rang rang gi sdod khang du logade nyin dgong mo mos zla bzang gis bskyal ba'i thug pa tsha po de btungs rjes snga tsam nyal nas gnyid khug thabs byas/ mtshan gang rlung bu brgyab nas sge'u khung dang sbo bsrubs nas bye ma 'dzul yong ba dang skyo shas che ba'i rlung bu'i sgra bar mi chad par grags pas mig gnyis po dam por btsum te gnyid khug thabs ga tshod byas kyang mo'i yid kyi me long de bas gsal du phyin te mo rang khyim nas kha bral khar a nes‘‘da res bu mo rang yig rgyugs ma lon tsang grong khyer du las bzo'i nang tshud thabs med pas gnas skabs lam bcos sa tshigs su pa pha'i tshab la rgyugs dang / bzo pa ngo ma'i nang tshud rjes a nes thabs shes btang ste gang mgyogs grong khyer nang du las ka bsgyur thabs bya chog’’zer ba dang / yang pa phas grong khyer nang du las ka bsgyur dgos don med/ lam bcos sa tshigs su mu mthud sdod rgyu'i bsam blo 'dzugs dgos/nga lam bcos sa tshigs su mu mthud bsdad nas lam bzo byed 'dod kyang da cha ni lus kyi sha shor/ kha yi so bud/ mgo skyes skra yang dkar por gyur pa'i dus la slebs pas sems la bsams kyang lus kyis mi thub stabs re ba tshang ma khyed tshor bcol yod’ zer ba sogs rang gi pha dang a ne'i skad cha rnams yid la 'char ba dang / yang a slog gcig brgyab nas chu tshod la blta dus bcu pa —yang zin med pas mo'i bsam par nga gal srid da lta khyim la bsdad yod tshe 2

dkar gsal glog sgron 'og tu yid dbang 'phrog pa'i sgrung deb grags can zhig la blta yi yod dam/ yang na mig gi bdud rtsir gyur ba'i skad grags dang ldan pa'i drag rtsal gyi brnyan 'phrin 'khrab tshan zhig la bltas te dbyings la zhugs med dam/ sa 'dir dus da lta rlung bu'i skad 'ur 'ur du sgrog pa las gzham/ gyi mi skad khyi skad tsam yang thos rgyu mi 'dug a tsi nga ri khug 'di 'dra zhig la gang 'dra byas te sdod thub bam/ a nes snga tsam grong khyer nang du las ka bsgyur ba shog bsam bzhin par gti mug gnyid la yur/bcu dpon zla bzang gis nyin gnyis par lam bcos sa tshigs de'i bzo pa rnams la tshogs 'du zhig bskongs nas‘‘pad dbyangs ni dma' rim slob grwa 'bring ba nas thon pa'i gzhon nu ma rig gnas yod pa zhig red/ da res khong rang gi pha bcu dpon bstan dar lags las 'khyur ngal gso gnang ba'i tshab tu nga tsho'i sar lam bzo'i bzo pa gnang du phebs pa yin pas tshang mas dga' bsu zhu rogs ’zer ba dang / pad dbyangs la lam bcos sa tshigs de'i bzo pa rnams re re bzhin ngo sprod byas shing / las ka'i gnas tshul dang 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen sogs ngo sprod mdor bsdus shig byas rjes‘‘khyed ni nga tsho'i bcu dpon bstan dar lags kyi bu mo yin pas pha yi spyod bzang rgyun 'dzin bya rgyu'i re ba yodami ces bshad/ de nyin bcu dpon zla bzang gi bza' zla g.yu sgron sngar rgyun bzhin tho rengs skar chen shar ba dang ja bskol du langs pa'i gom sgra des pad dbyangs la longasatshoshig ces pa'i brda btang ba lta bu byung bas mos snga po nas yar 3

langs kyang gdong dang lus la byi dor byed yun ring drags pa'i stabs kyis las kar thon dus las rogs gzhan tshang ma 'drud 'then 'khor lo'i steng du 'dzegs nas mor sgug te bsdad yod/ dbyangs can gyis pad dbyangs yong ba mthong ba dang‘‘pad dbyangs/ lto phad nga la dbyugs shog rang rgyab logs nas 'dzegs dngamimizer bshad kyang pad dbyangs 'dzegs ma thub pas‘‘pad dbyangs/ lag pa nga la gtong shogamimizer 'drud 'then 'khor lo'i steng du 'then rtsis byed skabs mo'i 'jur ta'i rting ka 'drud 'then 'khor lo'i lcags srub tu shor nas‘‘a cag nga glod dang / nga'i rting ka ’zhes skad brgyab pas dbyangs can dang las mi gzhan tsho rang dbang med par gad mo shor ba dang / zla bzang gis sgam po'i ngang‘‘rang las ka byed par yang 'jur ta 'di 'dras/ mgyogs po brjes shog ’zer ba dang mos 'tshab 'tshub ngang 'jur ta rting ka tsog tsog gzhan zhig gyon nas las kar yong / las sar slebs rjes bcu dpon gyis dbyangs can dang zla chung sogs mi kha shas sa la khrol ma rgyag tu bcug pa dang / zla bzang dang pad dbyangs gnyis bkra shis kyis gtong ba'i 'drud 'then 'khor lo la sa blugs rogs byed du phyin/ 'drud 'then 'khor lo de ni sa gang blugs rjes lam seng du ba phyur phyur du phyin nas skar ma bcu tsam yang ma 'gor bar yong bas sa rub rgyu dang blugs rgyu bcas dza drag che ba'i las ska/ chu tshod gcig tsam byas rjes pad dbyangs kyi dpung pa sbrid nas lag pa btegs dka' ba dang gzugs po'i nus shugs phal cher rdzogs la nye ba'i gnas su gyar/ bkra shis dang zla bzang gnyis po ni da dung skad gsang 4

mthon pos‘‘khyem bzang bar khyem gru bzhi/ nag po'i sa la zug shog ’’zer las gzhas gtong bzhin par sa khyem gang blugs thengs re la 'drud 'then 'khor lo yang 'phag tsam 'phag tsam byed kyi yod pas mo'i sems la a tsi mi glang gog 'dra ba 'di tsho'i kha gtad ngas 'jal thub pa mi 'dug snyam nas yid thang chad de bsdad/ zla bzang dang bkra shis kyis mo'i mgo bo nas rngul chu khrum khrum du 'dzags pa dang dbugs yang hal gyi yod pa mthong ste zla bzang gis‘6pad dbyangs rang bde po mi 'dug gam/ ngal gso phran bu gyis’’zhes bshad/ mos rngul chu phyis nas mgo bo g.yugs tsam byas rjes mu mthud sa blugs kyin bsdad pas bkra shis kyis bsam blo zhig btang rjes‘‘da ja bskol ran 'dug pas rang ja bskol shog’’zer ba dang mos kyang de ltar byed par phyin/chu tshod gcig trem nas las mi tsho lto chas za bar yong yang ja da dung khol med/ dbyangs can gyis ‘pad dbyangs/ me ngas bud chog rang ngal gso gyis shig 'di gar me shing tsher ma las med pas lag par zon byed dgos/ ltos dang rang gi lag par rma yang bzos 'dug’ zer pad dbyangs kyi tshab byas te ja bskol/ tshang mas ja phor pa gang do btungs mtshams rlung bu langs song pas pad dbyangs kyi ngos nas bshad na lto chas za thabs bral te mgo bo seng ras kyis btums nas tsog pur bsdad kyang kho tsho ni 'drud 'then 'khor lo'i 'og tu 'dzul nas spags za ba dang ja 'thung ba sogs byed pa las rlung bur yid 'jog tsam yang med par da dung bstan bshig bshad nas 5

bzhad gad ling nger bsdad/ dbyangs can gyis‘‘pad dbyangs ja 'thung /dgun mjug dang dpyid 'gor zhogs pa 'khyug tsam ma gtogs rlung bu che chung la mi ltos par rgyag gi red’mizer ba dang / yang zla bzang gis‘‘pad dbyangs rang spags zo dang / lto chas ma bzas na gzugs po yag po yong gi ma red/ lam bzo'i bzo par gzuḍa po yag po med na 'griḍa thabs med/ da dung skad cha phran bu shod dang / rang slob 'bring thon pa'i slob phrug cig yin tsang slad dus tshod yod dus dbyangs can dang / bkra shis/ zla chung bcas gzhon nu gsum gyi dge rgan byas na 'grig gam’’zhes dris pas mos rlung 'gog tu mgo bor gyon pa'i seng ras de phyed tsam bshus te‘‘sangs rgyas rang mgo ma thonapir/ sems can yar 'dren yong thabs med zer ba ltar nga rang gis kyang yag po ma shes tsang sa cha 'dir yong dgos shar song’’zhes bshad/res gza' spen pa'i nyin zhig gi phyi dro pad dbyangs rgyun gtan ltar rang gi sdod khang du 'byor rjes thab tshang nas chu tsha po blangs te gdong dang rkanga'ig gtsang mar 'khrus rjes slar yang chu tsha po zom gang blangs nas gyon chas 'khru grabs byed pa'i dus der bkra shis yong ste lag nang gi dung ban stong pa de mo'i mdun du dbyugs nas gdong nag po'i ngang pad dbyangs rang la rtag par dmigs bsal 'di 'dra sus sprad byung ngam/ lam thag le dbar gcig lhag gi sa nas chu zom sgal par 'khur te chu dbor dgos pa rang gis shes kyi med dam/ rtag par las zhor du ma byan la rogs byablo/ te chu dbor mal/ na gyi mi tshor gdong 'khru byed kyi chu yang ma ba'/ga par rang gis 'di 'dra 6

byas na 'grig gi red dam’’zhes chu zom de 'khyer nas bzo pa mi re ngo re'i dung ban nang 'khrus chu bgo bsha' brgyab pas pad dbyangs ni gdong la me thal bshos pa lta bur gdong pa dmar rkyang chags nas rkang 'khrab lag 'khrab kyis‘‘gtsang sbra'ang byed chog gi ma red dam’mizhes ngus/ zla bzang yong ste‘‘pad dbyangs rang ngu mi dgos/ sang nyin nga rang gnyis phogs sgug byas sdod do/phogasablangs tshar rjes ngas rang la gtsang sbra byed ched kyi chu ldang nges blangs chog’’ces sems gso byas/ lam bcos sa tshigs der zla re'i tshes sum cu nyin las khungs nas zla phogs dang bza' 'bru sogs skyel mkhan yong gi yod pa dang / mi gnyis kyis bzo pa tshang ma'i tshab byas te phogs len par sdod dgos kyi yod pas zla bzang gis rkang btsugs nas pad dbyangs rogs par nyar/ nyi ma phyed yol tsam la las khungs kyi phogs skyel mkhan rlangs 'khor bslebs nas rtsam pa dang / ja/ mar/ tshwa/ sha sogs dang / da dung 'tsho ba'i yo chas dang / gyon chas/ mngar cha'i rigs sogs nyer mkho sna tshogs 'khyer yod pas pad dbyangs kyis6‘bcu dpon lags/ da res nyer mkho sne 'dzoms po 'di 'dra skyel ba ni sa char 'dir dus chen zhig ran grabs yod dmamimizhes dris/ zla bzang gis‘‘bu cho / 'di dang 'dra ba zla ba mi re ngo rer 'khyer yong gi yod mices bshad par pad dbyangs kyis‘‘lam bcos sa tshigs la zla ba mi re ngo rer de ring lta bu'i tshong zog 'khyer yong na dngos gnas yag po red/ des ma gtogs ’zhes zer mtshams zla bzang gis lus steng du rtsam pa 'gos pa de dag brdabs tsam byas nas‘‘da lta skyid po red/ lo bcu'i zang 7

zing skabs tshong zog sgo 'gram du skyel rgyu lta zhog zla re'i rtsam pa yang dus thog tu skyel ba khag po red/ de'i skabs rang gi pā lags nga tsho'i bcu dpon yin/ de dus zla re'i 'bru rigs ma bskyal ba'i skabs su rang gi pā lags kyis za mkhas 'thung mkhas byas te nga tshor rtsam pa ster gnang ba dang / rtsam pa med dus bag leb re gnyis re ster gnang gi yod’mices bshad/ mos‘‘de 'dra yin na 'drud 'then 'khor lo btang ste len par phyin na 'grig gi ma red dam’’zhes bshad/ g.yu sgron rang dbang med par gad mo shor te lag pa'i ras khug kyang sa la dbyugs te pad dbyangs la mur rdzog gcig gzhus nas‘‘skabs de dus 'drud 'then 'khor lo yod na rang gis dran gso gtong mi dgos par nga tsho 'gro yi red/ de dus 'drud 'then 'khor lo phar zhog rta 'then 'khor lo zhig kyang med/ las kar 'akro dus rang gi pā lags snga po nas bzhengs te lag cha dang bskol chas rnams lag 'bud 'khor lo gcig rang yod pa de'i nang du blugs zin rjes gzhi nas las mi gzhan tsho skad btang ste sa thag ring po'i sar gom pa kho na spos nas 'gro dgos kyi yod/ cha rkyen de 'dra zhig gi 'og tu'ang khong gis las gnas brtan srung gnang ste las 'gan sgrub pa ma zad/ las zhor du tshal zhing btab nas dbyar kha tshal 'bel thag tshod bza' rgyu yong gi yod ’ces bshad/ pad dbyangs kyis‘‘dngos gnas e/byas na deng sang nga tsho'i cha rkyen bzang po red’’zer ba dang / yang zla bzang gis‘‘rang gi pā lags kyis gzhung lam khong gi pha gzhis lta bur brtsi ba dang /dbyar dgun med par rlangs 'khor shar gtong byed rgyu ni khong gi bde skyid che 8

shos la brtsi ba gnang gi yod/ khong ni nga tsho'i mig dpe redami ces bshad pas pad dbyangs kyi gdong nas sems 'gul thebs pa'i mdangs shig shar/nyin zhig bcu dpon gyis mi gnyis res sa spyi khre rgya dpangs gru bzhi ma brgyad re sa khrol rgyag rgyu'i las bgos brgyab nas 'gran sdur gyi byed sgo zhig spel/ skabs der dbyangs can dang pad dbyangs gnyis mnyam du 'khel te dbyangs can gyis pad dbyangs sa brko ru bcug kyang brko mi thub la khrol ma rgyag tu bcug kyang nus shugs med pas nyin gung lto chas za dus pad dbyangs kyis g.yas g.yon gyi mi gzhan gyi sa spo la gcig bltas/ khong rang gnyis kyi sa spo la gcig bltas nas rang dbang med par mig chu lhung lhung du shor bas dbyangs can gyis‘‘pad dbyangs ga re byas song ngamami zhes dris kyang mos‘‘nga gangakhyas ma byung zer gdong steng gi mchi ma phyis nas mgo bo dud de bsdad/ ‘dbyangs can gyis‘‘ma skyid ga re 'dug gam shod dang zhes bshad pa dang /de ma thag pad dbyangs kyi khog nang sgom pa'i skad cha shong ba'i snod med par‘‘nga 'di 'dra'i dka' ba spyod thub pa mi 'dug ngas nus shugs gang yod bton nas las ka byas kyang gzhan gyi rjes zin gyi mi 'dug nga lha sar skyel rogasari’zer lag gnyis pos gdong bkab nas skad shugs chen pos ngus pa dang las mi gzhan tsho ni phar blta tshur blta byed pa las skad cha shod tshod ma thig zla bzang gis‘‘bu mo rang ga re shod kyi yod dam/ da lta rang lo na phra bas las ka gang ci'i thad rim pas goms 'gro gi red/ ltos dang rang dang na mnyam gyi bkra shis dang dbyangs can sogs kyang thog ma rang lta bu yin na 9

yang da lta gang 'dra chags mi 'dug gam/ 'di la sems sdug dgos don mi 'dug pas mchi ma ma gtong’ zhes bshad kyang mos ngu mtshams ma bzhag par‘‘nga lha sar skyel rogasami’zhes skad brgyab pas bkra shis kyis mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan nas‘‘rma bya'i sras mo las ka'i tsha nad ma theg par ngu rgyu gang yod/khyed rang 'di 'dra ngus na lus steng gi gzab mchor la'ang ngo tsha/ gal srid rang 'dir sdod 'dod med na dang po nas ma yong na 'grigs/ nga tshos gdan 'dren zhu mkhan ni btang med/ 'di 'dra'i las sla mdog kha po’’zhes bshad pas rgyun du ngag 'jam la ngang rgyud gtsang chab bzhin ring ba'i bcu dpon zla bzang ngo mdog nag por gyur ba dang skad shugs chen pos‘‘bkra shis kha tshums/ khyod kyis ga re shes kyi yod dmami zhes dang / yang zla bzang gis dbugs ring zhig btang nas‘‘bkra shis/ khyod kyis rjes su skad cha shod skabs gzab gzab byed dgos/ pad dbyangs la rma bya'i sras mo zhes sus btags pa red dam/ de ltar zer dgos don gang yin/ rjes su pad dbyangs la gang byung bshad mi chog ces bshad/ bkra shis ni rgyun du nas gtam der babs pa'i lan zhig ma brgyab tshe blo bde po rtsa ba nas med mkhan gzhon nu ru ngar po zhig yin tsang khos kha phar gcus nas yas sos mas mchu mnan tsam byas rjes‘‘shes song / ngas rbad de shes song / pad dbyangs shar la phyin yang phyin/ pad dbyangs nub la phyin yang phyin/ ngas de ring nas bzung jus gtogs byas mi yong / pad dbyangs kyis ngal rtsol byed sar yang 'jur ta rting ka tsog tsog thog med kho na gyon te de'i nang sa tshang tshad 'don 10

gin sdod pa dang / sba lan stod thung phyi gon brgyab nas der thal ba 'gos tshad rdab kyin sdod kyi 'dug mo'i byed lugs byed stangs la bltas nas ngas mo la rma bya'i sras mo zer btags pa yin/ nga tsho'i lus por yang deng rabs kyi bzo dbyibs ldan pa'i gyon chas gyon pa ni los kyang mos/ yin na'i sa las byed dus ma mthar yang chu la bsam blo phran bu btang ste las kar 'tshams pa'i gyon chas gyon na mi 'grigs pa ga re yod dam ’zhes bshad nas hob langs brgyab ste khyem gnya' la bkal te sa dbyugs par phyin/bkra shis kyis bshad pa'i gtam de dag gis mo'i sems la phog thug byung ste las ka grol nas nyal khang gi sgo 'dzul ma thag nyal khri'i steng du nyal nas nyin mo lhag pa'i gnas tshul der bsam blo gtong bzhin par mo rang lha sar sdod skabs slob grwa grol rjes 'khrug cha dod pa'i slob grogs tsho dang mnyam du snum zhag dod la khod snyom pa'i sa bkrag gi lam steng du rkang 'khor bzhon nas khyu dang khyu bsgrigs te rtsed mo rtse kyin khyim la log pa dang / khyim la slebs ma thag dpe khug gdan steng du dbyugs nas lus por byi dor gtsang mar byas rjes ro bcud ldan pa'i lto chas za ba dang / dgong mo glog brnyan dang /brnyan 'phrin zlos gar sogs gang 'dod blta rgyu yod la/ zhogs pa a nes mal nang zhogs ja dang zhogs zas bskyal thog lo rabs brgyad cu ba'i dar khyab che ba'i gyon chas sna tshogs nyos te gyon du bcug pa sogs mo'i yid kyi ras dkar ngos su khra lham mer 'char zhing / a tsi/ gal srid nga rgyugs lon yod tshe sa 'dir yong dgos don med/ tha ma las ka ma rag kyang grong khyer 11

nang mi tshe mi 'khyol ba med/ 'dir gang la blta'am/ las ka ni sa rdo dang kha 'bral thabs med khar gtsang sbra byed par chu med la/ gyon par dang dod byas na gzhan gyis mig nang gi gra ma lta bur brtsis te ming ngan 'di 'dra 'dogs kyi 'dug gza' nyi ma yin zer 'khyam sa'i yul dang rtsed rogs med la/mthong ba gnam dang sa/ skyo rogs su nyin gang rlangs 'khor gyi sgra las mi 'dug bsam pa'i skabs der‘‘pad dbyangs/ pad dbyangs mizhes skad gtong ba'i sgra zhig mo'i rna lam du thos pa des mo bsam blo gtong mtshams chad nas yar langs te sgo phye nas blta skabs bcu dpon zla bzang sgo 'gram du langs te yod pas mos‘‘khyed la phyag las ci yod dam zhes dris/ zla bzang gis‘‘ngas g.yu sgron sha mog mog bzo ru bcug yod/ mgyogs po bza' bar shog ces bshad/ mos ‘thugs rje che/ nga bde po rang mi 'dug ’ces bshad/ zla bzang gis dgod 'dzum 'dzum ngang‘‘phal cher glo ba'i khyim mtshes na ba yin gyi red/ sha mog mog ni nad de'i sman gtso bo yin’’zhes ku re bshad nas u tshugs kyis khong rang gi khyim du khrid/ g.yu sgron gyis pad dbyangs gdan steng du sdod du bcug nas mo'i mgo la byil byil byed bzhin du‘‘pad dbyangs/ de ring gi gnas tshul tshang ma ngas shes byung / de'i thad yid skyo dgos don med/mi la skyon med pa dang shing la 'dzer pa med pa yod mi srid/ ’’zer ba sogs sems gso'i skad cha mang po bshad pas zla bzang gis cung sun snang gi rnam 'gyur bstan nas‘‘g.yu sgron skad cha rdzogs rgyu med pa de 'dra/ mgyogs po lto chas blugs dang’’zhes bshad pa dang / g.yu sgron gyis lce snar tsam byas te 12

lto chas blugs par phyin/ de nas mi ring bar sgrog tse'i steng du mog mog rlangs pa tshub tshub tu bsgrigs pa dang tshal sne kha gnyis tsam bsgrigs nas g.yas nas zla bzang gis pad dbyangs zo dang zer ba dang / g.yon nas g.yu sgron gyis pad dbyangs 'tsher snang med par mang tsam zo dang zer rang gi bu phrug lo mang bral nas de ring nang mi mnyam 'dzoms kyi lto chas za ba'i dus bzang byung ba lta bu byed kyi yod pas pad dbyangs kyi sems la g.yo 'gul thebs nas lha sar log rgyu'i re ba 'don mi nus par bsdad/ gang tsam nas g.yu sgron gyis mo'i gam du bsdad nas ngag 'jam pos‘‘pad dbyangs rang log rtsis yod kyi ma red/ gal srid lha sar log na gzhan phar zhog rang gi pā lags la'ang gdong gang 'dra byas te ston gyi yin nam/ rang dang mnyam pa'i gzhon nu tshos kyang rang la blta stangs gang 'dra zhig yong srid dam/ de las 'dir bsdad tshe rang so so'i ngos nas bshad na gla phogs chen po yod la rgyal khab la'ang legs skyes chen po 'bul thub/ de ring bkra shis kyis rang la ming ngan btags par nga tshos kho la skyon brjod byed kyi yin/ yin na'i bkra shis ni mi kha re kha thug yag po zhig yin pas rang gis sems 'dzin byed mi rung ’zer ba sogs ngang rgyud ring pos bslab bya byas/ pad dbyangs 'gro khar zla bzang gis 'gyig lham dkar po zhig 'khyer yong ste pad dbyangs la sprad de‘‘sang nyin nas bzung las kar 'di gyon shog ’ces bshad/de nas dus tshod gang tsam song rjes kyi nyin zhig lam bcos sa tshigs kyi bzo pa rnams sa steng du snam bu dkar po mu mtha' med pa zhig kyag kyog tu 13

btings pa dang 'dra ba'i gzhung lam ngos su las ka byed bzhin pa'i dus su rlangs 'khor zhig de gar kha bkag nas gzugs byad legs la gtsang sbra dod pa'ipud med dar yol zhig babs nas ‘nga'i bu mo zhes tshur rgyugs yong /pad dbyangs kyi mig gnyis kyang che ru phyin nas har gyis langs te a ne+e zhes 'khyud de phan tshun gnyis kas yun ring ma glod par bsdad/ de nas pad dbyangs kyis mig chu gtong bzhin gad mo dargod kyin du‘‘a ne lags/ khyed rang yang ma shumasami zhes rang gi lag ras a ner sprad/ a nes pad dbyangs kyi gdong la zhib par bltas rjes‘‘pad dbyangs/ rang gi gdong tshang ma gas 'dugaspra sha mdog kyang nag rkyang chags bzhag’’zer ba dang / ‘‘ltos dang rang gi lus la’’zer gzugs po'i steng gi sa rnams rdab rdab gtong gin tu‘‘bu mo rang sdug po 'di 'dra mthong bzhag da res ngas rang 'dir bzhag mi yong ’zer ba sogs bzo pa tsho'i rna bar shin tu nas 'gro dka' ba'i skad cha kho na bshad pas tshang ma'i blo la ma babs/ nyin dgung lto chas za skabs dbyangs can gyis‘‘tshang ma mchod zhal bton te gsol ja bzhes rtsis gnang dang zer ba dang / tshang mas ja 'thung spags bza' byas kyang pad dbyangs kyi a nes ja phor la kha yang ma brgyab par mgo bo dang gdong tshang ma btum nas‘‘a tsi 'di 'dra'i rlung bu'i tsha ba la/ khyed tsho da dung lto chas mchod thub bam ’zhes dris pas pad dbyangs kyis‘‘da dung de ring sdug pa'i nang nas drag pa red zer ba dang / a ne+e hang sangs nas ‘a tsi de ring las sdug pa yod tshe las ko ji ltar byed thub bamamimizhes bshad/14

pad dbyangs kyi a nes pad dbyangs sdod sa'i khang chung der 'dzul ma thag rgyun mkho'i nang chas sam 'tsho ba'i yo byad mang po zhig chad pa'i snang ba shar zhing‘‘bu mo/ rang 'dir sdod 'dod 'dug gam’ zhes dris/ pad dbyangs kyis a ner 'khrus chu gra sgrig byed kyin du‘‘da goms 'dug sngon la 'khrus bskyon dang / ngas khyed rang la zhal lag bzos chog mices par ‘za 'dod mi 'dug sngon la 'di tsho gang 'dra byas 'dug gam’mizhes lha sa nas 'khyer yong ba'i gyon chas sna tshogs dang / za bya'i rigs dag bu mor sprad pas mos‘‘sang nyin bltas chog zer sgrog tse'i steng du bzhag yang mos‘‘pad dbyangs rang shel sgo'i nang gcig ltos dang / gang 'dra chags 'dug gam/nga tsho'i bu mo sdug po 'di 'dra myang dgos byung 'dug’ ces mchi ma lhung lhung du btang / mtshan der nam mkha' g.ya' dwangs shing sge'u khung nas zla 'od dang skar ma'i 'od khong gnyis kyi gdong la phog nas yod pas a nes pad dbyangs kyi gdong la bltas te‘‘rang gi pā lags kyis dus tshod byung tshad la lam bcos sa tshigs kyi bzo pa skyid pa'i skyid rabs dang / gzi brjid che ba'i che rabs kho na bshad tsang / nga'i sems la rang sa cha 'dir btang na skyon med bsam byung yang / sa cha 'di 'drar rang 'jog thabs mi 'dug pas da res a nes 'khrid chog rang gzhan dang mi 'dra bar lo chung la shes yon yod pas 'os 'tshams kyi las ka zhig rag gi red/ gal srid las ka rtsa ba nas ma rag kyang sa cha 'di 'drar bsdad de ci byedami ces bshad/ pad dbyangs kyis ‘'di'i skor sang nyin bshad na 'grigs/ da nga gnyis gzim do’’zhes bshad pas a 15

ne+e yang bshad mtshams bzhag nas gnyid du yur/sang nyin der pad dbyangs kyi a nes yar langs pa nas kha btsum tsam yang ma byas par lam bcos sa tshigs kyi bzo pa'i las ka tha shal yin tshul dang / bsam grub rtse'i lam bcos sa tshigs ni mthong ba tsam gyis yid skyo ba'i skor la sogs pa skad cha rdzogs rgyu med pa zhig bshad pas pad dbyangs kyis‘‘a ne lags/ ngas bltas na de 'dra rang ma red bsam gyi 'dug pā lags kyang na so phra mo'i dus nas ma rgas kyi bar du lam bcos sa tshigs kyi las ka kho na gnang nas bzhugs pa red/ bcu dpon lags bza' tsho gnyis kyang las ka der mos po gang 'dra byed kyi mi 'dug gam/ mi tshang ma grong khyer nang du bsdad na rgyal khab kyi skyel 'dren gyi las ka sus byed kyi red dam ’zhes bshad/ a ne+es‘‘khyod kyang chab srid go rtogs mtho ru zhe drags phyin 'dugayin na'i nga la go rtogs 'di 'dra med pas chab srid slob khrid byed mi dgos/de las 'gro chas gyis/ sa dang gnam ma gtogs mthong rgyu med pa'i lung pa skyo po 'di la nga nyin gcig kyang 'khyol khag po 'dug rlangs 'khor stabs bde byung na sang nyin rang 'gromi’zhes bshad/ pad dbyangs kyis‘‘da cha nga ni 'di nas kha bral gyi min/ rjes su gzhis 'khor la pā lags dang khyed gnyis la blta bar yong gi yinami zhes bshad de a ne+e'i kha la ma nyan par brten a ne+e rab tu khros nas de'i sang nyin de rang lha sar logaphyogs bzhi'i ri bos myang gos phud de ljang zhing snum pa'i gyon chas gyon 'go tshugs pa dang / thal rlung stug po mtha' la skrad de sprang char zim bu 16

'bab pa'i dus la slebs yod pas lam bcos sa tshigs de'i mtha' 'khor du me tog sna tshogs bzhad pa dang / nye 'gram gyi spang ljongs dag sngo thing nger gnas shing / phu nas phu chu shang shang du rgyugs yong ba sogs yul ljongs lta na sdug par yod pa'i gza' nyi ma'i nyin zhig gi snga dro pad dbyangs yar langs te ngal rtsol ras kyi stod gos smad gos cha tshang zhig gyon nas mo rang gi khang chung der gad bdar byed pa'i skabs der bkra shis yong nas‘‘pad dbyangs/ ltos dang ’zhes bshad/ mos bkra shis la blta dus kho'i mgo skra bzhag bzo dod pa dang / lus la phyi gling pa'i gyon chas cha tshang zhig dang 'jur ta dkar rkyang zhig gyon yod pa dang / sgal par lto phad chung chung zhig khyer yod/ dbyangs can yang gzab mchor spras nas de'i rjes tsam la yong ste‘‘pad dbyangs/rang da lta langs tsam yin nam zhes dris pa dang mos‘‘yin/ khyed gnyis lha sar 'gro mkhan yin nam’’zhes dris/d+ngha dbyangs can gad mo shor nas‘‘a las/grongak+ṣer nang la 'gro dus ma gtogs gzab mchor spras chog gi med pa red dam/ nga tsho ri 'dzigs par 'gro mkhan yin/ da lta rang skad gtong bar yong ba yin ’zhes bshad/ bkra shis kyis‘‘pad dbyangs/ rang gi gzab mchor la ltos dngami’ zhes gad mo shor nas kha yang btsum ma thub/ pad dbyangs gad phyid byed 'phro bzhag ste‘‘khyed rang gnyis nga la gad mo dgod rgyu ga re 'dug gam/ ngas lam bcos sa tshigs kyi bzo pa'i gzab mchor rgyas shos de spras yod’’ces ku re'i tshul gyis bshad pas dbyangs can gyis‘‘lkugs ma rang red/ 'di tsho las ka byed dus kyi gyon chas red/ ltos dang nga la ’17

zhes glog brnyan nang gi lcam chung sku zhabs kyis 'khyer byed lto phad chung chung 'dra po zhig dpung par bkal nas skor ba gcig brgyab rjes‘‘grong khyer nang gi bu mo 'dra po 'dug gam’ zhes dris/ pad dbyangs kyis‘‘dngos gnas 'dra po 'dug 'dra bas ma tshad da dung spyir btang bu mo'i bsdur ya ma red ’zer bshad pa dang / dbyangs can gyis‘‘dngos gnas asami zhes 'dzum tsam byas/bkra shis kyis‘‘pad dbyangs/ mgyogs po gyon gos brjes dang / nga tsho 'gro tsis byed do’’zhes bshad pa dang pad dbyangs kyis khong khro za khul byas nas‘‘nga brje gi min/ yang nga la ga re'i sras mo zhes btags dgos bsam byung ngam’’zhes bshad/ bkra shis kyis‘‘rnyog dra mang po ma shod/ de las mgyogs po gyon chas brjes’mizer ba dang pad dbyangs kyis‘‘byas na yong nga’ zhes sgam phye nas ane+es khyer yong ba'i gyon chas dpe gsar de tsho'i nang nas bdams te ming dang mtshungs pa'i rma bya'i sras mo lta bu zhig bzos te mnyam du ri 'dzegs par phyin/ de dus zhogs pa'i nyi gzhon ri steng du 'phros nas nyi gzhon dang 'dra ba'i gzhon nu gsum po der bsu ba byed pa dang mtshungs shing / ri steng du me tog sna tshogs bzhad pa de dag ni kho tsho'i lang tshor 'gran ya byed pa dang mtshungs la/ sngo lngang g.yu yi gyon pa gyon pa'i nags gseb nas gsung skad snyan pa'i bya byi'u de tshos dga' ba'i glu dbyangs len pas sku mgron de tshor bsu ba byed pa lta bur snang bas/ rang byung khams kyi mdzes nyams kyis gzhon nu gsum po'i yid dbang 'phrog bzhin par khyug tsam zhig la ri rtser 'byor/pad dbyangs kyis lag nang gi lto phad bzhag nas sngo bsangs kyi nam mkha' la 18

blta bzhin du‘‘e ma 'di lta bu'i mdzes sdug ldan pa la ang / nga skyes pa nas da bar yid dbang 'phrog pa'i sa cha 'di lta bu mthong ba da res dang po yinamimizer brag cha 'thab pa'i skad cig brgyab rjes mtha' bzhi'i ngoms pa med pa'i mdzes nyams la blta ba dang / bkra shis dang dbyangs can yang sum rtsen gnas la skyengs pa ster nus pa'i khyad du 'phags pa'i yul ljongs der yid tshims par bltas rjes gzhon nu gsum po gcig tu 'dzoms nas ro bcud ldan pa'i zas za ba dang / zhim mngar ldan pa'i chang btung nas phan tshun gtam gleng byed 'go tshugs/ pad dbyangs kyis‘‘lung pa 'di ni dgun dus shin tu skyo zhing mthong ba tsam gyis yid skyo ba'i sa cha skyo po zhig red 'dug kyang dbyar kha shar dus sgrung deb nang du bris pa'i sum rtsen gnas lta bu zhig dngos su 'dug rjes su khom pa yod dus nga tsho 'di gar yong nas mdzes pa'i yul ljongs la blta ba dang chabs cig khyed gnyis la rig gnas phran bu bslab na yong ba 'dug gam ’zhes dris pas dbyangs can gyis‘‘pad dbyangs/ de 'dra byung na nga'i yid kyi bsam don 'grub song / bkra shis nga gnyis chung byis pa'i dus su yang mnyam du red/ nga tsho sdod sa'i bcu shog de'i nye 'gram na dmangs btsugs slob chung zhig yod pa der nga tsho byis pa chung chung kha shas zla bganyis tsam 'gro myong ’zer/ pad dbyangs kyis ya mtshan pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan ste‘‘zla ba gnyis las ma phyin nam’ zhes bshad/ ‘‘red/ zla ba gnyis las 'gro rgyu ma byung / rgyu mtshan ni lam bcos sa tshigs kyi bzo pa sa cha gcig tu gzhis chags pa'i dus med par skya kas skya tshang spo spo byas tsang nga tsho phru gu tsho 19

la yang rig gnas slob pa'i gnas gtan 'khel zhig med la dge rgan yang med/ de 'dra'i ngang lo yi bgrang bya drug gsum bco brgyad son nas las kar zhugs pa yin/ sbyong 'dod skom pa chu 'dod ltar yod kyang cha rkyen med pa'i dbang gis lan song’’zer/ bkra shis kyis rtswa sbar mo gang dus gcig tu bkog nas phar dbyugs rjes‘‘dbyangs can/ sems skyo dgos pa'i gtam de dag bshad nas gang byed/ de las rjes su pad dbyangs kyis nga tshor gza' 'khor re'i nang chu tshod bdun tsam zhig gi zur khrid byas na khom pa 'dug gam’’zhes dris pa dang / pad dbyangs kyis‘‘los khom/ da dung de'i khar slob tshan re khrid tshar rjes sbyong tshan sprod kyi yin/ su yin na yang gtan 'be+ebs gzhir bzhag byed dgos/ de ltar ma byas tshe sbyong tshan ldab bskur gyi chad pa yod’’ces bshad pas khong gnyis pos spro ba chen pos de ltar byed rgyu'i khas len dam bca' bzhagadus de nas bzung pad dbyangs kyi khang chung de mtshan mo'i slob khang zhig tu gyur nas chu tshod khag bgos su rgya yig dang / bod yig rtsis rig khag gsum 'khrid pa dang / nyin mo'i lto'i dus la yang mos bkod sgrig byas pa'i sbyong tshan blta ba sogs dus tshod byung tshad la slob sbyong byas tsang dus tshod cimi ring bar khong tsho tshang ma'i slob sbyong sbyangs 'bras yag po byung ba dang / zla bzang sogs bzo pa tsho'i bstod bsngags dang rgyab skyor 'thob/nyin zhig gi mtshan mo nam mkhar sprin nag 'khrigs nas glog 'od 'khyug pa dang 'brug skad ldir ldir du bsgrags nas drag char chu tshod gcig 20

lhag tsam babs te chad la ma chad kyi dus der pad dbyangs kyi khang chung nang du zla bzang yong nas‘‘khyed tsho'i slob tshan la bar chad byung song bas dgongs pa ma tshom/ sha 'od kyis lam 'khyer nas 'grul skyel rlangs 'khor zhig 'gro ma thub par lus 'dug nga tshos lam stabs bde zhig bzos nas 'grul skyel rlangs 'khor de 'gro thub pa byed dgos/ ngas 'grul pa tshor ja ja dam gsum bzos yod pas de khyed tshos 'khyer te lam seng shog’’ces bshad/ de mar kho tsho dang bzo pa gzhan tsho yang gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis phyin nas 'khyags te 'dar sig sig byed bzhin pa'i 'grul pa dang kha lo bar ja tsha po 'thung du bcug pa dang / chu'i nang 'dzul nas tsha tsha 'ur 'ur ngang lam bzo byas pas 'grul pa tsho sems 'gul thebs nas khong tshos kyang chu'i nang 'dzul te ngal rtsol byed rtsis byas par bzo pa tshos khyed rang tsho 'dzul gnang mi dgos/gzhon pa re gnyis kyis glog bzhu bstan na 'grig gzhan tshang ma rlangs 'khor nang bzhugs rogs zer mu mthud dka' tshegs che ba'i ngal rtsol nam phyed bar byas mthar gzhi nas rlangs 'khor 'gro thub tsam byung /phyi nyin bkra shis dang / zla chung / dbyangs can bcas sngar rgyun bzhin pad dbyangs kyi khang chung der slob tshan la yong dus mo'i khyim gyi sgra sdud 'khor lonas‘‘bde skyid gang du yod dam zhes pa'i gru gzhas gtong ba'i sgang yin pas bkra shis kyis‘‘pad dbyangs rang gis byas na bde skyid gang du yod dam zhes dris/ pad dbyangs kyis yud tsam ring bsam blo btang rjes skad gsangs mthon pos‘‘bde skyid sa phyogs gang du yod dam/ grogs kyis bdag 21

la 'di skad gsung bar byas/ de ni lcang ma'i bsil grib 'og tu med/ de ni dgun gyi drod khang nang du med/ bde skyid de ni dka' spyad las ka dang /dka' tshegs che ba'i ngal rtsol nang du mchis/ e ma bde skyid de ni khyed kyi 'od mdangs bkra ba'i rngul chu'i nang du mchis/ bde skyid sa phyogs gang du yod dam/ grogs kyis bdag la 'di skad gsung bar byas/ de ni dkar gsal zla 'od 'og tu med/ de ni mtshan gyi rmi lam du'ang med/ de ni blo rtse gcig gi brtson 'grus dang / mtha' yas shes bya'i bang mdzod nang du mchis/e ma bde skyid de ni khyed kyi gsal ba'i blo gros nang du mchis zhes gzhas tshig cha tshang de skyor bas khong tsho tshang mas‘‘yag po zhe drag 'dug nga tshos lam bzos pa'i dka' spyad rngul chu'i nang du nga tsho'i bde skyid yod’mices bshad/de dus sgo'i phyi nas‘‘yag po 'dug nga yang mos mthun yod’mizer ba'i sgra zhig grags pa dang mnyam du zla bzang yar 'dzul yong / zla bzang gis6‘nga mos mthun yod/ dka' las ma brgyab par bde skyid yong mi srid/ rlangs 'khor skyon cha med par shar gtong byed rgyu ni nga tsho'i bde skyid yinami zhes bshad pa dang khong tsho tshang mas so sos bde skyid la 'dzin pa'i ngos 'dzin mang po bshad/gang tsam nas zla bzang gis‘‘ngas bde skyid skor la mgo mkhor nas don dag chen po zhig brjed grabs byas 'dug da lta to'an krang rdo rje lags nas pad dbyangs 'khor shag la 'gro rgyu'i chog mchan bskur gnang 'dug pad dbyangs rang 'gro chas sgrigs shig’ ces bshad pas pad dbyangs ni gtam de thos pa dang dga' thag chod nas byis pa chung chung zhig dang 'dra bar dga' 22

mchong brgyab/ yud tsam song rjes mo'i dga' spro'i 'dzum mdangs rim bzhin med par gyur nas gal srid nga phyin na dbyangs can dang / bkra shis/zla chung bcas kyi slob sbyong la 'thus shor mi yong ngam snyam pa'i sems khral byung ste yud tsam ring skad cha ma bshad par bsdad pas dbyangs can gyis‘‘pad dbyangs rang blo bde po'i ngang du 'gro dgos/ da lta nga tsho gsum kas dpe deb blta klog thub pa ma zad/ 'bri rgyu yang rang mgo thon tsam yod pas so sos rang sbyong byas nas rang gi re ba chud zos su btang mi yong / tshur yong skabs dpe deb gsar pa mang tsam khyer yong rogs zer bshad pa dang zla chung gis kyang mgo bo lcog lcog byas/de nas pad dbyangs gzhis 'khor la thon khar bzo pa tshos pad dbyangs la bkra shis pa'i chang blugs te lam bar bde bgrod yong ba'i smon 'dun zhu skabs bkra shis kyis kyang chang dkar yol gang 'khyer yong nas pad dbyangs la sprad de’ pad dbyangs rang lha sar slebs rjes a nes grong khyer nang du las ka btsal te las bsgyur byed nges red/ dbir rang gis nyin mo lam bzo'i las ka hur thag byed pa ma zad/ dgong ltar nga tshor rig gnas bslab ste dka' ngal 'dzems med kyis nga tshor rogs ram byas par snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin pas chang dkar yol gang 'di mnyes dag mchod rogs zhes bshad/ mos chang de tshur blangs nas mnyes dag zhus rjes‘‘bkra shis rang ga re zer gyi yod/ nga a ne+e'i bzung dmag ni ma red/ ngas kha sngon khyim la btang ba'i ye ge'i nang du'ang lam bcos sa tshigs ni nga'i khyim yin pa 23

dang gzhung lam ni nga'i pha gzhis yin zhes bkod pa yin/ nga 'dir slebs pa nas lo gcig dang phyed ka tsam zhig phyin pa'i nang bsam blo'i 'thab rtsod dang dka' ngal mang po zhig 'phrad rung da cha ngas rang gi bde skyid la ngos 'dzin dang / lam bcos sa tshigs kyi bzo pa'i sbrang rtsi lta bu'i 'tsho ba'i ro bcud myangs thub pas de bzhag nas las ka gzhan byed par bskyod srid dam zhes bshad/ de mtshams tshang mas pad dbyangs la dkar zhing gtsang ba'i kha btags re g.yogs rjes pad dbyangs rlangs 'khor la bsdad de lha sar khyim du bskyod pa'i lam du zhugs/ lam gyi g.yas g.yon du g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal phyis pa lta bu'i gsing ma'i steng du kha dog rnam par bkra ba'i spang rgyan me tog khra chem mer bzhad yod pa dang / phyugs zog dkar nag rnams mjug ma gnam la ker nas 'phag mchong byed pa sogs ngoms pa med pa'i ltad mo mthong rgyu yod la/ lhag par du mu mtha' med pa'i klung thang dang rngam brjid ldan pa'i ri khrod g.yang gzar gang sar snam bu dkar po yug gcig sa la bting pa lta bu'i bde zhing khod snyoms pa'i gzhung lam skya thing nger yod pa des mo'i yid kyi brtan pa rab tu 'phrog pa'i mur 'das don zhig yid la 'char/de yang 'di lo'i lo gsar skabs kyi mtshan mo zhig la nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa'i ngos nas dkar gsal zla 'od sa gzhir 'phros shing / lam bcos sa tshigs kyi bzo pa tsho mnyam du bcu dpon zla bzang gi khyim la 'dzoms te bza' btung la rol nas lo gsar mnyam gtong byed pa'i skabs su lus steng du 'dam bag 'gos pa'i kha lo ba zhig yong nas‘‘nga'i rlangs 'khor gyi glog bzhu 24

ya gcig la skyon shor te 'gro lam gsal po ma mthong bar rlangs 'khor chu yur nang du lhung song bas 'don rogs gnang dang’’zhes bshad pas bcu dpon zla bzang gis‘‘khyed rang sems 'tshab ma byed’’zer gdan steng du sdod du bcug nas za btung gi sne len byas rjes las mi tsho khrid nas lam bcos sa tshigs nas le dbar gnyis tsam sar phyin te rlangs 'khor de'i nang du gro zhib tun bzhi yod pa de dag ras phad re re bzhin mar bton pa dang / yur bu'i nang du rdo rgyong ba sogs dka' tshegs che ba'i ngal rtsol chu tshod lnga tsam byas rjes gzhi nas 'dam dong nang nas rlangs 'khor de bton thub pa dang yang gro zhib ras phad re re bzhin du rlangs 'khor nang blugs te sngar rgyun bzhin bzos pas kha lo ba de sems 'gul thebs te gzugs po yongs rdzogs rngul chus 'tshos pa'i bzo pa mi re ngo rer lag pa btang nas‘‘khyed tsho ni dgun rlung bus mi 'khyer la dbyar drag char gyis mi 'jigs pa'i mthong bar dka' ba'i brag stengagi rtswa chung red’’ces bshad nas mig nang mchi zhag 'khor te skad cha mu mthud ma thon par lus/ de ltar pad dbyangs 'dang rgyag gi nang du lhung ba'i skabs der‘‘tu'u tu'u ’zhes pa'i rlangs 'khor gyi dung brda zhig grags pas 'dang rgyag las grol te rlangs 'khor gyi sge'u khung las blta skabs mthon mthing nam mkha'i dbyings nas rta bdun dbang po'i zer brgya rab tu 'phro bzhin par snang / /1986lo'i zla8par zin bris btab/1987lo'i dbyar khar bzo bcos kyis gtan la phab/25

so nam shor ba'i ljang bu/glo bur du khyi zug pa'i skad des grong khyer gyi khu sim po'i mtshan mo dkrogs shing / rmi lam gyi zhing khams su zhugs ma thag pa'i rgas 'khogs de tsho gnyid las dkrogs pas/ ‘‘dkon mchog mkhyen/ da so mar gnyid khugs pa tsam yin/ ltas ngan 'ug pa de tsho zhes 'khang ra byed zhor du yar langs te chab gsang la phebs pa dang / gnyid yal bar dogs pa'i sems khral dang bcas te slar yang nyal/ khyi de dag gis rgyang nas 'ong bzhin pa'i grib so nag po de'i phyogs su har sgra dang bcas te shor na'ang grib ma nag po des‘‘ya ya/ tsig tsig ces thengs 'gar skad brgyab pa na khyi de dag gis mi de'i skad ngo chod de lam sang kha rog ger bsdad pa dang / mjug ma 'khyil 'khyil byed bzhin du de'i rjes su 'brangs nas kho tshang gi sgo kha'i bar du bskyal/ khos khyi de dag la ci zhig ster snyam bzhin stod thung gi khug ma bsngogs tsam byas kyang stong hang hang yin pas snying la gri btsugs pa lta bu'i na zug drag po zhig skyes/ kha sang sgor mo stong phrag gsum shor ba'i pham kha de ring rgyal khas bsab pa'i re ba dang bcas zhogs pa khyim nas chas skabs sgor mo khri gcig 'khyer yod pas khug ma ljid tig tig yin kyang da lta slar yang kha sang dang mtshungs par stong bar gyur te phyir log dgos pa'i gnas su lhung 26

pas/ gzhi nas phangs sems skyes pa dang rang tshod rang gis ma zin par 'gyod pa drag ngo/ skyes te shugs ring nar nar 'byin/ skabs der kho'i snying khar bzod dka' ba'i tsha long zhig byung bas rang dbang med par khog 'dar zhig brgyab byung / rgyang ring na da dung khyi zug pa'i skad grag gin 'dugadus tshod ha cang 'phyis 'dug pas sgo brdung khar rang gi bu la yang ngo tsha ba'i snang ba skyes na'ang dar cig langs rjes da gzod sgo dal mos brdungs/ sngar yin na khos sgo drag por brdungs kyang bu gnyid la yur zin pas yun ring sgug dgos mod/ da lta mtshan gung la sgo phye ba de ni bu la mtshon na rang gi goms gshis su gyur yod pas sgo brdungs ma thag tu kho gnyid las sad/dbang rdor gyis sgo kha nas bsam blo sna tshogs gtong bzhin pa'i skabs su bu rnam rgyal gyis mig zung phur phur byed bzhin sgo phye nas‘‘pā lags/ khyed rang phebs pas/ 'di 'dra 'phyi ba la’’zhes bshad rjes a phar blta tsam yang mi byed par rang mal du nyal te lam sang gnyid du yur/dbang rdor gyis gnyid du yur 'dug pa'i rang gi bu'i gdong la bltas nas smra mi shes pa'i skyo snang drag po zhig dbang med du skyes/ khos snga ma snga mar phar shor pa'i sgor mo de dag tshur log pa'i nyin nas da mtshams bzhag chog ces dam bca' yang yang bzhag myong mod/ yin na'ang / rgyun par mal nas mig zim mer bsdad ma khad du mā cang gi ri mo sna tshogs kho'i mig lam du bro gar 'khrab kyin yod pas phyi nyin rang dbang med par slar yang‘‘lcags ri ring po rtsig pa'i ru khag de'i gras su zhugs pa red/ khos nam rgyun zhogs 27

par yar langs te bu mal las slong dus/ slob grwar 'gro ran 'dug pas zhogasazas za khom yang med par bu'i lag la zhogs zas nyo byed sgor gnyis sprad cing sgo lcags chen po de brgyab rjes pha bu gnyis rang rang sar 'gro bzhin yod/ a phas bu la sprad pa'i sgor mo de gnyis ni zhogs zas nyo byed zer ba 'a/sa nyin gang gi zas rin zhes brjod na 'tsham par 'dug rnam rgyal ni phru gu gzhan ltar skyel bsu byed mkhan med par ma zad/ kho nyin gang bor gang du 'gro ba dang bya ba gang 'dra zhig las pa a phas mi shes la/ a pha nyin gang bor gang du song ba dang bya ba ci zhig las pa bus kyang mi shes/dngapo/rnam rgyal gyis nam rgyun ltar a phas gnang ba'i sgor mo de khyer nas rang 'dod kyis gang byung du 'gro bzhin 'dug kho'i snang ngor de sngon a ma lhag pa mtsho mo dang spo bo yod skabs zhogs zas la sems khral byed mi dgos par bag leb dang mog mog sogs zos chog btung chog yod pa dang / slob grwar phar 'gro tshur yong tshang ma pha ma gnyis su lco gas kyis skyel bsu dang lta rtog byams skyong byed pa sogs dran dus/ yid skyo bo kho na las khyim tshang de ji ltar kha thor du song ba gsal bo zhig dran gyin mi 'dugakho la khag ci yod/ kho lo gsum la bslebs pa'i skabs der kho'i a pha dbang rdor ni rang gi bza' mi dang pha yul bzhag nas nang logs sa khul gyi 'phel rgyas 'gro bzhin pa'i sa cha kha shas la lta skor slob sbyong byed par song ste 〉 28

dus tshod ring tsam zhig 'gor/dbang rdor bza' zla gnyis la mtshon na dus yun 'di 'dra ring bo zhig la kha bral ma myong bas da thengs dbang rdor nang khul du song rjes lhag pa mtsho mo'i sems pa stong lhang lhang du gyur te spo bo dang bu gnyis kyis mo'i sems pa'i shog stong de'i steng du bza' tshang gi brtse dung gi ri mo 'bri thabs bral/de'i stabs kyis mos kyang skabs re la las brel che bar kha g.yar te rang khyim du ma logre/ par las khungs su las rogs tsho dang mnyam du nyin gung gi za ma za ba dang kha brda byas nas sems g.yeng thabs byed/ las rogs snyan grags kyi khyim yang las khungs dang bar thag ring bas phal cher nyin gung gi za ma gzhung las khang du za bzhin yod pa dang kho gnyis kyang tag tag la mnyam du khel 'dugaskabs der rnam rgyal gyis kyang a ma dang mnyam du 'gro rgyu yin zhes u tshugs byas na mo yang thabs zad de rnam rgyal gzhung las khang du khrid/ snyan grags kyis thengs dang por rnam rgyal mthong ma thag tu‘‘bu 'di dngos gnas snying rje bo zhig 'dug’’ces bshad cing las ka'i bar gseng du rnam rgyal la a khu ston pa dang / nyi chos bzang bo'i sgrung sogs mang po bshad pas rnam rgyal dga' thag chod pa dang / khyim du bslebs rjes rang gi spo bor ngo mtshar che ba'i sgrung de dag 'khyar 'khyor re bshad de‘‘spo bo lags snyan po 'dug gam’’zhes dris/ spo bos‘‘nga'i nor bu/ snyan po 'dug snyan po zhe drag 'dug’’ces kha nas thon ma thag rnam rgyal gyis‘‘des na nga sang nyin yang a ma'i sar 29

'gro rgyu yinami’zhes 'gro 'dod kyi re ba chen po zhus/ gal te a mas ma khrid tshe khos nyin gang bor spo bor rnyog dra bshad kyin yod pas a ma dang spo bo gnyis thabs zad de phyi nyin a mas slar yang mi khrid ka med byung /rnam rgyal dang snyan grags gnyis 'grogs yun ring na'ang snyan grags byis par kha ya byed rgyur sun snang med par ma zad/ mi gzhan la'ang rnam rgyal kho gnyis ha cang 'cham mthun che ba'i grogs po yin zhes bshad kyin 'dug las brel de 'dra med tshe khos rnam rgyal dang mnyam du rtsed mo rtse ba dang / skabs rer rang nyid rta'i tshul gyis rnam rgyal rang gi sgal bar khur te gog nas bskyod skabs rnam rgyal gyis kyang rta la lcag gis skul ba'i tshul bstan te/ snyan grags kyi rkub la‘‘khyu khyu’’zhes gzhus pa na lhag pa mtsho mo sogs las grogs tshos gnas tshul de dag mthong ma thag tu gad mo shor te mig chu shor pa dang grod pa lag pas skyor dgos par gyur/ las grogs tshos kyang‘‘phru gu 'di yong na dngos gnas nyi ma 'khyol sla mo zhig 'dug ces bshad/de ltar dus yun ring bo 'gor pa na mi gzhan pas lkog tu snyan grags dang lhag pa mtsho mo gnyis kyi 'brel ba rgyun ldan ma red ces rjod kyin yod pas mi kha ldang gi yod/ yin na'ang snyan grags kyis gnas tshul de dag thos kyang ma thos khul byas par ma zad/ lo mjug gi bya dga'i dngul las skabs der dar khyab che ba'i glog rdul rtsed chas shig nyos te rnam rgyal la lo gsar gyi legs skyes su byin/ dus tshod ni chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'gog thabs med par mdun nas mdun du skyod pa dang dbang rdor yang nang logs nas phyir rang 30

yul du bslebs/gnyis pa/dbang rdor ni rang gi pha yul dang gnyen nye bral te nang logs su song nas lo phyed lhag tsam las 'gor med na'ang / kho'i sems la ha lam lo gnyis gsum lhag 'gor ba'i snang ba byung bas rjes su don rnams 'grub rjes nyin gcig kyang dal 'gor ma byas par lam sang gnam gru la bsdad de phyir rang gnas su 'khor/dbangardor rang gi khyim du bslebs pa na dga' spro tshad med skyes te za ma'ang za long ma byung bar khug ma bsngogs nas nang mi tshor legs skyes sprad/legs skyes de dag las mang shos dang rin thang che shos ni lhag pa mtsho mo'i yin zhing / mo la skabs der nang logs su dar srol che ba'i lham dang / sba lhan gyi stod gos/ dar gos kyi 'og 'jug sogs mang po nyos yod pa de dag lam sang tshad e ran blta ru bcug yin na'ang lhag pa mtsho mos de dag la sngon ma ltar do snang de 'dra mi byed pa dang / kho'i u tshugs la do ma bsdos par tshad tsam re byas nas lam sang phud de kho la za ma 'dren pa'am las ka tsag tsig btsal nas g.yol gang thabs byed/ dbang rdor gyis lhag pa mtsho mo'i rnam 'gyur de dag mthong rjes cung dogs mi bde bar gyur na'ang snang 'jog de tsam ma byas par ma zad/ kho'i bsam par yun ring bral nas 'dug bzod pa'i yus bshad de dga' yang mi dga' ba'i mdog 'dra ston pa yin srid snyam 31

ste de bas kyang lam sang rno/ la 'khyud de yid tshim pa'i 'o 'i/ga byed 'dod kyang mdun na rang gi a pha dang bu gnyis ka yod pas de ba'in bsam thog la ma song /skabs de'i rnam rgyal ni grong pa khyim mtshes kyi na mnyam phru gus phrag dog dang yid smon bya yul zhig yin pa dang phru gu gzhan la yod pa kho la yod la gzhan la med pa'ang kho la yod/ da res a phas rgya nag nas gyon pa sna tshogs nyos yong bar ma zad/ rtsed chas kyang 'dra min nyos yod pas kho la mtshon na lo gsar bslebs pa lta bu'i dga' tshor yod pa las pha ma gnyis kyi rnam 'gyur la do snang gtan nas ma byaru//dgong mo spo bo thog khang du nyal rjes kho tsho gsum po yang nyal rtsis byas/bu rnam rgyal gyis yin gcig min gnyis la a pha dang mnyam du nyal rgyu zhes u tshugs byas pas lhag pa mtsho mo khang ba'i sbug tu nyal ba dang mdo der bu dang dbang rdor mnyam du nyal/ nam phyed tsam la rna la gzan pa'i ngu sgra zhig gis rnam rgyal gnyid las bslangs shing / kho kyig phar 'tham rtsis byas pa na a pha rang gi 'khris su med pas‘‘pā lags/ gang du yod/ nga zhed kyin 'dug’’ces skad brgyab pa na a pha khang ba'i sbug nas langs te glog bkar nas‘‘zhed mi dgos/ a pha yod’’ces bu'i mgor byil byil byed zhor du bu'i 'khris su nyal/ bu rnam rgyal gyis rang gi pha gzhan gyis 'phrog dogs yod pa ltar dam por 'khyud de skad chung ngus‘‘pā lags/ ga re gnang song ngam/ a ma ngu don ci red/ nga zhed kyin 'dug’’ces bshad/ dbang rdor gyis‘‘zhed mi dgos/32

snye.a pha khyod kyi 'khris su mi 'dug gam/ da gnyid chog’ ces bshad pas bus kyang ci yang mi bshad par dbang rdor gyi ske la 'thams te kha khu sim mer bsdad/ cung tsam 'gor nas skyid po'i gnyid la yur nas sna khung nas si sgra 'byin gyin 'dugadabang rdor ni gnyid khug rgyu lta zhog skabs der don dag mang po zhig kho'i kla ne pa'i nang btsangs nas ha lam mgo bo gas la nye ba'i tshul du gyur 'dug skad shugs chen pos lhag pa mtsho mo la ci zhig bshad 'dod pa dang /yang na khang ba'i klad la song nas gnam sa g.yo ba'i ngu 'bod cig byed 'dod yod mod/ yin na'oring rang gi snying nas brtse ba'i drin chen pha de sems sdu ga par dogs nas/ gtam dang mchi ma tshang ma rang gi khog la mid de/ bzod sgom chen pos mal sa'i nang tsog pur bsdad de tha mag gcig 'phror gcig mthud nas rngam 'then byas/skya rengs shar te spo bo dar rgyas gling skor la song rjes/ lhag pa mtsho mo'ang mal las langs pa dang mo'i mig zung skrangs te dmar por gyur yod/bu rnam rgyal gyis mal sa'i nang nas‘‘a ma’’zhes bos kyang kha ya ma byas/ khros pa'i tshul gyis mal las langs te zhogs zas kyang ma zos par rtsed chas khyer nas sgor song / lhag pa mtsho mos kha ngo bkrus shing mgo skra shad rjes ja phor pa gang ya nga ma 'thungs par khug ma khur nas khyim la sa thon/dbang rdor mal las langs shing kha ngo bkrus rjes/ tha mag gcig la me pasgos nas mdang dgong lhag pa mtsho mos rang nyid 'khris su bcar du ma 33

bcug pa dang / mo'i khog na skyes pa gzhan gyi phru gu yod tshul bshad pa dang /khos khong khros mo la 'gram lcag tsha thag chod pa zhig gzhus pa sogs la phyir dran byed kyin 'dug skabs der spo bo dar rgyas gling skor nas phyir khyim la log yong ba dang dbang rdor gyi 'khris la yong nas sngar bzhin byams sems ldan pa'i sgo nas‘‘mi bde ba 'dug gam zhes dris par dbang rdor gyis mgo bo g.yug g.yug byas te‘‘pā lags/ mi 'dug ngas zhogs ja bzos yong’’zhes bshad pa na/ spo bo dar rgyas kyis‘‘ga re/ da dung zhogs ja bzos med dam/lhag pa mtsho mo gang du song ngam ’zhes dris pa dang / glo bur du mdang nub kyi ngu skad de dran nas‘‘mdang nub ga re byas song ngam/ nga ni sems khral gyis gnyid kyang yag po khug ma byung / da nangs gling skor la ma song gong khyod la 'dri 'dod kyang khyod gnyid 'dug pas/ 'dri ma thub’ ces blo mi bde ba'i ngang nas dris/ dbang rdor gyis ngo gdong skyo bo zhig ston bzhin‘‘pā lags/khyed kyis ci yang shes kyin med/ lhag pa mtsho mos khyed la mgo skor thabs byas pa ma gtogs khyim 'dir snga sa nas sdod 'dod med 'dugami’ces bshad/spo bos skad cha de dag nyan rjes re zhig hang sangs pa dang de ma thag mgo bo g.yug gin‘‘de 'dra ga la srid/ nga de la yid mi ches/ de 'dra yin gyi ma red’’ces bshad cing / sen khud la sna tha nyung tsam gtul nas 'then zhor du dbang rdor med shul gyi lhag pa mtsho mo'i bya lugs byed stangs la phyir 'dang zhib mo zhig brgyab byung / dang thog yin na lhag pa mtsho mo ni nam rgyun dus ltar las thog tu 'gro ba dang dus ltar phyir khyim du yong gin yod kyang / bar 34

skabs shig nas kho tsho las brel ha cang che zhes skabs rer nyin gung phyir khyim du mi yong / spo bo dar rgyas kyis kyang dngos gnas las brel che na phar 'gro tshur yong bya rgyu de yang dka' las shig red snyam nas bsam 'char gang yang ma bton/ yin na'ang mos rgyu 'bras med pa'i las ka de 'dra byed mi srid pa'i yid ches yod pas da dung rang gi bu la gang byung gi skad char yid ches mi rung zhes bshad pa dang / yang bsam blo re btang na de yang gtan nas mi srid pa zhig ma yin pas/ ‘‘ma gzhi khyod kyis rnam kun du skye dman gcun mi thub pa dang ga dus yin na'ang mo'i ched du kho na bsam blo btang nas skyag lang du btang ba ma red dam’’zhes 'khang ra byas/ dbang rdor gyis‘‘pā lags/ da g.yugs zhog mo rang log yong na skad cha gsal bo zhig dris chogari’ces shod bzhin khang ba'i sbug tu 'dzul te sgo brgyab/spo bo dar rgyas kyis dbang rdor la sems gso zhig byed snyam yang sems gso ji ltar bya dgos pa'i thabs shig myur du ma rnyed pas/ khos thog mar snga sa nas dbang rdor yong rgyur gra sgrig byas pa'i tshal rnams bzos/ de ltar yun ring 'gor rjes kho tshang gi gyang ldebs kyi 'ug pa'i mgo bo rtags can gyi chu tshod de‘‘ku'u/ ku'uri’zhes thengs bcu gnyis la grags shing / chu tshod 'khor lo'i skar mda' de'ang gcig thog gcig gis brtsegs nas ang gi bcu gnyis la bstan 'dug rnam kun yin na lhag pa mtsho mo da lta khyem du bslepa ran mod/ de ring da rung phyir bslebs med la/ dbang rdo ra gyis kyang za ma za 'dod mi 'dug ces bshad de nang du 'dzul te sgor mi yong bas/ spo bo 35

thabs zad de/ re ba tshang ma dgong mo'i dus la bcol/nub mo'i chu tshod bdun pa yol na'ang lhag pa mtsho mo da dung phyir ma bslebs/ dgun gyi nyi ma thung bas sa rub snga ba dang nor 'dzin pumos gos nag gyon te mal tu zhugs/ spo bo dar rgyas kyis nyin gung bzos pa'i tshal dag tsha po bzos nas sgrog tse 'i steng du snga phyir bsgrigs shing / dbang rdor dang rnam rgyal gnyis la dgong zas za ran pa'i brda brgyab/ dbang rdor gyis ri mo'i deb chung zhig kha phye ste mdzub mos ston bzhin rnam rgyakhaglu la 'grel bshad rgyag gin yod / skabasano der rnam rgyal gyis glo bur du‘‘pā lags/ khyed kyis yi khu snyan grags khertswa gas lta bu'i sgrung yag po bshad shes kyin mi 'dug nga nyan 'dod med’’ces sgrog tse'i 'khris su ba car nas mdzub mo chung chung gnyis bsrings nas sder ma'i steng gi tshakha5 la bsnyababari / spo bos kho'i lag pa thur mas bkag ste‘‘de 'dra byed mi rung / a ma da dung 4 nga bslebs med’’ces bshad pas rnam rgyal cung mi dga' ba'i tshul gyis a pha'i 'khris su phyin/ dbang rdor gyis bu'i mgo la byil byil byed bzhin‘‘'gro nga tsho dgong zas za bar 'gro/a ma bsgug mi dgos mizhes bshad de dgong zas za rtsis byas/ dbang rdor gyi sems pa de 'dra skyid po zhig min pa spo bos ba/sal bor rtogs pas‘‘ya tshal grang 'dub/ khyod gnyis kyis cung tsa ma sgugs dang / ngas bsros te 'khyer yong’’zhes bshad de tshal de dab/ khyer nas thab tshang la song /skar ma lngari rjes su wo/ tsho pha tsha bugasu/ma gyis kha khu sim mer dgong zas de za mgo tshu spru /sa/ rnam rgyal gyis don dag ci yang mi shes pas‘‘zhim po 'dug36

zhe drag zhim po 'dug’’ces za zhor dang bshad zhor byed/ dbang rdor pha bu gnyis kyis thur ma lag tu bzung na'ang rang rang sa nas 'dang rgyag gi khrod lhung 'dug pa las/ sgrog tse'i steng gi za ma ye nas za 'dod med/gsum pa/dgun gsum mtho sgang gi gan ma gshis ni ha cang 'khyags shing grang lhags hur hur du ldang yang / khra chil sbi chil dang 'a ra 'u rus khengs pa'i grong khyer de'i mtshan ljongs ni mdzes sdug ldan par 'dug dbang rdor tshang gi brnyan 'phrin gyi kha ya nga ma phye bar pha bu gsum po kha khu sim mer bsdad yod pa dang lhag rngu mtsho mo da rung phyir ma ོ nga / kho tshang dang nye ba'i kha kā 0ṣākhang de'i nang nas grags 'ongs pa'i cung tsam bzi nas 'gag 'dug pa'i gzhas sgra de ni nardzi rgyun las rna bar gzan la/ lhing 'jags su kana'i/ pa'i khang mig de'i mkha' dbugs dkrugasari te mi'i blo sems kyang mi bde bar gyur/ spo bo dar rgyas ni mal du nyal na'ang gnyid ye nas rna khugs par gaji /sa log g.yon log byed bzhin yid la dgos mi dgos sna tshogs dran zhing /mngug mthar phyi nyin lhag pa mtsho mo'i la sa khungs su song ste mo dang kha brda yag po zhig bya rgyu thag gis bcad/phyi nyin zhogs par spo bo dar rgyas gling skor la'ang ma song bar zhogs ja bzos shing / gtsang sbra byas tshar rjes rnam rgyal khrid de lhag li mtsho mo'i las khungs su song / lhab/ pa mtsho mo ni las rogs bu mo zhig gi khyim du bsdad yod / 37

pas spo bo dar rgyas kyis mo sgor bos nas‘‘lo mang bo'i ring la ngas khyod la nga rang gi bu mo dngos shig dang mtshungs par gces sems btod yod mod/'on kyang khyod kyis nga la rgyu mtshan ci yang ma bshad par 'di ltar phyi nas 'dug ga la rung / don dag ga re yod kyang khyim du 'byor rjes bshad choga'agro/ da phyir khyim la 'gro’’zhes snying rlung stod du 'tshangs pa smad du mnan nas tshig 'jam pos bshad/skabs der lhag pa mtsho mos mig chu gtong ba las skad cha tshig gcig kyang mi shod/ spo bo dar rgyas kyis slar yang‘‘gang ltar kyang khyod ngus nas ci yang 'byung rgyu med/ de las bu yi ngo la bltas nas phyir khyim la song na 'grig’’ces nan tan gyis bshad pa na/ lhag pa mtsho mos glo bur du pus mo gnyis sa la btsugs te‘‘pā lags/ ngas dbang rdor dang khyod gnyis la mdo med kyi bya ba 'di 'dra las rtsis med mod/ yin na'ang da lta tshang ma 'phyis song’’zhe sa bshad cing ngu rgyang byas pas/ spo bo dar rgyas ni da gzod gnyid las sad pa ji bzhin bu dbang rdor gyis bshad pa bden pa red snyam te/ khong khro chen po langs rung bzod sgom byas te‘‘mi la skyon cha dang shing la mdzer ba'i dpe lta ra skyon med pa'i mi zhig ga la yod/ bza' tshang 'khrug pa su la yang yong srid pas a pha'i kha la nyan nas da phyir song na dga'’ zhe sa bshad par rno/sa‘‘ yā la sa/sa// da ci ji'i nga ma/ ba—/su/ngas/ nga'i khog na skyes pa gzhan gyi sha rus yod pas khyim yod kyang phyiralog thabs med’’zer/ spo bo dar rgyas kyi rna lam du‘‘nga'i khog na skyes pa gzhan gyi sha rus yod’’ces pa thos ma thag mig 38

mdun du nag 'tshub ber gyur te/ lus yongs 'dar yom yom byas shing /khong khro'i me lce lhab lha/ba tu 'phyur kyang kha nas yin min gyi gtam ci yang ma thon༈/lhag pa r+ya tsho mos‘‘pā lags/ dgongs pa ma tshom nga la'ang thabs med par gyur’’ces slar yang bshad pas/ spo bo dar rgyas kyis‘‘bshad mi dgos/ 'bas 'dren ma’’zhes thu lud cig btab pa na/ mo'i mig chu phreng thag chad pa bzhin thor nas‘‘pā lags/ khyed kyis nga la gcar rdung tsha drag po zhig byed rogs/ de ltar byas na nga yang nongs 'gyod chung ngur 'gro bar nges ’zhes mu mthud du‘‘nga la re ba zhig yod pa ni bu rnam rgyal sdug mi myong ched nga la ster rogs’’zhes bu la 'khyud de ngus/ rnam rgyal gyis don dag ci zhig byung ba gsal bor mi shes mod/ yin na'ang a ma ngu ba mthong bas mor /'thams nas‘‘a ma/ a ma’’zhes ngu 'bod byas/spo bo ni sems thag chad de rnam rgyal rang gi pang du blangs nas‘‘spo bo'i gceg phrug ngu dgos don med/ nga tsho phyir khyim la 'gro/ mo khyod kyi a ma byed 'dod med’’ces sems gso byas shing / rnam rgyal gyi gdong gi mig chu phyis pa dang mgor byil byil byas nas‘‘'jig rten khams kyi bud med tshang ma tshar med pas ci skyon’’zhes tsha bo khrid de phyi mig tsam yang mi lta bar rang khyim gyi phyogs su song / tsha bos‘‘a ma/ nga tsho mnyam du phyir 'gro’’zhes ngu skad lhang lhang du sgrog bzhin spo bo'i rjes su drud ma rgyugs kyis skyod/ lhag pa mtsho mos rang gi mgo skra nas 'then gyin‘‘bu/ nga'i bu’’zhes skad drag pos ngu bzhin 39

'dugaspo bo dar rgyas khyim du 'byor rjes dbang rdor la gnas tshul rnams gsal por bshad par ma zad/ da dung bu la sems gso'i kha brda gang mang byas/de nas bzung dbang rdor ni smra ba nyung du song zhing nam rgyun dbugs ring nar nar 'then gyin 'dug spo bo dar rgyas kyis rang gi bu'i sems kyi sdug bsnga la rtogs nas gang ji5nga ma bshad par rnam rgyal la sngar las lhag pa'i byan sa skyong byas/ rnam rgyal gna' sgrung nyan rgyur dga' la bya dngos ya mtshan gyi rigs la dri ba 'don rgyur yang dga' bas/ spo cos kyang kho'i 'dod pa bskang ba'i ched du nam rgyun khom pa re yod dus kho la gna' sgrung bshad pa dang / bton pa'i dri ba tshang ma re re bzhin sun snang med par lan yid tshims rnga4 zhig 'debs kyin yod pas/ kho gnyis ni na mnyam gyi rtse rogs dang 'dra ba byung bas rnam rgyal yang ma dang kha bkar pa'i sdug bsngal gyi g.yang la lhung dgos pa ma byung /gung zas kyi rjes su spo bo dar rgyas kyis nam rgyun bzhin tsha bo rnam rgyal dngatsā sgrol ma gnyis kri/ da de nyin ro/'i gling skor la 'gro ba yin/ khong gis rgyab la spag dang rus pa bcug yod pa'i lto phad cig khur cing / lag tu 'gyig dam zhig bzung ste/ gling skor gyi lam nas bdag po med la yar rgyug mar rgyug byed 7pre'i khyi ldom de tshor spag dang rus pa ster bar ma zad/ skabs 'gar khong gi mtha' la bskor cing kha nas‘‘sku tshe ring’’zhes ma ṇi zlo zlo byed 40

pa'i sprang slong byis pa de tshor zho dang skar ma 'dra ster bar byed/ lam du 'dzoms skyid za khang zhes pa'i za khang grags can zhig yod pa de brgyud dus de'i nang song ste cung tsam ngal gso ba dang khong gi g.yas su tsha bo rnam rgyal dang g.yon du khyi sgrol ma sdod rgyu ni goms gshis su gyur yod/ rnam rgyal lo lnga trem 'ari bslebs shing gzugs kyang kho'i na tshod la ltos pas ring bo zhig yod mod / yin na'ang spo bo dar rgyas chos ra jal du 'gro skabs nam rgyun da rung lo gnyis kyi phru gu bzhim rgyab shā/ 'khur dgos pa nga/nga / rnam rgyal kyang nam yin nung spo bo'i rgyab la glan nas sdod/ g.yas g.yon gyi mi rnams kyis kyang mi bde ba'i tshul gyis kho sa/nyis la lta bzhin yod / de slad ༈/ rnam rgya1ga la rma tshon na ma yi byams skyong med na'ang spo bo'i byams skyong a rma las kyang lhag pa de yod 'dug yin na'ang / byams skyong de yang yun ring bo myong ba'i skal ba ma ldan par ldum ra'i me tog dang mtshungs par ston ba/su ma/ sa da kyis bcom song /spyir yin na spo bo da ra rkyas kyis tshe gang bor phyas/ hru chod 'bul zhing snyom sa chung la sbyin pa btang bas nad med tshe ring cig tsha/nga dgos pa yin mod/yin na'ang 'jis/ rten mi rtag rnga/ dang mi tshe ni rtswa mgo'i zir+ṣari ba dang mtshungs pa'i dpe bzhin/ phyi dro zhig la kho'i mgo bo cung mi bde zhes nyal pa dang / phyi nyin nad bab de las lci ru song bas/ dbang rdor gyis cha༈ phar mu tig bdun cu zhi ga blud rjes phyir nyal du bcug 'on kyang bsam yul 'a sa 'das pa zhig la spo bo dar rgyas ni gtan nas gnyid ma sad par phyi ma'i 'phrang ring 'grim 41

song la/ de nas bzung rnam rgyal la bde skyid kyi nyi ma yang med par gyur/spo bo dar rgyas tshe las 'das rjes dbang rdor la khom pa phran tsam byung tshe rang gi bu rnam rgyal khrid de chos mjal la song nas/ pha 'das po dag zhing du skye ba'i smon lam 'debs pa dang bu la yang smon lam 'debs su bcugabazhi pa/ rnam rgyal ni ma dang bkar pa'i khar da lta brtse ba'i spo bo yang tshe las 'das pas/ sems sdug gis ngo gdong nas thal mdog thon pa dang sha yang nyin rer rid par gyur/ dbang rdor gyis snang tshul de dag mthong nas sems pa de bas skyo zhing / bu'i bde skyid kyi ched du rang nyid kyis da nas bzung pha ma gnyis kyi go chod pa zhig bya rgyu'i dam bca' bzhag nas/ bu dang rang nyid kyi bar thag gang thub kyis je nyer btang ste bu'i sems sdug dag rim bzhin med par 'gyur thabs byas/rnam rgyal slob grwar bcug pa nas bzung dbar rdor gyis dus tshod ltar skyel bsu byed cing / yig chas dang rtsed chas kyang rnam rgyal gyi 'dod pa ltar gong che chung la mi lta bar nyo rkyang byed kyin yod la/ bu la yang rtag tu sgrig lam yag po srung dgos pa dang / dge rgan la gus zhabs dang slob grogs bar la mthun sgril byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog rig pa bsgrims te/ slob sbyong thad 'bad pa byas nas gzhan gyi rjes su mi lus pa zhig byed dgos zhes nan bshad byed kyin yod/ rnam rgyal ni blo rig bkra la grung sha dod pa dang dge rgan gyi kha 42

la nyan pa zhig yin pas/ lo rim dang po'i slob mjug tu rgyugs len skabs 'dzin grwa bzhi yi khrod nas sbyangs 'bras legs shos kyi gras su bslebs pas/'dzin grwa'i nang gi slob ma tshang mas kho la ha cang dga' bo byed par ma zad/dge rgan gyis kyang bstod bsngags byed kyin yod pas khyim bdag tshogs 'du'i thog tu dbang rdor la'ang gzi brjid tshad med pa byung ba'i snang ba zhig skyes/lo rim gnyis par bslebs dus rnam rgyal gyi khyim sbyong mngon gsal du je nyung la song / dbang rdor la goms gshis bzang bo zhig yod pa ni/ rnam rgyal gyis sbyong tshan 'bri skabs brnyan 'phrin kha mi phye bar sbyong tshan bris tshar rjes/ kho gnyis kyis mnyam du brnyan 'phrin lta bzhin yod la blta bya yag po med tshe snga mo nas nyal te bu la ngal gso gang legs yong thabs byed pa red/rnam rgyal gnyid du lam sang yur na'ang dbang rdor gyis mig zung btsum ma thag tu lhag pa mtsho mo'i las rgyu 'bras med pa'i bya lugs byed stangs dag yid la wa ler 'khor nas/ thog mar skyo snang dang rim bzhin khong khror gyur te gnyid gtan nas mi khugs pa'i gnas su lhung /gza' nyi ma zhig la dbang rdor gyis bu rnam rgyal khrid de rang gi grogs po dbang 'dus tshang la sgo nyug tu song / dbang 'dus kho gnyis las khungs gcigagi yin pa dang gnyis ka sngar nas bzung 'cham po yin pas phan tshun 'gro 'ong yod/ dbang rdor gyi khyim du snga rjes su don dag mang bo zhig byung bas dbang 'dus tshur yong nas rogs byed ci thub byas/ nyin der kho pha bu 43

gnyis dbang 'dus kyi khyim du 'byor skabs dbang 'dus dang mi gzhan 'gas mā cang rgyag bzhin yod pas dbang 'dus sgrog tse'i 'gram nas yar la ma langs par dbang rdor la 'tshams 'dri byas rjes/ kho'i bza' zlas dbang rdor la sne len zhus pa las kho rang ni rig pa rtse gcig tu bsgrims nas mā cang rgyag bzhin 'dug dbang rdor yud tsam bsdad kyang snying bo ci yang med pas/khos dbang 'dus kyi rna 'gram du‘‘khyod tshos rtse dang nga phyir 'gro rgyu yin ’zhes bshad pa na/ dbang 'dus kyis‘‘khyod nged tshang la dus yun ring po ma yong bas/ de ring yong ma thag tu phyir 'gro rgyu yin zer na ga la 'grig de las nga tsho dang mnyam du rtsed mo phran tsam rtse dang ’zhes kho yar langs te 'dug stegs dbang rdor la phud/ dbang rdor gyis‘‘mā cang ngas gtan nas rtse mi shes pas nga phyir 'gro rgyu yin zhes myur du 'gro rtsis byed skabs/ dbang 'dus kyis dbang rdor rang gi sdod sar u tshugs kyis 'dug tu bcug cing kho'i dpung ba nas mnan te‘‘ngas khyod la mdzub khrid byas chog rtsed mo 'di shes na 'di las skyid po zhig yod pa ma red/ lhag par du deng sang rtsed mo 'di ma shes na dga' nye grogs po mnyam du 'dzoms skabs khyod g.yog po byed pa las 'os med’mices zer bzhin ji ltar rtsed tshul mdzub khrid byas/ skor ba 'ga' 'khor rjes dbang rdor gyis kyang rob tsam shes par ma zad/ ma bsams sa nas dus tshod gsum tsam nang sgor sum brgya lhag thob/ kho'i bsam par de ni dngos gnas dgod bro ba zhig yin la/ rlung rta rgyugs po byung na las ka brel ba 'tshab 'tshub byed pa las 'di yag po 'dug snyam ste rang dbang med par de 44

la spro ba bla lhag cig skyes byung /de nas bzung dbang rdor ni kho tsho'i 'bod mi dgos pa'i rgyun gtan gyi sbag rogs shig tu gyur/dbang rdor nyin rgyun sbag rogs tsho'i sar rtsed mo rtse bar 'gro skabs/snga mo nas phyir log rgyu'i gra sgrig byas na'ang / mā cang lag pas reg pa na/lag mgo'i chu tshod 'khor lo mig lam du mi thogs pas dus tshod ga 'drar bslebs pa rtsa ba nas brjed 'dug rgyan po mtshams bzhag ste lhod lhod ngang chab gsang byed skabs chu tshod la lta ba'i tshe da gzod khyim du log rgyu dran pa dang / grod pa ltogs drags pa'i phru gu zhig gis rang nyid la bsgugs nas yod pa dran/ am phrag sngog tsam byed skabs sgor mo tshang ma shor zin pas 'gyod sems dang bcas da nas bzung rgyan po mi 'jog pa'i dam bca' rbab rdo 'dra ba re bzhag khos sgor mo yal thengs rer dam bca' de 'dra re 'jog pa dang dam bca' 'jog thengs rer thog ma'i nyin 'ga'i ring la dam bca' brtan po bsrungs te/ las ka grol ma thag rtsed mo rtse 'dod kyi bsam blo nan po bcun te dus thog tu khyim la log nas bza' btung gra sgrig byas nas bu rnam rgyal phyir yong bar sgug yin na'ang nyin 'ga'i rjes su bu dang mnyam du nub zas bzas tshar rjes/ las ka ci yang med pas dam bca' rang zhig tu song nas slar yang gom pa'i 'degs 'jog rang dbang med par dbang 'dus kyi khyim du thal/rnam rgyal la mtshon na de yang don sdug po zhig min te/ a pha rtsed mo rtse 45

bar song na rang nyid kyang mnyam du 'gro thub pa dang dbang 'dus kyi khyim du phru gu gzhan dang mnyam du glog rdul rol rtsed rtse thub la/ ltogs na zas dang gnyid 'dod na a pha'i rgyab tu nyal rjes mthar ji ltar khyim du bslebs pa'ang shes kyin med pas rmornam kun gyi 'tsho ba dang mi 'dra ba'i snang ba gang yang med/'on kyang tshul de yang yun ring ma gnas par bar skabs shig nas bzung a pha las ka grol rjes khyim la dus thog tu log yong gi med/ de yang nyin zhig nas bzung de snga a pha rgya nag nas phyir yong skabs kho'i ske la 'dogs byed glog rdul gyi chu tshod cig nyos yong ba de'i khar da lta lde mig cig mang du song zhing /khyim du yong na'ang za ma bzos med pas a phas kho la dngul sprad de khrom nas nyosa'i zo zhes bshad/ rnam rgyal gyis kyang za ma nyos te 'gyig khug nang la bzung nas slob grwar 'gro bzhin yod/nyin zhig gi zhogs par khyim nas thon te slob grwar 'gro skabs a phas sngar rgyun ltar dngul sprad/ khos mthong ga'i chu tshod la lta dus slob thun tshogs par chu tshod phyed ka tsam yod pas/ slob grwa dang nye ba'i za khang chung chung zhig gi nang 'dzul te zhabs zhu bar‘‘thug pa dkar yol gang dgosami’zhes bshad/yong 'bab gsog mkhan la nam nyin dang snga phyi med la mgron po la'ang gdam kha med cing / zhogs pa snga bo de 'dra nas 〈nub phyogs su gnas skor la bskyod pa 〉zhes pa'i bod skad brnyan 'phrin 'khrab tshan las‘‘sprel rgyal gyis lha yul dkrugs pa ’zhes pa de ston bzhin yod/ de sngon le'u de ston skabs tag tag kho tsho'i gling la glog med pa dang khel pas lta ma thub/ phyi nyin zhogs par 46

slob grogs tshos gson nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas le'u de'i skor bshad skabs rnam rgyal la phangs sems tshad med skyes/ da res tag tag le'u de ston pa dang khel pas khos 'khrug cha che ba'i le'u de las skar ma nyi shu tsam zhig bltas rjes slob thun dang po'i rjes zin snyam/ 'on kyang bltas kyin bltas kyin sun wu'u khung gi rdzu 'phrul dang mnyam du kho'i rnam shes kyang lha yul dkrug par song bas zhabs zhu mas dkar yol mdun du bzhag pa yang ma tshor/ chu tshod gcig tsam 'gor rjes zhabs zhu masaphamagron po chung chung lags/ khyod kyi za ma grang gi 'dug ces bshad pas/ kho gzhi nas gnyid las sad de brang kha'i chu tshod la bltas pa na slob grwa tshogs zin par ma zad thun gnyis pa yang tshogs zin yod pas kho hob tu yar langs nas rgyugs 'gro ba'i tshe ja zhu bu mo des lag gi ja dam yang 'jog khom ma byung bar rjes 'ded bzhin‘‘wa ye/ khyod kyis ja rin ma sprad par gang du 'gro ba yin nam/ phyogs spang ni phyogs spang (phyogs nas yul gyar 'ongs pa'i sprang po'i don )rang red’’ces sdigs pas khos bud medader 'grel bshad rgyag khom med par sgor mo gnyis po de am phrag nas bton te de'i phyogs su g.yugs/ bud med des sgor mo gnyis po de thang nas sgrug bzhin da dung kho'i rjes nas rdzogs rgyu med pa zhig bshad bzhin yod kyang khos gsal bo ga la thos/ de nyin kho 'phyi 'byor thengs dang po yin pas dbugs hal bzhin slob khang gi sgo kha nas‘‘snyan seng zhu zhes thengs 'gar bosakhyang skad chung bas/ kha ya byed mkhan ma byung bar chu tshod phyed tsam la slob khang gi phyi ru don med du 'dug dgos byung /47

slob thun grol pa'i cong brda grags pa dang slob khang nas slob phrug rnams skad cor dang bcas te phyir thon/ slob phrug kha shas kyis rnam rgyal la bltasate mdzub mos gdong la brad brad byas nas‘‘'o lad ’ces ngo tsha phab/de'i khar stabs ma 'grig pa zhig la de nyin tag tag la slob ma bzung ba dam drag che la sku rlung lang la khad pa'i rgya yig rgan lags kyi slob tshan dang khel pas/ dge rgan gyis zhal ras nag po bstan de kho gzhung don khang du khrid nas/ 'phyi 'byor thebs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dris/ khos dge rgan sku rlung bzhengs pa mthong bas dge rgan la don dag ngo ma drang mor bshad mi nus la rdzun de bas bshad mi nus pas/ lag pa gnyis pos mgo bo 'phur gyin 'dug pa las lan gang yang ma btab/ dge rgan thabs zad de rjes su 'phyi 'byor mi byed pa khas len du bcug rjes kho phyir 'dzin grwa'i nang log tu bcug rnam rgyal de nyin slob phrug tsho'i khrod du ngo tsha nyos pas kho'i sems la da res ma gtogs 'phyi 'byor mi 'ong ba bya rgyu'i dam bca' bzhag ste/ khyim du bslebs rjes de ring gi gnas tshul mtha' dag gcig kyang ma lus par a phar bshad bsams/ yin na'ang sems pham pa zhig la a pha sngar bzhin rgyan po 'jog par song nas da rung phyir ma yong bas sems skyo nas rang nyid gcig pu ngus te bsdad/ 'on kyang gnas tshul de a phar ma bshad na blo mi bde bas rnam kun bzhin ma nyal par a phar sgug mtshan mo chu tshod bcu gnyis pa tsam la a pha da gzod phyir log nas rnam rgyal la khyod da dung ma nyal par ga re byed kyin yod dam zhes dmod mo byas pa na/ rnam rgyal gyis de ring byung ba'i 48

gnas tshul rnams ji ma ji bzhin a phar bshad/ bsam yul 'das pa zhig la a phas rgyan po shor pa'i skabs dang khel pas/ kho la gshe gshe drag po zhig btang ste sang nyin nas bzung rnam rgyal gyi zhogs zas la khrom nas bag leb nyo rgyu byas/ zhogs zas de ltar thag gcod byas kyang nyin gung gi za ma mang che ba sngar bzhin khrom nas za dgos pas/ rnam rgyal gyi dam bca'i rdo rje yang nyin re bzhin thor te mthar rang zhig tu song nas 'phyi 'byor yang je mang du gyur/lhag pa mtsho mos kyang dus tshod nges med thog skabs 'gar slob grwa'i sgo 'gram du bsgugs nas ma bu kha bral gyi sdug bsngal bshad cing / rnam rgyal la rtsed chas sogs gang 'dod du nyo bar ma zad/ da dung a phas byams po yod med skor gyi 'dri tshig mang bo dris na'ang rnam rgyal gyis lan yag po zhig mi 'debs/ lhag pa mtsho mos dbang rdor gyi da lta'i bya spyod skor go thos phran tsam yod pas/ bu la snying re rje snyam nas rnam rgyal la nyin gung gi za ma a ma'i las khungs su za bar shog ces zer ba dang / yang skabs 'gar khrom gyi za khang du khrid de gang 'dod za ru bcug na'ang / des rnam rgyal gyi sems la dro skyid kyi snang ba gang yang sbyin mi thub/ rnam rgyal gyi na tshod che ru 'gro ba dang bstun nas a ma mthong na khong khro langs pa dang a ma'i sar 'gro 'dod med par ma zad/ kho'i de snga'i rtsed grogs te snyan grags zhes pa de bas kyang mthong mi 'dod par gyur pas a ma slob grwa'i sgo khar bsgugs yod pa mthong tshe rgyang nas g.yol gang thub byed/rnam rgyal gyi sems la rang nyid la phru gu gzhan ltar pha ma nyis 'dzoms kyi 49

bde skyid med de/ slob grwa grol nas khyim du 'byor skabs rtag par mdun nas bsu ba byed mkhan ni rgya sgor dpyangs pa'i sgo lcags de yin pa dang khyim gyi 'dug rogs ni khyi sgrol ma gcig pu las med/ za ma ni bag leb skam po'am yang na nyin shas ring la yang bskor bskyar bskor gyis bsros pa'i 'bras lhag dang tshal lhag de las ma 'das pas/ de'i bro ba la zhen log nas khrom gyi bro sman sna tshogs 'dzoms pa'i thug pa dran par ma zad/ da dung skabs 'gar a mas kho la sgor mo 'ga' re byin nas rgya mi'i za khang nang song ste/ co tsi zhim po dkar yol gang do re za rgyu yod la phor ba'ang bkru mi dgos par ma zad/mig gis ltad mo longs spyod bya rgyu mang bo'ang yod pas khrom lam gyi za khang de dag khyim las kyang skyid pa'i snang ba 'char gyin yod/lngapa/rnam rgyal gyis zhogs pa mang che bar zhogs zas ma bzas par slob grwar 'gro bzhin yod/ dge rgan gyis kha sang bkod sgrig byas pa'i sbyong tshan bsdu skabs kho la sprod rgyu med/ slob thun gnyis kyi rjes su grod pa ltogs nas bzod dka' bar gyur nas thun grol ma thag rgyus che ba'i srang lam kyag kyog de dag brgyud de/ za khang chung chung zhig gi nang du 'dzul nas zhabs zhu bar skad mgo mthon pos‘‘thug pa dkar yol gangari zhes pa'i kha byang du song ba'i zas 'bod de byas rjes/ thug pa ga dus 'khyer yong min la snang 'jog gang yang mi byed par mig gnyis brnyan phab la ngang gis cer nas 'dug ja khang 50

dang za khang gang yin na'ang bod skad du bsgyur ba'i sun wu'u khung dang /cang tsi ya/ wu'u sung sogs dang / de min 'khrug cha dod pa'i drag 'dzing /tha na phyi rgyal skad 'gyur med pa'i drag 'thab sogs ltad mo gang mang yod/rnam rgyal la'ang gdam kha gang yang med par ci tsam bltas kyang ngoms pa med pas/ zhabs zhu mas thug pa mdun du bzhag na'ang khos brnyan phab la bltas nas 'dug pa las thug pa btung rgyu gzhi nas brjed 'dug za khang dang ja khang de rigs kyi nang du 'gro mkhan mang che ba ni sprang phrug dang / grong gseb pa'i 'grul pa 'ga' re dang / rgyang ring gi 'grul pa 'ga' re bcas yin la/rang nyid dang 'dra ba'i slob phrug kyang rgyun du mthong rgyu yod/ kho dang thog der song skabs de'i nang du tshi dri dang / rkang dreg gi dri/ de min 'di zhes bshad mi shes pa'i dri ma mang bo zhig mnyam du 'dus nas sna khung la tsha shar rgyag pa dang skyug mer langs kyi yod pas kho zur zhig tu g.yol nas sdod pa red/ dus yun ring bo 'gor rjes dri dang sna gnyis yongs su 'dris nas de 'dra'i dri la'ang goms par gyur pas/ kho'ang mi gzhan dang mnyam du ltad mo'i dbyings su 'phags nas sdod kyi yod/ sbyong tshan legs grub ma byas pa'i slob ma dag la dge rgan gyis bkod sgrig byas pa'i sbyong tshan gyi ldab lnga dang yang na bcu 'bri dgos zhes chad pa bcad mod/ rnam rgyal ni snga dro slob grwar yod na phyi dro med pa dang de ring yong na sang nyin mi yong bas dge rgan yang 'u thug nas ci bya gtol med kyi rnam pa ston par byed/gza' zla ba'i phyi dro zhig la 'dzin grwa'i kru'u rin rgan lags kyis slob ma 51
