'ga' mngags nas kho srung du bcug nas 'dzin tshogs la u tshugs kyis zhugs su bcug 'dzin tshogs kyi nang don ni da lta'i bar kho la slob gso thengs mang btang yang phan thogs ma byung bas/ da thengs dge slob zung du 'brel nas slob gso yag po zhig bya snyam pa de red/ 'dzin grwa'i kru'u rin rgan lags kyis khor gshe gshe dang sdigs mo ma byas par ngag 'jam pos‘‘rnam rgyal ni gzhi nas phru gu ngan pa zhig min pas/ nga'i sems la khyod kyis da nas bzung skyon cha de dag tshang ma spangs na khyod kyi pha ma dang dge rgan tshang ma blo bde mo yong bar ma zad/ nga tsho'i 'dzin grwar yang skor skyod dar dmar 'thob pa'i re ba shin tu chen po yod/ sems pa ma pham par 'bad pa byed dgos’ zhes gsungs pa dang mnyam du slob phrug tshos kyang mdza' mthun gyi lag gnyis brkyangs te rnam rgyal la phan pa'i kha ta mang bo byas pas/ kho sems 'gul thebs nas dge slob tshang ma'i mdun du rjes su 'dzin grwa dang dge rgan gyi zhal ras la spyod ngan dri ma'i nag nog mi 'byug pa'i dam bca' bzhagadam bca' 'jog thengs rer kho yang phru gu bzang bo zhig bya rgyu'i sems shugs chen po skyes nas/ phyi nyin snga mo nas slob grwar 'gro ba dang sbyong tshan yang dge rgan gyi bkod sgrig ltar 'bri bzhin yod/ yin na'ang bya spyod ngan pa de'i bag chags ni ha cang zab pa dang za ma'ang sngar bzhin khrom nas za dgos pas/ za khang du 'dzul rjes ltad mo de dag las g.yol thabs med pa dang ltad mo'i mgo bltas rjes mjug de ma mthong na blo mi bde/ ltad mo'i mjug bltas tshar nas chu tshod la blta skabs slar yang slob tshan gcig gnyis re'i 52

rjes su lus pas/ 'dzin grwar 'gro mi phod la khyim du log na da rung cung snga bas de gar mu mthud du bsdad pa red/ rnam rgyal gyi 'phyi 'byor dang slob byol ni 'dzin grwa phar zhog tha na slob grwa'i nang du'ang ming grags che bas dge rgan gyi sngar gyi ngang rgyud 'jam po'i slob gso ni da lta gshe gshe dang sdigs mor gyur/ slob grogs tshos kyang rnam rgyal gyis 'dzin grwa'i zhabs 'dren byas pa min tshe nga tsho'i 'dzin grwar skor skyod dar dmar thob yod pa kho thag yin zhes kha rdung btang /'onaskrung dge rgan gyis gshe gshe gtong ba ni rnam rgyal la mtshon na lce snar tsam dang mgo bo 'phur 'phur byed pa las sems kyi gting nas do snang gtan nas mi byed pa dang / slob grogs tshos sdigs mo byed pa la'ang ma mos pa'i tshul gyis lkog tu mig log lta bar byed/dge rgan ni sems kyis ma bzod par rnam rgyal gyi khyim dang thag nye na bsdad yod pa'i 'dzin grwa'i grwa dpon bstan 'dzin la zhogs pa dang nyin gung slob grwar yong skabs/ nges par du rnam rgyal khrid yong dgos pa'i bkod sgrig byas kyang rnam rgyal gyis lam bar nas kha g.yar te bros 'gro/ de'i rjes su dge rgan thabs zad de rnam rgyal la khyim bdag khrid yong dgos pa'i blang bya thengs mang bton yang gtan nas khrid yong rgyu med pas/ mthar bstan 'dzin la rnam rgyal gyi khyim bdag khrid de yong dgos zhes bshad/ nyin der bstan 'dzin gyis rnam rgyal tshang gi sgo kha nas dbang rdor bos pa de dbang rdor gyis ma thos gong rnam rgyal gyis thos pas/ kho lam sang phyir thon yong nas 53

bstan 'dzin khug kyog cig tu 'then nas‘‘jo jo bstan 'dzin sku mkhyen/ da res khyod kyis nga'i pā lags la ma bshad na ci 'dra red/ gal te a phas shes na nga las sla bor 'jog gi ma red/ sang nyin nas bzung ngas dngos 'brel yag po byas te yong chog’’ces zhu ba yang yang byas shing u tshugs byas te bstan 'dzin phyir log tu bcugade ltar nyin kha shas la bstan 'dzin sgo khar bslebs ma thag tu rna cog krong nger bslangs 'dug pa'i rnam rgyal myur du sgor thon nas/ thabs mkhas kyis kho'i pha dang thug tu ma bcug pas bstan 'dzin yang 'u thug nas slar yang skad gtong bar ma yong bas rnam rgyal de bas rang dbang che ru song /rnam rgyal ni sngar bzhin rang 'dod kyis brnyan phab la blta ru 'gro bzhin yod/ ja khang dang za khang de rigs nang du slob grwa gzhan gyi kho dang 'dra ba'i slob phrug 'ga' re yang yod pas/ rnam rgyal kyang de tsho dang mnyam gcig tu 'gro bzhin yod na'ang de ring 'di dang sang nyin de yin pa las/kho la da dung kho'i 'khyam rogs 'di yin dang de min zer ba zhig gtan khel byas med la grogs po yang 'di yin zhes pa zhig med/ skabs re thug rin sprod rgyu med tshe kho a pha'i ngo shes kyi mdun du song nas g.yo sgyus sgor tsag tsig re slong ba dang kho tshos kyang dbang rdor gyi ngo la bltas nas ster rkyang byed pa las gang mkho dang ci bya zhes 'dri mkhan gcig kyang med/ de nas bzung kho la sgor mo med par gtan nas sems khral byed mi dgos par gyur/ rnam rgyal slob grwar snga dro yong na phyi dro mi yong ba dang de ring yong na sang nyin mi yong ba'i 54

grangs ka mang nas mang du 'gro bzhin yod pas/ 'dzin grwa'i kru'u rin bsam skyid lags rnam rgyal gyi a pha btsal bar kho tshang la thengs 'gar song yang /mor bsu ba byed mkhan ni sgo leb ngos su dpyangs 'dug pa'i sgo lcags dang khyi sgrol ma'i zug sgra ma gtogs med pas mthar dbang rdor gyi las khungs su mi 'gro ka med byung /drug pa/nyin zhig la dge rgan bsam skyid lags kyis slob tshan med pa'i skabs shig dang bstun te dbang rdor gyi las khungs la 'tshol bar song / las khungs kyi sgo srung par gar song gang yod kyi gtam dris pa na sgo srung spo bo des‘‘de ring phyi dro las ka med pas cus krang lags sku rtsed gnang gi yod pa 'dra/khyed la sku don yod na sang nyin snga dro phebs rogasari’zhes lan pa bslogs/skabs der bsam skyid kyis rang nyid slob grwa'i dge rgan yin lugs dang nges par du dbang rdor lags thug dgos lugs sogs rgyu mtshan mang bo bshad pas spo bo de da gzod dbang rdor 'bod par song /dbang rdor ni da lta rang gi sbag rogs 'ga' dang mnyam por du smug gi khrod nas phan tshun gyi gdong gi rnam 'gyur la bltas te rang gi khog rtsis rgyag gin yod pa'i sgang yin pas gzhan gyis 'bod kyin yod zer ba thos ma thag tu cung khros nas yud tsam sgrug dgos zhes lan btab/ sgo srung spo bo des khyod kyi bu'i dge rgan yin zer zhes pa na kho hob ste yar langs nas sgor bud/55

sgo kha ru sgug 'dug pa'i dge rgan bsam skyid lags mthong 'phral dbang rdor gyis mgo bo 'phur 'phur byed bzhin‘‘de ring phyi dro khom pa cung yod pas grogs po 'ga' dang rtsed mo 'khyug tsam rtse ba yin ’zhes tshur ma dris kyang rgyun du de ltar min tshul dag sel byas/dge rgan bsam skyid kyis 'dzum tsam las snang 'jog ma byas pa'i tshul gyis‘‘cus krang lags/ de ring ngas khyed btsal ba ni rnam rgyal gyi don yin/kha sngon ngas rnam rgyal la thengs 'gar slob grwar thengs shig phebs rogs zhes skad btang mod/ yin na'ang khyed rang phyag las brel ba che bas thengs gcig kyang phebs ma byung / rjes su ngas yang 'dzin grwa gcig pa'i slob phrug bstan 'dzin mngags kyang go ma chod rkyen de ring nga rang nyid yong ’’dge rgan bsam skyid lags kyi skad cha'i mjug ma rdzogs gong dbang rdor gyis hang sang sang ngang‘‘a tsi dge rgan lags/ nga la bus de'i skor gang yang bshad ma myong / ga re/ dge rgan lags/ khos las ka ngan pa 'dra las pa ma red dam zhes sngangs 'tshab kyis dris/der bsam skyid ya mtshan skyes te‘‘des na rnam rgyal gyis khyed la ci yang bshad ma myong ngam’’zhes dris par/ khos mgo bo 'phred du g.yug g.yug 'ga' byas nas‘‘ngo ma/ ci yang bshad ma myong’’zhes bshad de bsam blo ci zhig gtong bzhin‘‘gza' 'khor 'di'i gza' zla bar dge rgan lags kyis sbyong deb kyi rin pa sgor bcu khyer shog gsung gin 'dug ces sgor bcu khyer song / de ma gtogs gzhan ci yang bshad ma myong ’zhes bshad/56

de nas dge rgan bsam skyid de bas kyang hang sang nas dbang rdor gyi gdong la lta bzhin‘‘'o na da nangs rnam rgyal slob grwar song ngam’ zhes dris pas/khos kyang‘‘phyin song phyin song / nam rgyun nged gnyis mnyam du khyim nas sgor 'bud kyin yod’’ces bshad/dge rgan bsam skyid lags dgod tsam byas te‘‘khyed kyis rang gi bu slob grwar 'gro bzhin yod med dang nyin gang bor ci zhig byed kyin yod pa e shes’’zhes dris/ dbang rdor gyis dge rgan bsam skyid yong don dang don dag ga 'dra zhig byung ba tshang ma gsal bor rtogs nas ngo tsha ste/ skad mgo yang cung dma' mor btang nas‘‘dge rgan lags/ kho slob grwar yong gin med dam ’zhes dogs mi bde ba'i ngang nas dris pa na/ dge rgan bsam skyid kyis mthar shin tu zab pa'i ngang bya ba tshang ma ji ma ji bzhin du bshad de‘‘rnam rgyal 'phyi 'byor byed thengs re dang slob byol byed thengs rer nga tsho dge rgan gyis dris tshe/skabs rer sman khang du song ba dang skabs rer gcig pu gnyid la shor te dus tshod yol 'dug zer ba sogs ga dus yin na'ang rgyu mtshan mang bo 'dren rgyu yod pas/ nga tsho dge rgan rnams kyang ngu ma dgod du 'dug dgos pa zhig byed kyin yod/ khyed bu'i pha ma gnyis pos go chod pa byed dgos par 'dug na khyed kyis nges par du slob grwa la gzhogs 'degs byas te bu de'i kha lam log nas phyir bskor thabs byed dgos/ gal te nga tshos da lta nas dam 'dzin byed ma thub na phru gu lo chung chung yin pas ngan pa dgu tshang gi g.yang du lhung 57

nyen chen po 'dug ces bshad/skabs der dbang rdor gyi gdong ni dmar po khrag ltar gyur cing snying kha 'phar shugs che ru song ste dge rgan gyi skad cha'i mjug kyang gsal bo zhig ma thos/ skad cig gi dus tshod nang bu la khong khro dang / dge rgan la ngo tsha ba/rang nyid kyi byed stangs la 'gyod pa bcas dus gcig tu skyes na'ang bya thabs med pas khos lag gnyis 'phur tsam 'phur trem byed bzhin‘‘ngas rjes su do dam yag po byas te rgan lags kyis gsungs pa bzhin byed nges yin’’zhes pa tsam ma gtogs de las 'tsham pa'i lan zhig 'debs rgyu ma byung /bsam skyid kyis mu mthud du‘‘nga de ring yong don 'di 'dra zhig yin pas rjes su khyed kyis kyang dam 'dzin byas te lhod g.yengs su mi 'chor bar zhu/slob phrug gi slob gso ni dge rgan phyogs gcig pu'i slob gso dang lta skyong gis mi 'dang bar nges par du khyim tshang gi slob gso dang de bzhin spyi tshogs kyi slob gso'i gzhogs 'degs bcas dang kha 'bral mi rung ba ni cus krang khyed kyis nga las kyang gsal bo mkhyen pas de lugs dgongs 'jags gnang rogs ’zhes bshad rjes kho la gyes mtshams zhus nas song /dbang rdor la mtshon na da lta'i bar du rang las lo na phra ba dang lhag par du go gnas kyang rang las dma' ba'i bu mo zhig gis thad kar go rgyu can gyi skad cha de lta bu bshad ma myong la/ bu mo gzhon nu ma zhig gi mdun du nyams dma' ba'i ngang slob gso myong ba ni de bas kyang thengs dang po yin pas sems la shin tu mi skyid pa'i snang ba zhig skyes par ma zad/ rnam rgyal gyi bya spyod la 58

'dang re brgyab pas khong khro sngar bas je cher gyur/ gal te rnam rgyal da lta kho'i gam du yod na khos nyes rdung drag po zhig bya rgyur the tshom med/las khungs kyi sgo ra'i nang kho gcig pu las med pas dben thing nger gyur/ yud tsam 'gor rjes dbang 'dus sogs sbag rogs tshos sgug ma bzod par sge'u khung las myur du phyir phebs dang tshang mas khyod gcig pur bsgugs 'dug ces bos na'ang / da ni kho la mā cang rtse 'dod kyi snang ba spu tsam yang med par gom pa'i 'degs 'jog rang khyim du bsgyur/red ang / lo phyed tsam gyi sngon la kho rtsed mo la de lta bu'i zhen chags med pas nam rgyun bu dang mnyam du 'dug pa dang / nub mor bus sbyong tshan bris zin rjes khos sbyong tshan la zhib bsher yang byed/ gza' mjug la bslebs dus pha bu gnyis kyis glog rdul rol rtsed rtse ba dang sbyong tshan nyung dus rang nyid kyis bu la khyim sbyong yang skul gyin yod/ 'on kyang gnas tshul la 'gyur ldog chen po de lta bu byung ba ni dbang rdor rang nyid kyi bsam yul las yongs su 'das/ kho dbang 'dus kyi tshogs pa'i nang tshud pa nas bzung bu'i sbyong tshan la zhib bsher thengs gcig kyang byed ma myong la/ bus re ba ltar khor skyel bsu yang thengs gcig kyang byas ma myong / skabs rer kho'ang khyim bdag gzhan dang mnyam du khyim bdag tshogs 'dur song na'ang dge rgan gyi ngo mjal tsam las dge rgan gyi mdun la song ste bu'i slob sbyong dang sgrig lam skor gtan nas dris ma myong / lhag par du bar skabs shig nas bzung ha lam khyim bdag tshogs 'du yod pa'ang gtan nas ma shes par gyur/59

dbang rdor rang gi khyim du 'byor rjes tha mag gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis 'then bzhin 'das don dag yid la 'khor pa na 'gyod gdung drag po skyes nas skyo snang gi g.yang la lhung /sa rub nas khang ba'i nang nag thib ber 'dug na'ang / dbang rdor gyis da rung glog ma bkar par 'bol khrir bsdad de 'gul tsam yang mi byed par sngar bzhin tha mag 'then gyin 'dug bu rnam rgyal da rung phyir ma yong /ngo ma bshad na rnam kun kho rang khyim du 'byor pa ha cang 'phyi bas bu slob grwa nas ga dus phyir slebs kyin yod pa gtan nas mi shes/rgyu nor ni gtan 'jags kyi dngos po zhig ma yin par nyin re bzhin rdzogs 'gro bzhin yod pa dang / pha yis ba'ag pa'i rgyu nor de dag kyang rim bzhin nyung du 'gro ba'i snang tshul de yid la 'khor dus/ dbang rdor gyi snying khar bzod glags bral ba'i na zug drag po zhig byung zhing / rang dbang med par yar langs te a phas bzhag pa'i dngul 'dzin tshur blangs te bltas pa na mig dbang gi nus pa la the tshom za dgos pa zhig byung / a phas tshe gang bor dka' ba brgya phrag spyad de bsags pa'i dngul dag rang gi sha las chad pa'i bu gcig pu la bzhag ste 'tsho ba skyid po zhig yong thabs byas kyang da lta dngul 'dzin thog tu de snga'i bcu zur tsam las lhag med pas kho de bas sngangs 'tshab chen po zhig skyes/khos mu mthud de bsam blo gtong ma phod par dngul 'dzin phar bzhag ste/ slad phyin ji ltar bya dgos pa'i thad gdeng tshod gang yang ma rnyed pa'i 60

skabs der phyi nas sgo brdungs byung / dbang rdor ni gnyid las sad pa ji bzhin myur du yar langs nas sgo phye ba na rnam rgyal gyis ya mtshan ngang‘‘pā lags/ do nub snga mo phebs 'dug ces bshad pas/ dbang rdor gyis‘‘ga re/snga drags 'dug gam’’zhes kho'i brang kha nas 'jus te khang ba'i nang khrid/ ci yang shes med pa'i rnam rgyal gyis‘‘pā lags/ 'di 'dra ma gnang dang / ngas ga re byas song ngam’’zhes skad brgyab pa dang bden pa yod khul byas/ dbang rdor gyis tshul de mthong rjes de bas khong khro langs nas‘‘khyod khyod khyod nam rgyun slob grwar mi 'gro bar thal ba 'gam du phyin pa yin nam/ khyod da dung kha bde bo 'dug’ ces kho la 'gram lcag tsha drag po zhig gzhus na'ang /des da rung khog gi na zug ma sos pas nyes rdung drag thag chod pa zhig byas te rang nyid kyi khong khro 'jags thabs byas/ dbang rdor gyis da lta'i bar rnam rgyal la nyes rdung 'di 'dra zhig byas ma myong bas khos gzhus thengs rer snying khar na zug drag po skyes na'ang / rnam rgyal gyi spyod stangs la bsams kyin bsams kyin khong khro je cher gyur pas mu mthud du shugs kyis brdungs/rnam rgyal gyis sngon la‘‘sku mkhyen/ pā lags/ sang nyin nas bzung ngas pā lags kyi kha la nyan rgyu yin’ zhes zhu ba byas na'ang a phas da dung mtshams mi 'jog pas/ khos‘‘a ma lags spo bo lags/ mgyogs por phebs dang / a phas nga gsod 'dod red’’ ces ngu 'bod drag po byas/dbang rdor gyis rna la gzan pa'i skad de ma bzod par rdung mtshams mi 'jog ka med byung / 61

lhag pa mtsho mos kho pha bu gnyis bzhag ste song rjes/ dbang rdor gyis da nas bzung rang gi bu gcig pur 'tsho ba sogs phyogs gang thad nas gso skyong yag po byas te byis pa gzhan gyi man la lhung du mi 'jug snyam nas/ da lta'i bar du yang bskyar gyi bza' zla zhig kyang ma btsal par bsdad/ yin na'ang don dag tshang ma de ring gi gnas tshul 'di 'dra'i gnas su lhung bar gyur pa ni dbang rdor gyi rmi lam du'ang mis ma myong / yang phyir 'dang re brgyab tshe don dag de dag gi thog ma'i 'byung rkyen ni rang nyid kyis bzhag pa'i dam bca' rang gis gtor nas/ khom pa cung tsam yod tshe mā cang gi sho mig la sor mos gtsubs te zad du bcug cing / bu'i slob sbyong gi gnas tshul la do snang ma byas par lhod g.yengs su btang bas lan pa ma yin nam/de dag yid la dran pa na khong khro'ang rim bzhin 'jags par gyur nas bu la khag med brjod pa'i blo zhig shugs kyis skyes shing / mig zung bu'i phyogs su 'khor pa na bu rnam rgyal gyis dpe deb kyi kha phye ste lta khul byed kyang da dung ngu mtshams bzhag med la mchi ma slob deb kyi steng du lhung bzhin 'dugakhos de dag mthong 'phral sems skyo nas‘‘da ma ngu/ khyod nam rgyun slob grwar mi 'gro ba de 'dra dpe srid dmami’zhes pa tsam las gzhan bzang ngan ci yang ma bshad par thab tshang la song /bdun pa/dbang rdor ni bar skabs shig nas bzung rgyan po kho nar mgo 'khor 62

nas bu la lta skyong dang do khur byed ma thub pa ma gtogs rang gi bu la gting nas brtse dung med pa ga la yin/ kho rang nyid la mtshon na'ang da lta lo na sum cu yol zin pa'i dar ma zhig yin pas rang la bza' zla dang kho pha bu gnyis la za sdog 'thung chog bzo mkhan khyim bdag ma zhig mi sems pa ga la yin/don dngos su kho'i nye 'gram gyi gzhon nu ma la las kho ni pho nyams dod po zhig 'dug ces mig zur gyi skog mda' 'phen mkhan yod la/ rgyu rngam can gyi bud med la las kho la rtag tu 'tsho ba'i thad do khur byed pa dang bu'i ma g.yar byed 'dod yod pa'i rnam 'gyur ston mkhan yang yod/ de min da dung dga' nye spun mched tshos kyang kho'i mdun du khyim tshang ga ge mo zhig gi bu mo bzang lugs dang / las khungs ga ge mo zhig gi nang du kho la 'tsham pa'i bu mo zhig yod lugs kyi ngo sprod mang bo byas kyang / rnam rgyal yid la 'khor thengs rer bsam tshul de thams cad dor/drang mor bshad na de kho la ci khag lhag pa mtsho mo mi gzhan gyi rjes 'brangs nas song ba'i rjes kyi nyin zhig la kho rang gi de snga'i slob grogs bde skyid dang stes dbang gis thug cing / kho gnyis slob grwar zhugs 'dug pa'i gnas skabs su brtse dung gi sa bon phran bu zhig btab myong zhing / da lta slar yang 'phrad tshe gnyis kas 'das don brjed med la/ lhag par du bde skyid kyi las dbang yang kho dang phal cher 'dra ste/ mo la yang phru gu lo gnyis tsam la son pa zhig yod pa las bza' zla dang gyes te yun ring tsam 'gor 'dug kho gnyis kyi gnas bab 'dra la de snga'i brtse dung gi rmang gzhi yod pas/ phan 63

tshul 'brel gtug thengs 'ga' byas rjes 'tsho ba mnyam du skyel rgyur kha 'cham par gyur/dbang rdor gyis bde skyid ma bu gnyis khyim la khrid de rnam rgyal la da nas bzung nga tsho mnyam du 'tsho ba rol dgos pa dang khyim tshang gcig gi bza' mi yin tshul sogs bshad/ rnam rgyal gyis mig gnyis 'bur tshugs kyis bde skyid ma bu gnyis la bltas rjes tshig gcig kyang mi bshad par sgor song /byis pa gzhan dang mnyam du rtsed mo rtse skabs de tshos kho la bde skyid ni kho'i a ma gsar pa yin lugs dang bu mo de yang bskos pa'i gcung mo yin lugs bshad/ khos a ma gsar pa'i go don gsal bo zhig mi lon na'ang gang ltar don yag po zheg min pa shes/ lhag par du byis pa de tshos de ltar bshad pa thos rjes khong khro langs nas rtsed rogs dag rdo 'ded gtong bzhin‘‘ga re'i a ma gsar ba/ nga la a ma gsar ba med’’ces bshad rjes/ ha cang mi dga' ba'i ngang nas khyim du log pa na/ grung sha dod pa'i bu mo des kho'i rtsed chas tshang ma gang 'dod du bkrams te rtsed bzhin yod par ma zad/ kho'i a mas byin pa'i mngar cha khrog le sogs bcug pa'i lcags sgam chung ngu de yang bu mo de'i 'khris su bzhag nas nang gi mngar cha za bzhin yod pas/ kho khong khro chen po langs te rtsed chas dag sdud gsog brgyab cing / lcags sgam chung ngu de yang kha brgyab/ bu mo chung chung des gnas lugs gang yang mi shes pas kho'i lag nas phyir 'phrog rtsis byed skabs rnam rgyal gyis ngar ngar gyi sgo nas‘‘phar song / 'di tsho tshang ma nga'i red’’ces bu mo de'i mgo bor 'gyig gi sbag 64

sbag me mda' zhig yod pa des gzhus pas bu mo chung chung de ma thag ngu shor/bde skyid rang gi bu mo pang ste sgo ra'i nang song / dbang rdor gyis rnam rgyal la sdang mig bgrad bzhin mgor thal lcag tsha drag po zhig gzhus nas skad dma' mos‘‘che chung tsam yang med/ ga 'dra'i byis pa zhig red dam/ mgyogs por song nas bu mo la rnam 'gyur yag po ston cigari ces gshe gshe btang / bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la rnam rgyal gyis‘‘pā lags/ khyed la bde skyid dgos kyang nga la ma g.yar dgos don med/ nga mi 'gro zhes bshad rjes ngu bzhin thog khang du song / de lta na'ang kho gnyis kyi sems la rnam rgyal da lta da rung lo na phra bas gnas lugs ma rtogs pa red snyam nas do snang ma byas shing / kho gnyis kyi kha chad ltar bde skyid ma smad gnyis dbang rdor gyi khyim du spos/dbang rdor la mtshon na khyim tshang gsar ba'i 'tsho ba gsar ba ni bde skyid ldan pa zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang rnam rgyal gyi snang bar de snga kha khu sim la gtsang sbra dod pa'i khyim tshang de da cha skad cor dang ngu skad kyis khengs par ma zad/ mig gis mi bzod pa zhig yod pa ni za ma za skabs bu mo chung chung des bshang gci 'dor sa'ang mi shes par gang byung du dor pas/ khang ba'i nang du dri ngan gyis khengs pas khos ma bzod par phor ba 'khyer te za ma sgo ra'i nang du za bar 'gro dgos byung / de bas kyang mi bzod pa ni a ma gsar ba bslebs pa nas bzung sngar dang mi 'dra bar kho gcig pu khang ba chen po de'i nang du nyal dgos byung / a pha rang gi 'khris su med pas kho la bde 'jags kyi snang ba spu tsam yang med par gyur te/ lam sang gnyid kyang ma khugs par 65

sems la da lta'i ma g.yar de nga'i a ma ngo ma yin na ci ma rung / gal te a ma ngo ma yin na nga gcig pu khang ba chen po 'di 'dra zhig gi nang du 'jog mi srid snyam zhing / a pha dang bde skyid kyi 'khris su bde bar nyal 'dug pa'i bu bo chung chung de la phrag dog dang khong khro cig car du skyes/bde skyid ma smad gnyis de gar bslebs nas zla ba gcig tsam song ba'i nyin zhig la/ dbang rdor dang bde skyid phyi la don cig bsgrub par 'gro rtsis byed skabs tag tag bu mo chung chung de gnyid du yur 'dug pas/ rnam rgyal yang bu mo dang mnyam du khang ba'i nang du bcug ste/ 'gro khar bu mo gnyid las sad rjes gcin pa sgug dgos lugs bcol gdams yang yang byas par khos kyang kha nas khas blangs/ yin na'ang rnam rgyal gyi bsam pa la rang nyid kyi bde skyid dang spro snang tshang ma bu mo des phrogs pas de ring go skabs yag po 'di la brten nas 'khon lan zhig bslog dgos snyam/ khos bsam blo drug gsum bco brgyad btang mthar ha yang gi mthil gyi dud dreg brad de gnyid du yur ba'i bu mo chung chung de'i ngo la byugs/ yin na'ang dud dreg byug skabs bu mo gnyid sad byung bas a ma med pa shes nas skad mgo mthon pos ngus/dang thog rnam rgyal gyis ngu kha len thabs byas kyang bu mo'i ngu skad sngar las kyang che ru 'gro bzhin yod pas/ rnam rgyal khong khro langs thag chod nas‘‘ngus shig da khyod ngus shig ’ces kha nas de ltar bshad bzhin nyal chas bu mo de'i mgor g.yogs par ma zad shugs kyis mnan nas ngu skad thon mi thub par byas/ skabs der stabs legs pa zhig la dbang rdor dang bde skyid gnyis blo 66

ma bde bas khrom du yar 'khor mar 'khor ma byas par myur du log yong ba dang khel/ bde skyid kyis tshul de mthong 'phral rnam rgyal la phud rgyag cig byas nas mal chas 'og gi bu mo phyir blangs pa na/ bu mo phal cher dbugs kyang med pa'i tshad la bslebs 'dug pas/ sngangs skug chen po skyes te ngu skad 'chorabazhinadzid ci zhig byed dgos/ da ci zhig bya dgos zhes 'ur brgyab/dbang rdor yang 'tshub cha langs nas re zhig la ci byed 'di byed med par gyur/de nas glo bur du sman khang du 'gro rgyu dran nas bu mo myur du sman khang du bskyal/dus thog tu sman khang la song bas bu mo'i srog la nyen kha ma byung /rnam rgyal la mtshon na don dag de 'dra tshabs chen zhig tu gyur 'gro ba gang nas shes/ dbang rdor sman khang nas phyir yong rjes rnam rgyal la gshe gshe drag po btang ste ha lam brdung grabs byas kyang rnam rgyal gyis rang nyid la gnongs yod pa shes pas tshig gcig kyang bshad ma phod/ skabs der bde skyid tshur yong nas dbang rdor la‘‘da ni phru gur gshe gshe btang yang phan pa med/ ngas bsam blo ji ltar btang na'ang rnam rgyal la khag med/ nged gnyis bar gyi brtse dung ci 'dra zab pa nged gnyis rang gis gsal bor shes/ yin na'ang ngas rnam rgyal dang ji ltar nye 'dris byas nas ma bu'i 'du shes 'jog ci thub byas kyang rnam rgyal nga'i bu mo dang mi 'dra bar lo na cher son yod pas kho'i sems pa bsgyur dka'/ de slad nged gnyis mnyam du 'dug pa nor 'khrul zhig yin pas snga mo nas kha kha so so byas te bsdad na legs bsams/'on kyang de ni nga khyed la brtse dung med pa ma yin pas khyed kyis kyang dgongs 67

bzhes thub pa gnang rogs ’zhes bshad/dbang rdor la re zhig ci yang bshad rgyu ma rnyed par had de bsdad/ de nas‘‘ngas bltas na don dag ni de 'dra'i tshabs chen zhig gi tshad la bslebs med pas/ khyod kyis kyad lam sang de ltar ma shod/ nged gnyis kyis rnam rgyal la gnas lugs dang rgyu mtshan bshad na kho la'ang bsam shes rgyu los yod’’ces bshad/de nas bzung dbang rdor gyis rgyun du rnam rgyal la bde skyid dang kho gnyis kyi 'brel ba dang / pha bu gnyis las med pa'i khyim tshang 'di la bde skyid ji ltar mkho lugs bshad na'ang rnam rgyal ni bde skyid la mi dga' bar ma zad/ bde skyid kyi bu mo chung chung de la de bas kyang mi dga'/ gang ltar nga la dgos pa med ces khas gtan nas ma blangs pas/ khyim tshang de ni slar yang dbang rdor pha bu gnyis kyi 'jig rten chung chung zhig tu gyur/bde skyid dang kha bral rjes dbang rdor slar yang rang gi grogs po dang mnyam du mthun pa spun bzhi bsgrigs te phan tshun lus kyi spu 'thog res kyi las la zhugs pa dang / dus tshod ci tsam ring na de tsam gyis tshabs che ru song bas/de yang gang zhig gser gyi ri la gnas bcas na/ / de yis 'dab chags thams cad gser du 'gyur/ / gang zhig dug gi ri la gnas bcas na/ / de yis 'dab chags thams cad dug tu 'gyur/ / zhes pa'i dpe ltar kho yang rgyan po'i las la ci tsam zhugs pa de tsam gyis mun pa'i dbyings su zhugs te bu la lta rtog bya rgyu ma byung bas da lta'i gnas 'di 'drar lhung ba red/68

brgyad pa/ dbang rdor gyis thab tshang nas za ma bzo bzhin lo 'di ga'i ring gi bya ba tshang ma phyir dran re byas tshe tshang ma rang nyid kyis lan 'dug pa'i tshor shes zab mo zhig byung / khos za ma bzos tshar rjes rnam rgyal bos nas pha bu gnyis kyis mnyam du bro ba ldan pa'i dgong zas shig bzas/ dus yun ring bo zhig la pā lags dang mnyam du za ma lhod lhod byas te bzas pa ha cang nyung ba dang lhag par du dgong zas za ba ni de bas dkon pas/ rnam rgyal gyis za zhor du‘‘pā lags kyis bzos pa'i za ma zhim po 'duga'adi 'dra nam rgyun za rgyu yod na skyid pa la angami’zhes pa'i tshig rang bzhin du thal pas dbang rdor gyi sems la ljid tig tig gi snang ba zhig skyes te‘‘gal te khyod kyis a phar khong khro ma bslangs par slob grwar yag po byas te song na za ma bzo rgyu ni las ka sla mo zhig red ces bshad/rnam rgyal gyis‘‘gal te pā lags kyang thugs brel chen po de 'dra med pa dang / de sngon ltar nga'i 'khris su bzhugs na nga 'khyam ga la phod’’ces bshad/dbang rdor gyis bu la smra mi phod pa'i 'gyod pa yod na'ang bu'i skad cha der lan ci yang ma btab par kha rog ger bsdad/yud tsam song rjes dbang rdor gyis rnam rgyal gyi mgo la byil byil byed bzhin byams brtse ldan pa'i ngang nas‘‘da nas bzung nga la'ang brel ba med pas/ khyod kyis kyang snga ma'i byed stangs bsgyur te slob sbyong yag po byos’ zhes brjod/69

mtshan mo der kho gnyis ma gros gcig mthun gyis mnyam du nyal cing /rnam rgyal nyal chas nang 'dzul na'ang dbang rdor tsog pur tha mag rkang gcig la me sbar nas 'then bzhin slar yang de ring gi gnas tshul thams cad la bsam blo gtong ba dang / sngar gyi 'das don la bskyar du bsam gzhigs byed bzhin sems gtam mang po zhig bshad 'dod skyes/ 'on kyang rang gi 'khris su lo na phra ba'i bu rnam rgyal las med pas snying gtam mang bo zhig tha mag gi du ba dang mnyam du khog pa'i nang khyur mid byas/ yin na'ang skad cha kha cig bu la ma bshad na blo mi bde ba'i snang ba yod pas da dung gnyid la ma shor par pa pha'i lag pa ya gcig nas dam por bzung yod pa'i bu la‘‘rnam rgyal/ khyod kyis bltas na pa pha ni yag po zhig red dam sdug cag cig red ces dris/rnam rgyal gyis bsam blo gang yang ma btang bar‘‘pha ni rang gi pha de yag po los yin zhes brjod/dbang rdor gyis ci yang mi bshad par yud tsam bsdad nas‘‘spyir khyod kyi a pha ni yag po zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang bar skabs shig nas bzung sdug cag cig tu gyur pas khyod kyang slob byol byed mkhan zhig tu gyur pa red/ da ni nged gnyis da rung 'di ltar bsdad na mi 'grig pas/ sang nyin nged gnyis gtsug lag khang du jo bo rin po che'i sku mdun du da nas bzung pa pha yag po zhig bya rgyu dang slob phrug yag po zhig bya rgyu'i dam bca' 'jog par 'gro rizhes bshad/ rnam rgyal la mtshon na mna' yi don gsal bo zhig mi rtogs na'ang /da nas bzung pa phar khong khro ma bslangs par phru gu yag po zhig byed 'dod 70

yod pas de ltar bya rgyur kha 'cham/chang 'thungs nas chag sgo mang bo bzo mkhan dang / mā cang brgyab nas khyim gzhis stong la nye ba bzo mkhan/ de bzhin tha mag 'then mkhan bcas mi mang bo zhig khyim mi dang bza' zla'i re ba nan po'i 'og jo bo rin po che'i sku mdun du mna' skyel dam bca' 'jog par slebs kyin yod na'ang / dus yun ring bo mi 'gor bar chang 'thung mkhan tshos sngar bzhin chang 'thung ba dang / mā cang rgyag mkhan tshos sngar bzhin mā cang rgyag pa/ tha mag 'then mkhan tshos sngar bzhin tha mag 'then par ma zad/ tha na mi mang po zhig gis chang sngar las mang bo 'thung ba dang rgyan sngar las che ba/ tha mag 'then 'dod de bas che ru 'gro bzhin yod cing / kha shas kyis bshad na mna' zla ba kha shas las bskyal med ces pa dang / yang la las zer na khyim mis btsan shed kyis bskyal du bcug pa las rang mos kyis bskyal 'dod med pas/ de mna' bzas par mi brtsi zhes dag 'bud byed kyin yod pas/ yang snying ci 'dra yin pa ni jo bo rin po che yis mkhyen pa dang mi de rang nyid kyis ma gtogs sus shes/ 'on kyang da res dbang rdor pha bu gnyis kyis bskyal pa'i mna'ani rang mos yin pa las btsan shed dang u tshugs byed mkhan su yang med pas/ jo bo rin po che'i sku mdun du mna' tshig gang 'dra zhig bor yod dam/ /1996lo'i zla2par ma zin btab/1997lo'i dbyar khar bzo bcos kyis gtan la phab/71

las dbang /de ring phyi dro nga rang slob grwa'i dge rgan dang las bzo pa'i tshogs chen du zhugs pa yin/ 'di ni nga rang thengs dang por slob grwa'i byed sgor zhugs pa yin la spyi tshogs kyi gar stegs steng du spos pa'i gom pa dang po yang yin/ nga rang slob grwa'i tshogs khang du song ba na der mi nyi shu lhag 'dus shing kho tsho'i 'dren byed kyi mda' mo dus mnyam du nga'i phyogs su 'phangs byung bas nga rang rgyus mnga' med pa'i mi dag gi mdun nas 'tsher snang skyes shing ngo gdoḥng tsha lam lam du gyur te tshogs khang gi 'gram zur zhig tu bsdad pa yin/ tshogs 'dur yong ba'i dge rgan dang las bzo pa de dag las kha shas mgo bo rub rub kyis shub bur smra bzhin nga rang la blta ba'i nyams las kho tshos phal cher nga'i gnas tshul la lab gleng byed bzhin yod pa rtogs thub/ kho tshos 'di ltar byed pa la yang ngo mtshar rgyu med de/ lta rgya dang mthong rgya med pa'i ri khug 'dir mtshon na/ mi rgyus med cig gsar du slebs tshe gtam gleng sna tshogs byed pa ni yul 'di'i rgyun lugs ltar gyur 'dug pas so/ / nga rang ni slob grwa chen mo nas thon ma thag yin la/ lus la gyon pa yang da lta grong khyer che khag tu dar so che ba sha stag yin pas nga'i skor la dpyad gleng byed pa yang lugs dang mthun pa zhig yin/72

ngas tshogs khang gi gral mgor 'dzum dmul ler bzhugs pa'i gdong cung rid pa'i slob spyi de ngo shes pa las/ gzhan rnams gcig kyang ngo mi shes pas ngas kho tsho'i mig zhags la g.yol thabs byas shing mgo bo sgur nas tshogs 'du'i mgo rtsom rgyur re sgug byas/ de nas tshogs 'du'i mgo tshugs shing slob spyis gtam bshad par brten nga rang ci bya gtol bral gyi gnas bab las gzhi nas bcings 'grol thob cing / da gzod dbugs ring zhig phyung ste g.yas g.yon gyi ma 'ongs pa'i las grogs rnams la mig nyul byed pa'i go skabs thob/slob spyis thog mar nga'i gnas tshul rags rim tsam ngo sprod mdzad rjes gong rim nas slob grwa chen mo las thon pa zhig rang slob tu mngags yong ba ni slob grwa'i gzi brjid yin lugs sogs mang po gsungs song / slob grwa de ni‘‘cha tshang ba'i ’slob 'bring zhig ste/ rdzong khag gsum gyi slob ma yong gi yod cing dge rgan gyi stobs shugs kyang cung zhan stabs slob grwa chen mo las thon pa zhig dge rgan du mngags yong ba ni ha las dgos pa zhig ma yin par rta dang ran pa'i sga zhig bstad pa red zer yang mi 'grig pa med/slob grwa'i 'go khrid kyis slob dus gsar ba'i las 'gan dang slob tshan 'khrid mkhan sogs bkod sgrig byed skabs/ bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la nga rang la 'dzin grwa gsar pa zhig gi bod yig dang 'dzin grwa gzhan zhig gi tsis rig slob khrid bkod sgrig byas 'dug pas nga rang ha las par gyur/ nga'i ched las bod kyi skad yig yin pa 'go khrid kyis brjed pa ma yin nam snyam nas khong la gsal 'debs shig byas kyang khong gis nga la lag brda byed bzhin 73

bshad mtshams bcad de sngar bzhin 'dzum dmul ler‘‘da lta nga tsho'i slob grwar dge rgan nyung bas ched las la nges pa mi 'dug dge rgan tshos gang du dgos mkho yod na de gar 'khrid dgos/ da ni thag bcad pa ltar gyis’mizer/nga rang rtsis rig dang 'brel ba chad de lo bzhi tsam 'gor zhing slob 'bring du yod skabs kyang rtsis rig gi sbyangs 'bras yag po zhig thob ma myong pas de ring slob 'bring rtsis rig dge rgan gyi las 'gan lci mo de rang gi phrag tu lhung skabs nga rang ci bya gtol bral du gyur te slob spyi la rgya yig dang / lo rgyus/ chab srid sogs gang zhig khrid dgos kyang chog mod/ tsis rig ni ngas mi shes pas 'khrid mi thub’’ces zhu ba nan cher phul ba na/ slob spyis‘‘da 'o na las 'gan de su la sprod dgos sam ’zhes zer bzhin thabs zad pa'i nyams kyis nga la cer 'dugadus tshod skar ma kha shas kyi ring la mi gcig kyang kha ma grags pas tshogs ra yongs su grag 'gul tsam yang med par dal cag ger gyur cing / skabs der nga'i sems la'ang nongs 'gyod chen po skyes nas ngas rtsis rig yag po zhig ma shes pa ci yin nam snyam zhing dbugs kyang 'byin dka' ba lta bu'i snang ba skyes/ skabs der mi zhig gis‘‘ngas kyang rtsis rig ched du bslabs ma myong yang rang sbyong byas te da lta phran tsam shes kyi yod pas gal te yid ches yod na nged gnyis kyi slob tshan brjes na 'grig gi ma red dam’’ces bshad pa na tshang ma'i do snang gi 'dren byed dang mnyam du ngas kyang phyogs der bltas tshe da lta skad cha bshad mkhan de kho red 'dug 74

nyin 'ga'i sngon la nga thog mar 'di gar 'byor skabs nged gnyis rlangs 'khor gcig tu bsdad nas yong zhing / khong gis nga'i dngos po sogs rlangs 'khor las len rogs byas pa'i dge rgan bstan phun ma yin nam snyam bzhin mgo sgur te slob spyis lan ga 'dra zhig 'debs par bsgugs pa yin/slob spyis khong gi skad char thad kar lan ma btab par nyob mdangs dang bcas nga tshor lta bzhin yod pa las don der do snang de tsam byed kyi med pa ltar mngon/ dge rgan gzhan rnams kyis bzang ngan ci yang ma bshad pas mjug mthar slob spyis‘‘gnas skabs su nga tshos de ltar bya rgyu las 'os mi 'dug’ ces tshig thag bcad nas gsungs/nga tsho'i 'dzin grwa'i slob grogs rnams kyis dga' spro'i ngang nas slob grwa chen mo'i mtha' mjug gi dus tshod de skyel skabs dge rgan gyis‘‘mi 'gyangs par khyod tsho spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos kyi khrod du zhugs dgos pas/ mngar skyur ska gsum gyi 'tsho ba'i bro ba ci yang myong srid na da lta nas bzung yid ches dang re smon de 'dra chen po bya mi rung la yid thang chad pa dang re med spobs med ni de bas kyang bya mi rung ’zhes gsungs myong yang nga rang la mtshon na rang gi mdun lam la yid ches dang snying stobs kyis khengs yod/ yin na yang da res las ka'i mgo tshugs ma thag gdong pags bshus pa'i gnas tshul 'di 'dra zhig dang thug pas nga rang sems ha cang pham byung / yang sgos su bstan phun zhes pa des rang 'gul gyis nga'i las 'gan khas blangs kyang slob spyis rnam 'gyur de 'dra ston dgos don ga re yin nam snyan bzhin yid blong blong 75

por gyur cing dri ba mang po zhig mig lam du shar/ 'di ltar sems skyid po rang ma byung bas nyin rgyun rang shag tu 'dzul te sdod pa las gang du'ang 'gro 'dod mi 'dugang la sprad pa'i 'dzin grwa de'i slob ma mang che ba ni rdzong gi las bzo'i bu phrug yin zhing / 'dzin grwa de gleng dus dge rgan zhig yin tshe gis mgo bo 'phred du g.yug par ma zad/ ngas gsar du ngo shes pa'i bu mo dge rgan zhig gisu 'dzin grwa de'i‘‘mdzad rjes midag gleng zhing bud med dge rgan zhig yin tshe slob ma tshos ngu ru bcug pa'i gnas tshul rnams thos skabs 'jigs sngangs dang sems khral gyis gnyid kyang mi khugs par gyur/ 'on kyang blo yul las 'das pa zhig la nga rang thengs dang por slob khrid du song skabs slob ma chos rig pa bsgrims te slob khrid la nyan pa dang nan tan gyis zin bris 'god bzhin 'dug pas nga rang dga' spro dpag tu med pa skyes shing nga'i sngar gyi spobs pa'i khrag rgyun de slar yang lus yongs la rgyu ba ltar gyur/ngas slob tshan dang po de bde blag tu khrid rjes sems lhod shig shig gi ngang nas slob dpyod khang du 'dzul skabs de gar dge rgan kha shas yod pa dang kho tshos nga la 'dzum tsam re byed pa las ci yang mi bshad/ nga'i yig cog gi kha sprod du yod pa'i dge rgan bstan phun gyis dpe deb cig la lta bzhin yod pas nga rang 'dug stegs su bsdad rjes gzhi nas 'dzum dang bcas mgo bo lcog tsam byas/ngas rgyun du bstan phun gyi gdong gi skyo nyams de mthong ba na dbang med 76

du thengs de'i tshogs 'du'i steng gi gnas tshul rnams dran zhing de ma thag kho la 'tsher snang zhig kyang skyes te/ khong dang phan tshun lab gleng byed mi phod par gyur/ kho'i gnas tshul ci yang mi shes pas dge rgan de dag gi bzhin ras la rgyun du slob khrid skabs kyi gzab nan dang sgam po'i tshul mngon 'dug pa las kho tsho'i lus steng du 'dris bde gshib bde dang gson shugs dang spro snang gi nyams 'gyur ha lam mthong rgyu mi 'dug pas da lta spro snang gi yul khams te/slob grwa chen mo dang bral ma thag pa'i nga rang la mtshon na gu dog cing dbugs kyang rngub dka' ba'i snang ba zhig byin/de nas nyin mang po 'gor rjes rim bzhin nga rang dge rgan bstan phun dang 'dris shing nged gnyis la‘‘thun mong gi skad cha’’yod par gyur/ khong gi lo tshod nga las cung che zhing khong la bod kyi lo rgyus dang / skad yig rtsom rig sogs kyi skor bshad rgyu mang po yod pa ma zad gzhan rgyal khab phyi nang gi shes bya'i skor la yang mang po zhig bshad rgyu yod pa red/ khong gi skad gdangs las khong gi skyes yul ni rdzong 'di rang yin pa shes thub mod/ 'on kyang khong slob grwa gang nas thon min shes ma byung la de'i skor gzhan gyis kyang bshad ma myong bas thengs shig ngas khong la4khyed rang slob grwa gang nas thon pa yin’’zhes dris par/ bstan phun gyis skad cha de go ma thag bzhin mdog cung log ste‘‘mi tshang ma'i rlung rta dang bsod nams gcig mtshungs gang nas yong thub/ kho bo ni slob grwa gang yang 'grims ma myong7zhes pa tsam las lan gsal bo zhig btab ma byung / khong gi nyams 'gyur la bltas na skad cha des khong gi sems 77

la phog thug chen po zhig btang ba ltar snang bas nga rang zhe gting nas 'gyod byung /nyin de nas bzung nged gnyis kyi bar du skad cha je nyung du song zhing 'brel thag je ring du gyur/ spyir nga rang mtshan mo nyal 'phyi mod/ yin na'ang dus nam yin yang nga rang nyal ba'i skabs su dge rgan bstan phun gyi sge'u khung las sngar bzhin sgron me'i 'od mthong thub la/ skabs 'gar zas za dus dang ngal gso'i dus su'ang khong gis rtsis rig slob gzhi khyer nas rtsis rig la cung mkhas pa'i dge rgan gi sar song ste dka' gnad bka' 'dri zhu bzhin pa sogs mthong skabs nga'i sems nas khong la ci zhig chad yod pa ltar nongs 'gyod re skyes na'ang khong la kha yag tshig bzang gcig kyang bshad ma shes pas/ sems gting nas khong la dgongs dag thugs bden snyam pa'i 'dod blo zhig rtag tu shar/dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'gros dang bstun nas nga rang dge rgan gzhan rnams dang 'dris shing rang nyid kher rkyang gi snang ba de'ang je chung du song /yin na yang nga dang dge rgan bstan phun gyi 'brel ba de je ring du 'gro bzhin yod pas nga'i sems mi bde bar gyur/ khong dang 'brel ba je dam du gtong ched/ ngas bod yig skor gyi dka' gnad mang po zhig btsal te khong gi sar 'dri bar song skabs/ khong gis snang dag de 'dra rang mi byed par nga'i dri bar lan stabs bde re 'debs pa las gzhan ci yang bshad rgyu med pas tho rang slar yang sems mi bde ba zhig byung / 78

nyin zhig nga rang khong gi nyal khang du 〈dag yig ngag sgron 〉las dka' gnad cig 'dri bar 'gro dus khong mal khang du med kyang sgo lcags brgyab mi 'dug pas thag ring du song med par snyam nas nang du song nas bsgugs pa yin/ nyal khang nang du mig myul byed skabs yig cog dang nyal khri'i steng du dpe cha dang zin bris deb kha phye ste bzhag 'dug pas grong khyer nas slebs ma thag pa'i nga'i nyal khang dang bsdur tshe dngos gnas go rim ci yang med pa zhig red/ kho'i yig cog steng gi gyang 'gram dang / nyal khri'i zur/ sge'u khung steng bcas su mtshan nyid rig pa dang / lo rgyus/ skad yig rtsom rigartsis rig sogs bod rgya yig rigs kyi dpe deb mang pos khengs 'dug pas nga rang ha las par gyur/ khong gi nyal khri'i sngas mgo'i thod kyi gyang ldebs su thon mi sam bho ṭa'i bris sku zhig bkal yod cing de'i gsham du thon mi la bstod pa'i snyan tshig sho lo ka zhig kyang bris 'dug yang gyang ngos gzhan zhig tu‘‘shes brtson thos pa can gyi nyam chung gi kha stabs/ / blun po nor rkyal 'khur ba'i dbang shed kyis bcom ste/ /chos mthun bkur sti'i bzhugs gral go log tu bsdebs nas/ /seng gi khyi yi g.yog tu gyur tshul 'di skyo ba/ / zhes pa'i dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi snyan tshig sho lo ka gcig tshugs yig legs pos bshus te sbyar 'dugangs de dag la bltas nas re zhig 'gor yang khong da dung ma yong pas yig cog steng nas deb cig blangs te lta bzhin du bsgugs/ yud tsam 'gor rjes khong dpe deb cig khyer nas yong ba dang nga mthong 'phraladzi.a tsi/ dge rgan zla 79

sgron lags/ sgug yun ring po ma byung ngam/ sku don yod dam/ zhes 'tshab 'tshub kyi ngang nas lag gi dpe deb phar bzhag cing 'tsher snang dang bcas nyal khri'i steng du bkram yod pa'i dpe deb rnams bsdu gsog brgyab rjes nga la ja ldug rtsis byed bzhin 'dug kyang ngas mtha' gcig tu min zhes bshad rjes dka' gnad de khong la dris pas gzhi nas khong gi rnam 'ugyur de rgyun ldan ltar gyur cing nga'i dri bar lan btab/ khong gi 'grel bshad de dag la nyan skabs de 'dra'i go bde ba dang shes sla ba zhig 'dug pas/ slar yang khong gi bshes gnyen dang slob grwa'i skor shes 'dod chen po byung na'ang de sngar khong gis lan ma btab pa de dran pas 'dri ma phod par phyir mid pa yin/ rjes su khong gi slob tshan thengs 'ga' nyan par song / khong gi slob khrid ni de 'dra'i kha gsal zhing go bde rīb dang slob tshan tshogs rim bzhin thog ma'i skar ma bcu re be+ed spyad de slob ma tshor tshogs thengs gong mar khrid zin pa dag shes yod min ngag rgyugs len pa dang / slob tshan gsar pa khrid skabs dpe don 'jug pa dang gson nyams ha cang dod pas slob ma tshos kyang‘‘rgan bstan phun lags’’zhes gus bkur byed pa la'ang rgyu mtshan chen po 'dug dge rgan zhig la don dngosakyi yon tshad gang 'dra yod min ni des bshad pa rnams slob ma rnams kyis dang len byed thub min dang slob phrug tsho'i shes tshad dang gdeng 'jog las rtogs thub pas/ khong gi de snga'i 'dzin grwa'i slob ma de dag da lta nga'i slob khrid la blo kha khengs kyi yod bzo ma mchis/phyi dro slar yang tshogs 'du zhig tshogs rgyu yin pas nyin gung slob spyis nga 80

la brda brgyab pa dang chabs cig bstan phun la‘‘khyod la don bya yod tshe ma yong na'ang chog ’ces bshad pas bstan phun gyis kyang‘‘nga la slob tshan gra sgrig dang sbyong tshan 'bri rgyu mang po zhig yod’’ces lan btab mod don dngos su kho'i sems la kho rang tshogs 'dur zhugs mi chog pa ga re yin nam snyam yod nges red/tshogs 'du'i steng du dge rgan gyi go ming thob thang sprod thabs skor gyi 'brel yod yig cha slob sbyong byas shing slob grwa'i 'gan 'khur bas yig cha klog bzhin du 'grel bshad mang po zhig byas/ yin na yang nga'i sems la bstan phun tshogs 'du 'dir zhugs mi rung ba ci yin nam snyam zhing chu tshad 'di ltar mtho zhing slob mas 'di ltar dga' bsu byed pa'i dge rgan zhig la go ming thob thang sprod mi rung ba ci yin sogs don mang po zhig sems la 'khor zin na'ang tshogs 'du grol rjes dge rgan gzhan rnams ni rang nyid la go ming rim pa gang 'dra zhig thob par tshod dpag dang gleng mol byed bzhin phyir song mod/ nga'i sems la bstan phun gyi don de kho na 'khor zhing don de'i mthil rtogs par 'dod pas lag tu dpe deb cig yod pa der blta khul gyis mjug tu bsdad pa yin/ slob spyis‘ zla sgron lags’’zhes gsungs pas ngas mgo bo btegs nas‘‘a tsi’’zhes mi gzhan dag song tshar ba ma shes khul byas pa dang de nas rang shag tu log bzhin‘‘slob spyi lags/ dge rgan bstan phun go ming thob thang sprod pa'i tshogs 'dur mi zhugs pa ci yin zhes kha nas thal/ ‘‘khong dmangs btsugs slob grwa'i dge rgan nas 'di gar yar 'then byas pa zhig yin/ slob 81

khrid kyi yun tshad dang cha rkyen mi 'dang bas yig cha'i dgongs don dang mi mthun zhes lan btab/de nas bzung ngas khong gi don la sngar bas kyang yid 'jog byas shing kho'i sems kyi gsang ba de shes 'dod chen po byung mod/ khong gis nga la sngar bzhin g.yol gang thub dang skad cha nyung ngu tsam las mi bshad pas thabs gang yang ma byung /sa 'di grang ngar ha cang che la dgun tshugs ma thag grang ngar gyis rus rkang la zug gzer gtong bas slob khrid med dus nyal khang du log par 'dod kyang slob grwa'i sgrig lam ltar na las byol gyi gras su brtsi bas slob dpyod khang mi srung ka med red/ stabs legs pa zhig la slob dpyod khang du lcags thab yod cing bud shing dang lci ba yang mang po yod pas slob khrid kyi res skor ltar dge rgan gnyis gsum re lhag yod pa dang de dag gis me dron po bus yod par ma zad chu khol yang bskol yod pas slob khrid la song ba'i dge rgan rnams phyir yong na lag pa bsro chog la chu khol 'thung rgyu'ang yod/sems kyi rnam rtog yin na'ang 'dra/ yang na don dngos yin na'ang 'dra/ gang ltar nga la slob khrid med dus dge rgan bstan phun la'ang slob khrid med pas dus tshod kyis kyang nga tshor ku re rtsed gin yod pa dang 'dra/ nged gnyis gcig pu slob dpyod khang du lus skabs khos dpe cha kho nar blta ba yin pas ngas khong la chu khol ldug skabs khos mgo bo yar dgye ste 'dzum dang bcas‘‘thugs rje che zer ba las tshig gcig tsam yang mi bshad pas ngas kha brda 82

'dra byed 'dod kyang bshad ya med pas kha rog mi sdod ka med red/ slob dpyod khang der nga gcig pu ma gtogs bu mo zhig med pa dang rgan dar rgyas lags phud mang che ba na gzhon sha stag yin pa dang phan tshun lab gleng byed pa'ang ha cang nyung / de'i rkyen gyis dus rgyun du nga'i sems la gal te bu mo rogs pa 'ga' yod na ci ma rung snyam/nyin zhig nga chu len du 'gro skabs nga'i sngon du slob ma'i ma byan bu mo de gnyis lab gleng byed bzhin 'gro gin 'dug6‘deng sang yin na 'khrug pa'i sgang red’ 4su dang su 'khrug gi 'dug gam mi‘‘rgan zla sgron lags dang rgan bstan phun lags gnyis deng skabs tsha ba ri thang mtshams su slebs 'dugami’ lke‘‘de ga rang red/ ngas bltas kyang kho gnyis kyi byed stangs mtshar po zhig 'dug lhag par du rgan zla sgron rgyun du rgan bstan phun gyi sar 'gro ba dang phyi ngos nas kho gnyis dpe cha phar g.yor tshur g.yor byed kyang don dngos su ci zhig bshad kyin yod pa sus shes’’ngas gom pa je mgyogs su btang nas khong gnyis kyi rjesga zin rjes‘‘de 'dra red dam’’zhes dris pas kho tshos phan tshun lkog lta re byas shing lce bsnar re byas te bros song / skabs der nga khong khro langs te don 'di slob grwa'i 'go khrid la yar zhu byed 'dod na yang mno bsam zhig btang na kho mo gnyis ka slob grwar 'grims ma myong ba'i zhing grong gi bu mo gnyis yin pas 'khang ra byed 83

dgos don med snyam byung / yin na yang ma byan gnyis kyi skad cha las rgan bstan phun gyis nga la g.yol dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang shes song / de nas bzung nga'i sems nas khong la dang ba zhig ngang ngam shugs kyis skyes kyang /rgyu mtshan ci yin rang gis kyang bshad dka'/nyin de'i phyi dro sgo srung bgres pos tshags par dang yi ge kha shas slob dpyodakhang du bskyal yong ba dang de dag gi khrod du nga'i yi ge zhig kyang 'dugangs de'i yig thum las nga'i dga' grogs kyis bskur ba yin pa lam sang shes byung / nga dga' spro dang sems 'gul tshad med skyed pas lam sang yig thum kha 'byed skabs lag pa cung 'dar bzhin 'dug cing / yi ge phyir bton nas lteb brtsegs bshigs dus de'i nang las 'dra par zhig sar lhung song / thog mar mi rnams kyis nga la do snang de 'dra byed kyi med kyang par de lhung 'phral tshang mas dus gcig tu 'dra par lta bzhin yod pas kho tsho tshang mas phal cher 'dra par de dang nga la do snang dang4thugs khur7byed bzhin yod pa 'dra/de'i rkyen gyis ngas 'dra par de yar blangs te ched du kho tshor ston bzhin‘‘khong nga'i dga' rogs red’ ces bshad pas tshang mas 'tshang kha shig shig gis lta ba dang mang po zhig gi gdong las ya mtshan dang yid mi ches pa'i nyams shig mngon/de nas rgya rigs dge rgan zhig gis ‘ngas sngar nas khyer tshor bshad ma byung ngam/ slob grwa nas thon te yong mkhan la re ba byed pa ni 'ja' tshon gos su re ba'i glen pa red/ kho tsho cha 'grig min na gan rgya bzhag zin pa'i mi 84

redamimices bshad pas tshang ma gad mo shor/slob tshugs kyi dril brda btang 'phral slob khrid yod pa'i dge rgan rnams brel 'tshub kyis slob khrid yo byad khyer te slob khang du song zhing slob dpyod khang du nga dang rgan dar rgyas lags kho na las mi 'dug gnam 'thibs shing grang ngar ha cang che bas ngas lcags thab la bud shing bsnan pa dang lcags thab kyi mdun du dpe char lta bzhin bsdad/ dge rgan dar rgyas lags kyis‘‘'o/ ngas kyang zla sgron lags la slob sbyong zhu dgos pa 'dug’mices rkub stegs khyer nas lcags thab kyi 'khris su bsdad/ me'i tsha drod kyis nged gnyis kyi lus yongs dros par ma zad kha yang dros pas rgan dar rgyas lags kyis lag gi dpe cha de yig cog steng du 'jog bzhinadzizla sgron lags/ da ci'i 'dra par de ngo ma khyod kyi dga' rogs kyi par red dam zhes the tshom gyis nga la lta bzhin dris byung / khong gi rnam 'gyur las nga la ya mtshan chen po skyes na'ang ngas‘‘ngo ma yin/ slob grwa thon khar nga gnyis dga' po byas kyang phan tshunakha ma 'chams pas da lta'i 'bras bu 'di byung ba red ces khong la lan srong por btab pa dang sbrags rang nyid kyi sems sdug yang brjod pa yin/khong gis phangs sems chen pos‘‘nyin shas sngon la nga'i rna lam du khyed dang bstan phun 'brel ba yag po yod lugs thos byung bas nga dngos gnas dga' zhing khyed gnyis snga tsam 'grig na snyam pa'i re ba chen po byas mod/ yin na'ang nga'i smon sems de ni 'ja' tshon gos su re ba'i dper gyur pa red/ngas rang gi na gzhon las grogs 'di dag la sems 'khur chen po byed kyi yod/85

kho tsho kha shas la dga' rogs re yod na'ang sa cha 'di'i gnas tshul shes rjes bu mo de tshos kha sna tshogs g.yar te brtse sems kyi 'brel thag gcod kyi yod pa redami’zer/ ngas shes bzhin du‘‘bstan phun lags da dung chang sa brgyab med dam zhes dris par khong gis dbugs ring zhig 'then bzhin‘‘de sngon dga' rogs shig yod kyang da lta kho gnyis kyi 'brel ba phal cher chad 'dug ’zer/ngas mu mthud rgyu ma phu 'ded kyis‘‘ji ltar byas pa yin namami’zhes dris par/khong gis nga la bstan phun gyi gtam rgyud 'di 'dra zhig gsungs byung /bstan phun de sngon sa khul du btsugs pa'i dge sbyong 'dzin grwa zhig la song myong la/ skabs der kho rang sems mthun gyi bu mo zhig dang mdza' gcugs kyi 'brel ba byung zhing / dge sbyong 'dzin grwa mjug 'gril skabs kho gnyis phan tshun 'bral mi phod pa'i ngang nas rang rang gi gnas su song /phyis su kho tshos 'phrin yig gi lam nas phan tshun brtse dung mtshon par byas kyang thag ring gi chu mig gis thag nye'i skom pa sel mi thub pas bu mo des yun ring kher rkyang gi 'tsho ba ma bzod cing kho gnyis mnyam du 'dzom thabs ma byung bas mthar rang gi yul du gnyen sgrig byas pas bstan phun yang bya thabs zad/rgan dar rgyas lags kyis bshad mtshams der slebs skabs slob khrid grol ba'i dril brda btang bas khong gis‘‘zla sgron lags/ mi tshe ni de 'dra red’’ces bshad bzhin yar langs nas rang gi yig cog mdun du song / gang 'dra zhig la mi tshe zer gyi yod dam/ khong gis yang snying gnad don gang 'dra zhig la dmigs te shugs ring 'then gyi yod dam/ 'on kyang slob tshan 'tshogs 86

thengs gnyis par nga slob khrid la 'gro dgos pas bstan phun skor gyi gnas tshul mang po zhig da dung shes ma thub par lus pas nga sems phangs bzhin slob khrid la song ba yin/gza' spen pa'i phyi dro slob tshan grol te rang shag tu log rjes sgra 'beb 'khor lo'i kha phye ste gzhas la nyan bzhin pa'i skabs phyi rol nas slob ma zhig gis 'bod bzhin 'dug ngas yar bos tshe slob ma bu mo gnyis kyis dpe cha zhig lag tu bzung te nang la 'dzul yong ba dang 'tsher snang dang bcas nga la tsis rig gi dka' gnad cig dris byung bas‘‘ngas rtsig rig mi shes pas khyod gnyis rgan bstan phun lags sam dge rgan gzhan zhig la 'dri bar song’’zhes bshad pa yin/ slob ma de gnyis kyis‘‘rgan bstan phun lags kyi sar 'dri mkhan mang po yod cing khos de tshor re re bzhin lan zhib mo 'debs bzhin 'dug pas nged gnyis khyod kyi sar yong ba yin ’zhes bshad pa dang kho gnyis kyi bzhin las blo pham pa'i snang tshul zhig rang shugs su mngon pas nga yang cung 'tsher ba dang ngo gnongs te kho gnyis kyi dka' gnad kyi mdud pa de u tshugs kyis 'grol thub tsam byung / slob ma de gnyis phyir thon rjes ngas rang nyid kyi ched las kho na ma gtogs shes bya gzhan dag la do snang ma byas pa der 'gyod pa skyes shing bstan phun gyi skor la bsam blo btang pa na kho'i zla re'i gla phogs ni kho mo'i zla phogs kyi phyed ka lhag tsam las med pas ngas rang gi lag khyer gyi rin thang ga'i/ nas rtogs song /slob dus gcig mjug rdzogs la nye bas slob ma tshor spyi'i bskyar sbyong gi 87

sbyong gzhi bton pa dang slob mjug rgyugs len gyi gra sgrig gi mgo tshugs/ spyir yin na slob dus gcig gi dus tshod de 'dra'i ring po zhig min na'ang nga rang la mtshon na ha lam lo shas 'das pa'i snang ba skyes/ ci'i phyir zhe na nga rang ni lo brgyad nas da bar lo bcu bzhi'i ring la slob grwa kho nar song ba dang 'gan 'khri med pa'i ngang nas dge rgan gyis khrid pa'i slob tshan dag nyan pa tsam las bya ba dngos kyi myong tshor med pa dang / da lta 'tsho ba dngos kyi khrod du phrad pa'i gnas tshul mang po zhig slob grwar yod dus bsam gzhig byas ma myong / zla ba lnga lhag gi dge rgan gyi 'tsho ba'i khrod nas nga rang la las ka'i byed phyogs dang /mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba sogs 'tsho ba'i shes bya mang po zhig shes su bcug pas slob dus gcig po de nga rang la bshad na phan 'bras nges can thob pa'i dus tshod cig red/slob ma tshor sbyong gzhi bkod sgrig byas shing rgyugs gzhi yang bton tshar bas nga tsho dge rgan rnams cung lhod la babs byung / nyin de'i phyi dror nga tsho mnyam du 'dzoms te nam rgyun ltar kha brda ni gnam gshis drod grang skor nas gleng mgo tshugs/ nga tshos gnam gshis skor gyi kha brda byed skabs gleng gzhi de rim bzhin bod kyi lo tho'i thog babs pa dang lo tho'i tshes grangs re'u mig nang gi 'phror spyor dang / spar sme sogs kyi tha snyad shes mkhan ha cang nyung bas bstan phun gyis gnad don de rnams chu rgyugs pa bzhin bshad pas nga tshos dge rgan gyi slob khrid la nyan pa ji bzhin khu sim mer nyan bzhin bsdad/skabs der slob spyi yang der slebs shing khong gis bstan phun gyi ngo la lta tsam 88

byas pa dang nga tshor mig myul zhig byas rjes ya mtshan sgos‘‘khyed tshos ga re'i skor gleng gi yod dmami zer/ nga sems 'gul chen po thebs pas lam sang‘‘khyed kyis gson dang rgan bstan phun lags ni dngos gnas shes yon phun sum tshogs pa zhig red/ de ring khong gis nga tshor skar rtsis skor gyi shes bya ngo sprod byed bzhin yodamimices bshad pa dang nga'i sems la slob spyi yang ha las nges red snyam byung /‘‘a tsi/ nga'i sems la don chen po zhig la gros bsdur byed kyi yod pa red snyam byung slob spyis ha cang snang chung gi sgo nas de ltar bshad pa dang de nas bstan phun ladzikhyod kyis skar rtsis gang nas sbyangs pa yin/mi zhes zur za dang mthong chung gi nyams kyis dris byung bas bstan phun ci bya gtol bral du gyur/ snang tshul des nga la brnyas bcos chen po zhig phog pa lta bu'i snang ba byung bas khong khro'i ngang nas lan 'debs pa'i tshig tsub cig mchu rtser slebs kyang bzod sgom chen pos phyir mid pa yin/ slob spyi song rjes/ ngas‘‘de ltar bshada.e rung / shes bya yon tan mtha' dag slob grwa ma 'grims na mi thob pa'i nges pa ga la yod ces bshad/ dge rgan gzhan dag gis kyang khyod kyis tshigagacig dang ngas gnyis re bshad de tshang mas slob spyi'i blo sbyong med pa'i gtamaspyod la phu thung nang gi lag bshad re btang ba dang yang bstan phun la slob thon lag khyer zhig gi ched du rgyugs sprod dgos zhes skul slong byas/ ngas kyang skad gsang mthon posadzikhyod rang de sngon slob grwa chen mo zhig tu 'gro 'dod med pa ci yin zhes dris pas/ kho rang 'dzum bzhin du‘‘de 'dra'i 89

bsam tshul sngar nas skyes myong la/ 'jig rten gyi bya dngos tshang ma shes thub pa byung na snyam yang bsams tshad bsgrub rgyu khag po yin pas da lta'i bar du lus pa red ’zer/ khos lan btab pa ni de 'dra'i sla mo zhig dang mi gsal ba zhig yin pas tshang mas rang rang gi go ba len stangs ltar kho'i mi tshe dang kho'i skad cha'i go don tshod dpag byed dgos/gza' 'khor rer slob tshan bcu bzhi 'khrid pa las las ka gzhan med na'ang lo phyed kyi ring la rdzong mkhar gyi sa bab ji 'dra zhig yin pa yang mi shes/rgyugs yig bris tshar rjes 'dzin grwa'i 'gan 'khur ba tshos slob ma'i khyim la bskur ba'i yi ge sogs 'bri ba'i skabs der nga la las ka med pas/ nga rang gcig pu rdzong mkhar la 'cham 'cham du song ba yin/ mkhar 'di ri mthon po gnyis kyi bar du chags shing nam zla ha cang 'khyag pas sngo ljang gi spang thang lag mthil tsam yang mthong rgyu med pa phyogs kun tu skya ther ther du snang /lung ba'i phu nas chu phran zhig bzhur 'ongs pa der chab rom mthug po rang chags med pas yur ba zhig brgyud nas chu 'khor (rang 'thag )zhig gi 'gab tu 'bab bzhin 'dugang rang chu 'khor de'i sgo khar song ba na/ de'i sgo dang skar khung gi zur tshang mar phye rdul mthug po chags 'dug cing skar khung gi nang nas rdul phye srab mo zhig mkha' la 'tshub bzhin 'dug chu 'khor gyi sgo 'gram du khyi zhig nyal 'dug pas de btags yod med mi shes pas nga 'gro ma phod par skad gsang mthon pos bos tshe khang pa'i nang nas mi zhig phyir thon byung / mi de'i lus chu 90

'khor gyi khang pa dang 'dra bar rtsam pa'i gyon chas gyon pa ltar snang bas mi'i bzhin rang ji 'dra yin pa mi shes/ mi des nga mthong 'phral‘‘a tsi/ khyed yin nam/ 'dir ga re gnang bar phebs pa yin namami zhes ngo mtshar ba'i tshul gyis dris byung / ngas zhib tu bltas pa na mi de ni gzhan ma yin par bstan phun yin pas nga yang cung ya mtshan pa'i ngang‘‘a tsi/ khyod yin nam/ ga re byed kyi yod dam ces kho'i dri bar lan ma btab par phar dris pa na/ bstan phun gyis‘‘nga rtsam pa 'thag par yong ba yin zer bzhin lus thog gi rdul phye dag sprug sprug tsam byas/ kho'i ngo la'ang rdul phye rim pa zhig chags 'dug pas nga rang dbang med par dgod kha shor/ de nas ngas‘‘chu 'khor nang du 'gro e rungami zhes dris/ khos lan ma btab gong skra dang smin ma yang dkar por gyur pa'i bgres song zhig phyir thon nas‘‘'grig dang 'grig nam rgyun nga'i 'dir las byed pa phebs pa ha cang nyung na'ang de ring khyod gnyis phebs pa 'di ni nga'i chu 'khor gyi gzi brjid red’ ces gsungs byung bas ngas gzhi nas khong chu 'khor gyi phye gnyer yin pa shes byung / phye gnyer de ni rgan po mtshar po zhig yin pas nged gnyid la gad mo yang yang bslangs shing / gtam gleng byas te cung tsam bsdad rjes de gar rtsam pa za dgos zhes u tshugs byed kyin 'dug pas ngas kyang 'dzem zol med par rtsam pa brdzis nas zos/ ngas rtsam pa za bzhin bstan phun la‘‘khyod rang dngos su rtsam pa 'thag par yong bas nang mi gzhan dag gang du song zhes the tshom dang bcas dris par bstan phun gyis nga la yid gzab kyis lta bzhin‘‘ga re/ khyod kyis da dung shes med dam ’zhes 91

cung ha las pa'i sgo nas bshad pas kho mo yang sems mi bde ba dang 'tsher snang skyes kyang snang dogs med khul gyis‘‘dgongs pa ma tshom/ don de khyed kyes gsungs ma myong bas ngas ji ltar shes zhes dag sel byas pas/ dge rgan bstan phun gyisayogal srid khyod rang nyan 'dod yod na ngas bshad chog mod/ 'on kyang mi phal ba zhig la de tshod kyi las dbang zhig las med pas khyod kyis nyan rjes don snying mi 'dug snyam nges red mizer/ phye gnyer rgan po de mi bsam shes shig yin pas lam sang‘‘rtsam pa nga gcig pus 'thag chog pas khyod gnyis kha brda gyis la cung tsam sdodami ces gsungs byung / bstan phun gyis skad cha der g.yol rtsis byed 'dod kyang / ngas 'thad pa'i brda brgyab pas/ phye gnyer rgan po nang la song ba dang bstan phun gyis nga la khong gi lo rgyus bshad/khong gi pha ma gnyis la phru gu kho rang gcig pu las med cing khong gi a ma sngar nas tshe las 'das pas a phas kho rang dpral ba'i mig dang khong gi snying ltaragaces par bskyangs/ bstan phun chung dus nas rig pa ha cang rno bas dge sbyong 'dzin grwar 'gro rgyu'i go skabs byung na'ang skabs der las bgo'i lam lugs med pas kho rang la sngar bzhin kung hre nas yong na kung hre la log rgyu'i skal ba las ma thob/ kung hrer log rjes bstan phun dmangs btsugs slob grwa'i dge rgan byas pa dang zla ba rer gla phogs sgor bcu gnyis las med na'ang de'i phyed ka ru khag tu skar cha'i thebs rtsar 'jog dgos/ skabs der kho dang chung dus nas 'dris pa'i dga' rogs gzhon nu ma zhig yod pa de 92

gzhan gyis 'dun mar blangs pas kho rang yid shin tu skyo ste bu mo de gtan nas mi mthong ba'i yul thag ring zhig tu 'gro thub pa'i ched du sngon chad dgon pa zhig gi dge bshes yin pa dang rjes su ru khag gi lug rdzi yin pa'i grwa log cig yod pa de'i drung nas sum rtags dag gsum dang snyan ngag le'u gnyis pa/skar rtsis dang mngon brjod sogs legs par bslabs par ma zad/ rgya yig la'ang rang sbyong byas te da lta slob grwa dang yul mi sus kyang khas len pa'i shes yon can du gyur/ dmangs btsugs slob grwa'i dge rgan byed skabs a phas kho la mna' ma zhig len rtsis byas nas slong chang drangs te gnyen rtags brgyab cing bu mo de dang kho gnyis kyi bar la'ang brtse dung nges can zhig chags yod kyang sa khul gyi las byed pa zhig gis dbang dang thabs kyis bu mo'i pha ma gnyis bkug cing mthar bu mo der mngal chags pas bu mo de dang mi 'bral ka med byung /de nas bzung kho'i do snang bya yul rbad de dpe deb kyi thog tu bsgyur nas slob grwa chen mo'am 'bring rim ched sbyong slob grwar rgyugs sprod rtsis thengs gnyis tsam byas kyang khyim du pha rgan gcig pu 'jog ma bzod par rang gi 'char gzhi de blos btang / 1980lor rdzong yongs kyi dmangs btsugs dge rgan gyi tshad len rgyugs sprod byas te rdzong rig slob cus nas dmigs bsal gyisardzong slob 'bring du gan rgya'i lam lugs kyi dge rgan la yar 'then byas na'ang da dung 'bru rigs kyi them tho zhing grong du yod pas bo ming thob thang sogs kyi thob thang ga la yod/ 93

bstan phun gyis skad cha de dag bshad tshar dus ji ltar bzhur ba'ang ma tshor bar nga'i mkhur mtshos kyi ngos su mig chu'i rdog po 'ga' dril byung bas/ngas mgo bo sgur sgur gyis g.yol ci thub byas nas‘‘khyod rang gis dka' las zhe drag brgyab 'dugami ces bshad pas bstan phun yang skyo ba'i dbugs ring zhig 'then bzhin‘‘ngas lam kyag kyog de 'dra zhig brgyud med tshe/ da lta'i grub 'bras chung ngu 'di tsam yang thob dka' ste/ mi su yin na'ang dka' ba ji tsam mang ba spyad na 'bras bu yang de tsam thob nges red snyam gyin 'dug’ zer/yud tsam la kha rog tu bsdad pa dang de nas ngas spobs pa chen pos‘‘da skabs khyod la dga' rogs med dam zhes dris par khos mgo bo phred du g.yug bzhin‘‘da lta bu mo mang po zhig ni kham sdong mthon po'i rtse'i kham bu dang 'dra bas ’zhes zer/ ngas mu mthud du‘‘gal te kham sdong mthon pa'i rtse na yod pa'i 'bras bu smin pa'i dus su khyod kyis 'thog rgyu yin nam zhes bshad cing / ngas skad cha de su la dmigs te brjod pa nga rang gis kyang mi shes/bstan phun gyis yud tsam zhig nga la ce rer bltas 'dug pa dang de nas slar yangadzide ni phal cher nga'i byis pa'i dus kyi mdzes sdug ldan pa'i rmi lam las mig snga'i don dngos shig yin mi srid zer/nga khong khro cung langs te‘‘'o na khyod kyis rang gi gnad don la bsam blo gtong gi yod dam7zhes dris par/ kho 'dzum bzhinadzings bsam blo btang 94

yang stong ba ma yin namami’zer/ nga rang kho la skad cha mang po zhig bshad 'dod yod mod/ 'on kyang dus tshod mi snga bas kha brda byed ma thub/ skabs der phye gnyer rgan pos chang dam bi gang dang dkar yol re khyer yong nas nged gnyis kyi 'khris su skyil krung bcos te bsdad cing chang dkar yol gang re blugs rjes‘‘khyed gnyis kyi kha brdar gnod pa med dam zhes ku re'i tshul gyis de ltar bshad/ nyi ma nub cing sa rub la nye bas nga rang 'gro rtsis byed skabs phye gnyer rgan pos‘‘da rung brel dgos don med/ khyod rang lam nas skrag na rgan bstan phun lags kyis skyel chog zer/ ngas khong la 'dzum tsam las ci yang ma bshad par bstan phun la‘‘khyod rang do nub 'gro thub bam zhes dris par/ rgan po de dgod bzhin‘‘rgan lags khyed kyis khong blos mi thongs na do nub khong la phyag rogs gnang ste bzhugs chog’ zer bas nga rang ngo gnong ste gdong tsha lam lam du gyur/ bstan phun gyis‘‘phye gnyer lags khyed kyis de 'dra ma gsung / kho mo ni bdag po yod pa'i mi red/ kho mo'i snying sdug da lta lha sa na yod pa red’’ces bshad pas phye gnyer rgan po ha las pa'i tshul gyis‘‘a tsi/ sa thag de 'dra ring pa la’’zer/grang rlung 'ur 'ur du ldang bzhin 'dug cing / nub phyogs kyi sprin gseb las 'phros pa'i dkar phyogs kyi zla 'od ni sang ras dkar po bzhin dbyig 'dzin dga' ma'i lus la khyab par bklubs/lung shur gyi chu phran ni lhung lhung du 'bab cing / nam mkha'i skar tshogs ni khra lam mer shar 'dug mtshams mtshams la rgyang ring nas khyi skad 'ga' 95
re go thub/ dge rgan bstan phun gyis nga rang slob grwar bskyal 1987lo'i dgun khar zin bris btab/1988lo'i ston khar bzo bcos thengs dang po byas/1989lo'i zla8par bzo bcos kyis gtan la phab/

rab rib kyi shul lam/de nyin ni dmigs bsal gyi nyin mo zhig yin pas mo snga po nas langs te khyim la gad phyid byed rgyu dang / zhogs ja bzo rgyu/ zhogs zas gra sgrig sogs cha tshang byas rjes ja phor pa do gsum btungs nas‘‘a cag de ring nga snga tsam 'gro gi yin/ bzang ngan ga re byung rung de ring thag chod kyi red’ ces 'gro rtsis byed skabs a cag dbyangs skyid kyisami ‘‘gsal sgron/ re ba chen po ma byed/ gal te da res kyang pham nyes byung na de las ngas bshad pa der bsam blo gtong / de ltar ma byas tshe dgon pa'i ja med la/ zhol gyi thug pa'ang med pa byas yong’ zhes re thag chad pa'i skad cha de bshad/ da lta'i ngos nas bshad na gsal sgron gyi rna bar skad cha de 'dra go 'dod med pas ci yang mi smra bar brel 'tshub kyis sgo las phyir thon/grong khyer gyi zhogs pa'i mkha' rlung ni gtsang zhing bsil ba dang / nam mkha' sngo la dwangs shing sprin dkar tshom bu 'ga' mkha' dbyings su zhi lhod kyis lding nas yod kyang mo'i sems ni khrom gzhung du yar 'gro mar 'gro byed mkhan mi dang rlangs 'khor dang 'dra bar yam yom gyis 'jags thabs med pas sems nang‘‘dkon mchog mkhyen/ re ba tshang ma da thengs la bcol yod/dkon mchog gis em rje'i mig bkab nas ci yang mthong med par shogami ces 97

smon lam dang sbrags te yid nas yang yang bzlas/ lam bar du slob grogs lhag chung dang 'phrad pas kho gnyis dal bus bskyod pa'i skabs su lhag chung gis‘‘gsal sgron/ nga zhe po zhed kyin 'dug rang zhed kyin e 'dug ces rang la tshod dpag med pas de ltar bshad/ ‘‘'gag rtsa 'di lta'i skabs su zhed snang dang 'tshab snang mi skye mkhan su yod dam’’zhes gsal sgron gyis de ltar lan btab/kho gnyis ngal rtsol zhabs zhu kung si'i sgo khar slebs skabs de gar las sgug gzhon nu mang po zhig rgyal pham thag gcod bya rgyur sems 'tshab kyis sgug nas yod na'ang gzhon nu kha shas ni rang gi pha ma dang mnyam du thad kar gzhung las khang du 'dzul nas las bgos kyi brda tho blangs te ngo gdong las blo yid tshims shing spobs nyams mngon pa dang dga' spro'i rnam pas log 'gro gin yod pas gzhan tsho ni de dag la yid smon skyes pa dang / kha nas‘‘ltag sgo nas thon song’’zhes 'khang ra byed kyin ngang sgug mi byed ka med red/gsal sgron ni 'dir yong thengs dang po ma yin zhing / na ning gi yig rgyugs tshad bkag gi skar grangs las ldab kyis mtho ba yod rung cha rkyen ang gnyis pa ste gzugs po'i cha rkyen tshang med pas 'di lo slar yang yig tshad bskyar gtong ma byed thabs med byung / da thengs a zhang gis ma gzhi dngul brgya lor kha shas shig gi rtsib rdo brgyab ste ngo shes shig brgyud de ngal rtsol zhabs zhu kung si'i las bgos rgyag mkhan mi zhig la mngags yod rung 'jig rten gtam dper‘‘mdzo de las zhed pa rwa ba'i sbug tu yod ces pa ltar ro/98

yud tsam song rjes mig shel brgyab pa'i rgya rigs gzhon nu zhig gis lag par shog bu chen po zhig 'khyer te gzhung las khang las thon yong ba dang sems 'tshab kyis gdung ba'i mi rnams kyi yam yom dang skad cor de bas je cher phyin/ mi des ci yang mi smra bar ming tho dang / skar grangs bris pa'i brda tho zhig gyang ldebs su sbyar rtsis byed kyi 'dug pas de mur sgug yun ma bzod pa'i mi rnams de'i phyogs su 'ur/ gsal sgron dang lhag chung gis kyang 'tshang kha brgyab ste lta rtsis bya skabs de'i mdun du mi tshogs kyis grog tshang rdol ba'i grog ma bzhin longs longs byed pa dang skad cor las gang yang mthong rgyu med pas kho gnyis zur zhig tu don nas ngang sgug ma byed thabs med byung /skabs der mi zhig gis skad chen pos ming tho'i gsham du bris pa'i gsal bshad yi ge de dag klog bzhin yod cing / de'i nang nas da res yig tshad gtong mkhan mi grangs chig stong tsam yod rung las bzo pa bsdu ba'i grangs tshad sum brgya tsam las med lugs dang de dag kyang yig tshad kyi ang ki dang bde thang gi tshad gzhi gnyis zung 'brel gyis bsdus lugs sogs 'khod yod pas bde thang gi tshad gzhi'i skor thos ma thag gsal sgron gyi snying la tsha shar brgyab pa dang / lus la chu grang mo bshos pa bzhin khog 'dar shor bas rang gi re ba chen po de'i phyed ka yal zin pa'i snang ba byung / 'tshang kha rgyag mkhan gyi khrod du slob grogs kha shas kyang slebs yod pas kho tshos mnyam rub kyis 'tshang kha brgyab nas gyang 'gram du slebs thugetsam byung / shog bu'i thog gsal sgron dang / don grub/ g.yu sgron/ rdo rje/ lhag chung kho tsho su gang gi 99

ang tshab med pas kho tsho phan tshun blta res re byas pa dang tshang ma phu shor ba'i 'bud pa bzhin dbugs ring gtong bzhin da lta'i tsha rlabs de gar song cha med du gyur/ rdo rjes ngal rtsol zhabs zhu kung si'i sgo la bltas te thu lud gcig 'phangs nas‘‘da res ma gtogs sus yong / gang ltar drang po drang shag byed mkhan ni mi 'dug ces dang yang gsal sgron la gtad de‘‘nga tsho 'dra po 'dra po yin rung gsal sgron rang slob sbyong yag po yod pas yig tshad mi lon pa ci la srid/ yang gzugs por khag btags pa yin gyi red ces 'khang ra byas/ gsal sgron gyis der yin min gyi lan ci yang ma brgyab kyang lhag chung gis‘‘gsal sgron/ skad cha zhig 'dri bar rgyugs dang / da res khyod tsho'i a zhang lags kyis ngo shes pa brgyud yod pas dpe srid dogs med/gcig byas na ang tshab nor las che’’zhes shod pa'i skabs su mi zhig gis gsal sgron zur zhig tu skad btang song / mi de ni a zhang lags kyis mngags yul de yin pas gsal sgron ni pham sems nang slar yang re ba phran bu bcangs bar thal/ mi des‘‘da res thabs shes gang drag byas rung khyod kyi lus la nad gzhi tshabs che tsam yod rkyen ’ zhes the tshom gyi gdangs shig bton pa dang yang mu mthud de‘‘nad gzhi de las cung yang ba yod na cung drag pa yod kyang ’’ skad cha the tshom can gnyis bshad de rang nyid la'ang thabs shes med tshul dag sel byas/ngal rtsol zhabs zhu kung si'i sgo khar gzhon nu kha shas dga' mchongs rgyag bzhin phan tshun bkra shis bde legs zhu ba dang / la la ngu ba/ la la rang 100

gi mig la da dung yid ma ches pa bzhin brda thor blta bzhin mchis/mi rnams rim bzhin nyung du 'gro gin yod pas don grub kyis khro ba'i ngang‘‘nga tsho 'dir skyag pa za gin sdod dam/ de las da lta snga po yin pas gling kha'i nang sdod par 'gro/ ltos dang gsal sgron rang nam rgyun nga tsho dang mnyam du skyid skyid gtong bar mi 'gro bar slob sbyong kho na byas te bsdad kyang yong rgyu 'di red/ de tsho tshang ma las red/ las la gang bskos ma gtogs snang bar gang dran yod pa ma red/ de ring nga tsho mnyam du 'gro’ zhes bshad/ skabs der lhag chung gis ngu ma dgod kyis‘‘nang la log kyang a mar gtam bzang shod rgyu med pas/ de las 'khyams te sdug bsngal brjed thabs bya rgyu dang /nyi ma 'khyol thabs byed rgyu red ces bshad/ gsal sgron nam rgyun kho tsho dang ha cang mthun po yod rung kho tsho gling kha dang / zhabs bro khang sogs su 'gro skabs mo 'gro rtsis byed kyi med pa de goms gshis su gyur te kho tshos kyang khrid rtsis byed kyi med/ 'on te de ring mo yang kho tsho dang mnyam du gling kha chung chung zhig gi nang du song ste rang rang lus thog tu yod pa'i dngul tshang ma bsdus te za chas dang sbi rag sgam gnyis nyos/ gsal sgron rnam kun chang gi rigs la kha rgyag gi med la sbi rag ni de bas kyang 'thungs ma myong / da lta sems mi skyid pas tsher ma'i ldi khu lta bu'i btung bya de u tshugs kyis btungs/ dus tshod gang mtshams song rjes kho tsho tshang ma ra bzi nas phan tshun skyid sdug gi snying gtam shod res byed pa dang sbi rag phyed ka 'thung ba dang phyed ka bor bzhin yod cing / lhag chung gis‘‘las ma dag pa nga / pha mas da bar gsos rung da 101

lta rang gi lto gos rang gis 'tshol mi thub par pha ma gnyis la brten dgos pa'i khar da dung kho tshor sems khral chen po bzos song mizhes ngus/ ngu mkhan gyi ngo la bltas na ngu bro ba'i dpe ltar bu mo gzhan gnyis kyang ngu dgod kyis mgo mjug med pa'i lab rdol gyi 'go tshugs/ gsal sgron ni kho tsho su las kyang sems sdug che ba yod cing / mo'i ngos nas bshad na slob sbyong yag po yod rung mchin nad kyis ga dus yin rung rang nyid thar par gtong gin med/de yang lo gnyis kyi gong du mos rang nyid kyi mdun lam la yid ches kyis khengs bzhin nyin mtshan ltos med slob sbyong la 'bad pa lhod med kyis slob grwa chen mor 'gro rgyu'i sta gon byed pa dang / dge slob tshang mas mo la re ba chen po dhe byed kyi yod/ 'dzin grwa'i kru'u ren gyis kyang mo la nges par du mes rgyal nang khul gyi slob grwa chen mo zhig la 'gro rtsis byed dgos zhes dran skul yang yang byas/ yin na'ang gzugs gzhir brtag dpyad byed skabs mchin nad yod pa shes pas gzhon nu ma zhig gi mtshon mdangs bkra ba'i rmi lam de rbad de thor ba dang dus de nas bzung slob grwa chen mo dang mo'i dbar la las 'phro med pa'i mtshungs rtags brgyabs/de ring mo rang ra bzi yod kyang 'das don de dag klad ngos su de bas gsal du 'gro gin yod pas mos glo bur‘‘khyod tsho ma ngu dang / ngu rgyu ga re 'dug7ces khong khro rab tu zos nas skad brgyab/tshang mas rgyun du kha khu sim pa'i gsal sgron la ha las te mig ce rer bltas te sdod pa las/ re zhig ngu mkhan med la skad cha yang shod mkhan med 102

par kha khu sim mer bsdad/ mos sbi rag shel dam gang 'degs bzhin yin dā/nga tsho tshang ma zhabs tag re zhes gzhan tshor btegs pa dang kho tshos kyang mo la 'degs bzhin sa ma rub bar bsdad/gsal sgron ra bzi ste mgo yur 'khor ba dang gom pa'ang yag po spo mi thub pas slob grogs tshos bskyor te khyim du bskyal/ gcung mo ni phyi nyin snga po nas slob grwar 'gro dgos pas nyal zin rung a cag dbyangs skyid brnyan 'phrin lta bzhin gsal sgron sgug nas yod pa dang mos tshul de mthong skabs hang sangs te rgyu mtshan 'dri skabs lhag chung gis‘‘nga tsho la gtam bzang shod rgyu med pas nang la log ma nus par da lta bar mnyam du chang btungs te bsdad pa yin/ a cag lags/ de ring mo rang nga tshos u tshugs kyis khrid pa las mo la lan pa med pas bka' bkyon ma gnang rogs ’ces lce sgrogs thebs bzhin zhu ba 'then/dbyangs skyid kyis gnas tshul gsal po rtogs pas sems gting nas dga' po gtan nas ma byung yang kho tsho'i mdun la rnam 'gyur ston mi phod par slob grogs tshor thugs rje zhus te log btang ba dang rang nyid kyis gsal sgron nyal du bcug gsal sgron gyi kha nas skad cha gsal la mi gsal mang po shod pa dang skyug pa yang skyug gin yod pas mo'i de ring gi byed stangs la dbyangs skyid shin tu nas ma mos par skad cha zhig shod par 'dod kyang do nub ra bzi yod pas bzod sgom byas/gsal sgron gyi ngos nas bshad na dbyangs skyid dngos gnas bka' drin 103

chen po red/ pha ma gnyis med par gyur ba nas bzung mo'i a zhang dang dbyangs skyid gnyis pos tshur bsus te rang nyid kyi bu phrug bzhin byams dang brtse bas bskyangs pa dang pha ma gnyis 'dzoms kyi bu phrug bzhin slob chung dang /dma' rim slob 'bring / mtho rim slob 'bring bar slob grwar btang ba ma zad lto gyong gos gyong gtong myong gtan nas med/mtshan mo der kho gnyis ka gnyid khug med cing / gsal sgron ni sbi rag 'thung drags pas skyugs 'dod pa dang / mgo yur 'khor ba/ tsha ba rgyab pa sogs shin tu mi bde rung rig pa de bas dwangs su 'gro gin yod/ rgyun du nang gi lto chas bzo rgyu dang / phor pa 'khru rgyu/ gad phyid sogs nang las tsag tsig tshang ma gsal sgron gyis byed kyi yod pa dang / kha nyin yang mos sngar ltar zhogs zas bzas tshar rjes phor pa 'khru skabs dbyangs skyid kyis‘‘rjes su gsal sgron rang gi phor pa ma gtogs/ bu mo nga gnyis kyi phor pa ngas 'khrus chog nga la phru gu sgrol dkar gcig pu las med pas rjes su khyod kyis gzab gzab byed rogs ’zhes bshad/ da bar ga dus yin na'ang mos bsam pa rnam dag gis yid gzab chen po byed pa dang phor pa ma 'dres pa byed kyi yod pa de dag dbyangs skyid kyis kyang gsal po shes bzhin du de ring kha nas de ltar thon pas mo de bas sems sdug skyes/ gnas tshul de dag yid la phra lham mer gsal ba dang dbyangs skyid kyi skad sgra lhang lhang du grags yong nas mo de bas gnyid la ma yur bar mos a slog zhig brgyab ste sems mnon thabs byas kyang rig pa de bas dwangs su song nas mu 'brel gyi brnyan 'phrin dpar gzhi 104

bzhin rnam 'gyur de dag ni kha sngon mo la dpal ldan ngo sprod byas kyang snang 'jog ma byas pa nas bzung rim bzhin thon pa gzhi nas shes pas bskyar du de'i thad bsam gzhigs byed dgos byung /dbyangs skyid kyis mig gnyis btsums te gnyid khug thabs ji ltar byas kyang mo'i sems nang yang da res kyang re ba zad/ des ma tshad rang nyid la'ang phru gu yod pa dang yang sgos de ring gi byed stangs la bsam bzhin nges par du khyim de nas mgyogs thabs 'don thabs byed dbo/sa/ dpal ldan mo rang las lo cung rgan tsam dang bu mo snga 'dzar zhig yod kyang kho'i bza' zla tshe las 'das nas yun ring song ste da dung gcig pur bsdad pa la bltas na kho ni rang gi zla grogs la brtse po yod par mtshon pa dang des ma zad kho la rig gnas yod la dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi mi dman tsam yod pas gsal sgron la mi lo ba gang yang med/ de ltar bsam nas sang nyin bskyar du gsal sgron la lab na da res kha rdab pas phal cher khas len mdog kha po red snyam/gsal sgron gyis da bar dbyangs skyid kyis ngo sprod byas pa'i mi de'i thog bsam blo nan tan zhig btang med pa de yang kho la snga 'dzar yod pa dang / lo rgan pa yod par mi mos pa zhig ma yin par gcig rnos rang nyid la da lta'ang las ka gtan 'khel pa zhig med pas gtan grogs 'tshol rgyur bsam blo gtong khom ma byung ba dang / yang sgos de ni mi tshe gcig gi don chen yin pas thag gcod ma nus/ gsal sgron gyis bsam blo ji tsam btang yang da cha rang nyid ni khyim tshang 105

'di'i nang gi mi thol pa zhig gam sbyin bdag gis dga' po mi byed pa'i mgron po zhig yin pa'i snang ba byung ba dang / 'di nas kha bral yang a cag dbyangs skyid kyis bshad pa ltar dpal ldan dang 'grig pa bya rgyu las legs pa zhig med pas dpal ldan gyi mna' ma bya rgyu'i sems thag bcad/dpal ldan nam rgyun 'jon thang che la mi gzhan dang mthun pa dang las khungs nang blta stangs yag po yod pas gnyen sgrig byas nas yun ring ma 'gor bar las khungs kyi tshags par dang yi ge sogs gtong len khang gi las ka de gsal sgron la sprad/ las ka zhig 'tshol thub pa bya rgyu ni gsal sgron gyi rmi lam nang du'ang re ba byed pa zhig yin pa dang de sngon dka' ngal dang thabs shes ji tsam spyad kyang 'tshol thub med mod/ dpal ldan dang gnyen sgrig byas te mi tshe gcig gi don chen thag bcad pa dang sbrags rang gis sngar nas re ba byed pa'i las ka zhig byung ba ma zad las ka de ni bzod yang la rnyog dra med pa zhig yin pas mo blo yid ha cang tshim po byung ba ma zad dpal ldan ni mi 'dris bdegashib bde dang bla ma dkon mchog cig yod pas mos rang nyid kyi las dbang 'di 'dra zhig yin gyi rede snyam nas kho la lhag bsam rnam dag byed pa ma zad/ lto chas bzo rgyu sogs nang las tshang ma su la'ang re mi dgos par rang nyid gcig pus 'gan 'khyer ba dang dpal ldan gyi bu mo lha mor yang a ma ngo ma'i byams brtse ster gang thub byed kyi yod pas dpal ldan dang bu mor gzhi nas khyim tshang gi dro skyid tshor bas sems gting nas dga' po byung /de nyin res gza' nyi ma yin rung mos rnam kun ltar snga po nas langs te 106

khyim las byas pa dang de rjes nyal chas dang gdan 'khru bar 'gro rtsis byed skabs dpal ldan gnyid sad pas gnyid dwangs la ma dwangs kyis‘‘de ring gza' nyi ma yin pas phyi trem ma nyal ba ’zhes bshad pa dang / de rjes tsog tsog byas te‘‘gos 'khru rgyu de khag shos red 'dug ngas snga sa nas gos 'khru'i 'phrul 'khor zhig nyo bsam rung da bar nyin 'gyangs zhag 'bud du lus song /dngul btang chog yod pas de ring dran thog la nga gnyis mnyam du nyo bar 'gro’ zhes rang gi bsam tshul dang 'char gzhi de bshad/ ‘‘'um/ de ring phyin na 'grig gi ma red/ res gza' nyi mar ngas lha mo rig gnas pho brang du rtsed mo rtse bar 'khrid rgyu'i khas blangs tshar ba yin/ lha mo'i sbyang 'bras de lnga'isko las dmigs bsal gyis yag tu phyin 'dug la kha sa khyim bdag gi tshogs 'du'i thog dge rgan gyis lha mo'i sbyangs 'bras yag tu phyin par bsngags brjod byas pa dang da dungalha mo nang sa'i slob 'bring du tshud rgyu'i re ba chen po 'dug pas pha mas phru gu'i mdun lam la bsam blo btang ste rgyag rībaskyor byed dgos zhes gsungs kyin 'dug la nga rang yang de 'dra rang bsam gyin 'dug’’ces shod kyin kho'i ja phor nang ja blugs/khos brtse ba chen pos mo'i gdong la lta bzhin‘‘de dag tshang ma khyed rang gi bka' drin red/ de min na da lta'i sbyangs 'bras 'di 'dra thob rgyu sems thag red ces bka' drin tshor ba'i ngang nas bshad pa dang / gsal sgron gyis‘‘deng sang gi phru gu ni nga tsho phru gu'i skabs dang mi 'dra bar gshis ka gyong po yod rkyen ngang rgyud ring trem ma byas na ga la 'grig de'i khar 'di lo bu mo 107
