dbyangs dang grogs mo tsho'i nyal khang gi gtan 'jags mgron por gyur pa dang khong tsho'i nyal khang nang shing tog dang / bye ril/ mngar sob bag leb sogs chad med za rgyu yod pas lhag chung gi 'dun pa dngos su grub pa dang bu mo gzhan tshos kyang dga' bsu byed kyin yod/ khos khyer yong ba'i rngan pa nyal khang nang bzhag rjes dus tshod dam 'dzin gyis pad dbyangs rkang 'khor rgyab la bskyon te skabs re glog brnyan lta bar 'gro ba dang / skabs re rdzong rgyab klu khang sogs su khrid de brtse dung bdud rtsir mnyam du rol/kho gnyis kyi 'bral du med pa'i brtse dung la dkon mchog kyang sems 'gul thebs te mo'i las bgos grong khyer nang gi sman khang zhig tu 'khel/bstan 'dzin gyis rogs pa gnyis 'khrid de sman khang nas pad dbyangs dang zla sgron la sprad pa'i khang pa rnying pa der dkar rag byugs/ nyi mas tshos log te thal skyar gyur pa'i sgo dang sge'u khung la bkrag rtsi byugs/ bstan 'dzin ni las ka zhib tshags la ngang rgyud ring bas mos kho'i las ka byed stangs la lta bzhin ha cang mos po byung ba dang / skabs re a cor gyis kho'i gdong steng gi rngul chu phyis/ yang skabs re dkar yol nang ja blugs te yang se sprod pa'i tshul de zla sgron gyis mthong skabs kha nas ci yang ma bshad kyang sems gting nas yid smon skyes/ zla sgron gyis ha lam zla phyed tsam re'i nang mi re brjes te khrid yong skabs kho gnyis blo mi bde bar gyur pa dang / sems kyis ma bzod par kha ta bslab bya byed skabs mos gad mo dgod bzhin‘‘khyed gnyis kyi dga' rogs sgrig 272

stangs de srol rgyun gyi dga' rogs sgrig stangs red/ nga'i dga' rogs sgrig stangs 'di deng skabs dar so che ba'i dga' rogs sgrig stangs dpe gsar red/ gang ltar mthun na mthun pa red/ mi mthun rta g.yag mgo 'brel byed dgos don med’mices rang gi lta ba lhug por bshad pa las kho gnyis kyi kha tar snang 'jog tsam mi byed/u tshugs khyu g.yag kha sprod/—1ge yud tsam zhig la dus tshod lo phyed 'das zin na'ang pad dbyangs la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i phugs bsam chen po zhig yod pas kho gnyis kyi 'brel ba'i 'phel rim de sngar bzhin dga' grogs trem gyi chu tshad du lus nas 'phel rgyas de tsam phyin med pa dang phan tshun gyi khyim nas kyang da dung gsal po shes med pas bstan 'dzin gyis don de phan tshun gyi pha mar snga tsam bshad de mgyogs tsam thag gcod dgos pa'i re ba 'don skabs pad dbyangs kyis‘‘nga em rje'i slob grwar yig rgyugs sprod rgyu de mngon 'gyur byung rjes phyin na de bas yag gi redamimices bshad/ bstan 'dzin skad cha der nyan 'dod med pas‘‘khyed rang gis nga la bsam blo phran trem thongs dang / nga tsho'i khyim la bu nga las med pa dang nga yang da cha lo chung chung min pas pha ma gnyis kyis sems khral chen po byed kyin 'dug nga'i gcung mo yang snga sa nas gnyen sgrig byas te phru gu chen po chags tshar yod/ nga la dga' rogs yod pa pha ma gnyis kyis 273

shes rjes kho gnyis dga' po byung nas snga tsam thag bcad nas khyim gzhis 'dzugs dgos pa'i re ba yang yang 'don gyin 'dug’’ces kho'i khyim la mi bab spyan zhur 'gro dgos pa'i re ba bton kyang mos sngar bzhin nar 'gyangs dgos pa'i tshul bstan/ khos‘‘khyed rang gis nga'i pha ma gnyis kyang thug 'dod byed kyi med pas nga dang mi tshe mnyam skyel byed rgyu yin zer ba'i bka' mol la nga dogs pa za gin 'dug ces rlung langs nas phyir thon/ mos lto phad 'khyer te lam seng kho'i rjes ded nas‘‘bstan 'dzin lags/ ngas de 'dra zer gyin med/ khyed rang gis go ba log sgrub gnang song / da lta nga lo chung chung yin pas ’‘‘'on kyang nga pho lo sum cur slebs pa red do ’ mos gom pa mgyogs po sposanas kho'i mdun bkag ste‘‘byas na ngas mos mthun byas chog de ring res gza' nyi ma yin pas phyin na 'grig’’ mo'i skad cha de ni bstan 'dzin la mtshon na than pas rdung pa'i ljang par char chu 'phrad pa dang / ha log kha'i tshong par khe spogs byung ba dang mtshungs pas da lta'i sems kyi na bun thams cad glo bur gang song cha med du song bas 'dren byed kyang che ru song nas g.yas g.yon la lta tsam yang ma byas par mo'i dpral bar 'o zhig bskyal/ mos mchu snar tsam dang / sna gnyer trem byas te g.yas g.yon la lta gin‘‘khyed rang ni nyi ma kha dkar ngo dkar la rgya lam sgang la de 'dra byas te ngo mi tsha'am’’zhes bzhin dpal dmar por gyur nas de ltar bshad/ khos‘‘khyed rang snga phyi ma gtogs nga'i mi yin pas de la ngo tsha rgyu ga re yodamimices shod kyin spro ba rab tu 274

'phel bas mo'i lag nas bzung ste thad kar rang khyim du khrid rtsis byas/ ‘‘a la sgug dang / da res thengs dang po yin pas lag pa stong par 'gro mi nyan’’zhes pad dbyangs kyis lag rtags ci zhig nyo dgos min skor shod skabs khos‘‘dgos kyi ma red/ nga'i pha ma gnyis kyi ngos nas bshad na khyed rang yong na lag rtags che shos de red’ ces bshad/ pad dbyangs kyis kho tshur 'then nas‘‘'grig gi ma red/ ma gzhi ngas a ma lags la khyed rang gi khyim gi skor zhu skabs ngo shes rnying pa red gsungs kyang nga ngo mkhyen gyi ma red ’ces u tshugs kyis khrom gzigs sgang nas mar rgya ma lnga nyos te phyin/kho'i khyim ni lha ldan grong gi gtsug lag khang dang thag nye ba'i srang lam gu dog po zhig gi rgyud du gnas yod pa dang / srang lam de'i g.yas g.yon gyi khang pa rnying song de tsho'i sgo dang sge'u khung nas nyams gud song ba dang gna' nyams 'dres ma'i mdangs shig mngon yong gin yod la/ kho tsho'i sgo ra'i nang kham sdong chen po zhig dang de'i 'khris su rgyug sgrom can gyi khron pa zhig yod pa des de bas mi la gna' nyams dang snga srol rjes dran gyi snang ba zhig ster bar byed/kho gnyis sgo ra'i nang 'byor skabs a ma skyid 'dzoms khron pa nas chu len bzhin yod pa dang chu zom khengs pa'i skabs rang gi brtse ba'i bu dang ma 'ongs pa'i mna' ma yong ba dang tag tag 'khel bas bkra shis rten 'brel gyi rnam rtog bzang po zhig gis a ma'i sems la spro ba chen po 'phel te‘‘bu log yong pas/ bu rang gis ma bshad kyang a mas shes song / bu mo rang pad 275

dbyangs red pā/ rang gi da lta'i byad dbyibs dang rang gi a ma chung dus gcig pa gcig rkyang red 'dug khong gzhon nu ma'i skabs nga tsho'i gzhung gi pho brgya sems pa shor sa dang / mo brgya snying rlung langs dgos pa'i mdzes ma red’ ces shod kyin 'dzum shig shig ngang mo'i lag nas 'jus te khyim du 'khrid/kho'i pha ma gnyis kyis pad dbyangs la ja dang kha zas yang yang drangs te sne len zhu bzhin bstan 'dzin gyi dge mtshan mang dag bshad/ a ma skyid 'dzoms kyis lag pa g.yas pas am phrag nang nas sna ru blangs pa dang sen mo'i steng sna tha phran tsam blugs rjes nor bu zhig la nyams dpyod pa bzhin pad dbyangs la zhib par bltas pa dang blo la babs pa zhig byung bas sems kyi rdog khres chen po zhig phab thub pa ltar gyi dga' snang dang lhug shig shig gi snang ba 'char/ mos lkog tu rang gi khyo bor‘‘ yang na hob ste bltas nas shes/ yang na zhag gsum gshib pas shes zhes pa ltar bu mo 'di yid la 'thad po zhig 'dug khyim tshang gnyis kyang rgyus mnga' yod pas snga tsam thag bcad na yag gi ma red dam ’zhes shab shub tu smras/ nyin dgung lto chas mnyam du bzas pa dang rim bzhin 'dris gshib byung nas gleng mol je mang du song /bstan 'dzin gyi pha rab rgyas ni rgyun du nas skad cha shod rgyur dga' po med la shod kyang mi shes pas nam rgyun khyim gyi kha don tshang ma a mas byed dgos kyi yod/ 'on te de ring ni rang gi bu'i ma 'ongs pa'i mna' ma khyim du 'byor nas sems pa ha cang dga' po byung bas‘‘bu mo/ nga tsho'i bu da lta lo 276

chung chung ma red/ bu mo zhig la mtshon na'ang chung dus khyim so zin na yag gi red/ khyod kyi pha ma gnyis dang nga tsho sngon ma gzhung gcig yin pa dang pha 'das po de dang mnyam las gcig nang las ka byed myong/ khong ni gzhung drang ba'i mi bla ma dkon mchog cig dang sems chung ya rabs dang / mi gzhan la bsam gzhigs thub mkhan zhig yin pas bu mo rang gi tshod la nga tsho sems khral ci yang mi 'dug da dung khyod rang la gcung po zhig yong sa yod ’mi pa pha'i skad cha'i mjug ma rdzogs gong pad dbyangs kyis‘‘gcung mo red/ gcung mo slob grwa thon nas slob grwa chung ba'i dge rgan byed kyi yod ’zer/‘‘byas na a ma lags skyid po byed pa'i dus shar ba red/ nga tsho ma mjal bar lo shas phyin song / nga gnyis ma gzhi byas na snga sa nas khong la blta bar 'gro dgos pa red/ da lta khyed gnyis kyi 'brel ba 'di 'dra yin dus nga tsho gang mgyogs khong la bka' mol zhu bar 'gro gin yin’’a ma 'dzoms skyid lags kyis kha phrogs nas de ltar bshad/ bstan 'dzin gyi pha ma gnyis pos sems rtsa 'khol po 'di ltar byed dus mo sems 'gul chen po thebs pa dang ha lam rang sems kyi chu rags mthon po de rang dbang med par kha shor grabs byas/ de ltar lags kyang mos bsam pa nang du chud nas‘‘pā lags dang a ma lags/ nga'i a ma lags kyis phru gu'i 'gro stangs bzo rgyu'i thad rtag par skyes khungs gtsang ma zhig dang / chang mi 'thung bar nga la brtse po byed mkhan zhig byung na gtso bo so sos thag gcod gsung gi red/ bstan 'dzin lags mi blo 'khel po zhig yin pas nga gnyis mthun po yong gi red/ khyed gnyis thugs 277

khral mi dgos zhes shod bzhin kho la lta tsam byas/ 'on kyang mo'i bsam blo'i nang du phugs 'dun chen po zhig bsgrub rgyu'i dam bca' zhig snga sa nas bkod yod pas 'phral du gnyen sgrig bya min thad lan kha gsal zhig ma brgyab/—2gepad dbyangs kyis re sgug dang gra sgrig ang gsar byas pa'i dngos gzhi'i slob grwa chen mor rgyugs sprod pa'i dus 'char la nye/mo'i las rogs rgya mo 'ga' yod pa de dag ni phru gu bzhag nas mtshan mo'i slob grwar 'gro ba dang / nyin mo sman khang nang du'ang deb 'khyer te zhar dang zhor la bskyar sbyong byed bzhin 'dug 'on te mo yig rgyugs nang zhugs rgyu'i gra sgrig byed skabs bstan 'dzin gyis ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byed pa ma zad/ tha na mo'i grogs mo nye shos zla sgron gyis kyang‘‘grogs mo rang mi tshe zhi mi'i al stong tsam la da lta'i gla phogs de ma chad ba mo'i 'o ma ltar blangs te mi sdod par rang sdug rang gis nyos nas ci byed/ nga ni da cha yig tshad kyi skor rna bar thos na'ang zhe mer ldang gi 'dug’ ces rgyab skyor byed mkhan ma byung /pad dbyangs kyis de dag la snang 'jog ma byas par sngon bkod 'char gzhi ltar bstan 'dzin gyi lkog tu yig rgyugs sprod rgyu'i ming tho bkod pa dang sbrags yig rgyugs nang zhugs/ nyin zhig pad dbyangs kyis bstan 'dzin la kha par brgyab ste las ka grol rjes mo'i nyal khang du yong dgos pa'i re ba bton/ mos rang 'gul gyis kho mgron pa ha cang nyung bas bstan 'dzin dga' thag chod nas las ka grol rjes gyon pa gtsang ma zhig gyon ste spro ba chen 278

pos mo'i nyal khang du yong / kho sgo 'dzul nas lta skabs pad dbyangs cog tse'i 'khris kyi rkub stegs thog 'dzum shig ger khor sgug nas bsdad yod pa dang / stabs bde'i cog tse de'i thog tshal sne kha kha shas dang sbi rag shel dam kha shas bsgrig yod pa mthong bas khos‘‘a tsi/ nga'i yid 'phrog lha mo/ de ring ston mo gra rgyas po 'di 'dra bshams te nga la gtam bzang ga re shod rtsis yod dam/ tan tan nga'i 'gyur ba med pa'i brtse dung gi bdud rtsis nga'i yid 'phrog lha mo'i ha cang mkhregs pa'i sems kyi rdo yang 'tshos pa yin gyi red’’ces mo la 'khyud rtsis byas/ pad dbyangs kyis kho sdod du bcug nas‘‘khyed rang la bsam rgyu dran rgyu de rang las med pa 'dra/ sngon la zhal lag mchod/kha lag za gyin ngas khyed rang la don dag cig gros bsdur byed dgos yod ’ces ghi la si'i nang sbi rag blugs te‘‘sngon la sbi rag 'di mnyes dag gnongs dang’’zhes bstan 'dzin gyi lag tu sprad/ khos ci zhig rdzi rig pa bzhin bzhin gyi 'dzum mdangs kyang de mar bsdus pa dang snyi la si cog tse'i steng du 'jog bzhin‘‘sngon la gnas tshul gsal po shod dang zhes smras/kho dga' po ma byung ba shes te pad dbyangs kho'i gam du bcar thog‘‘nga snga rting ma gtogs gang ltar khyed rang gi mi red/ ngas gdeng tshod de tsam med par yig rgyugs btang bas stabs legs nas lon 'dug khyed rang gis ’ mo'i skad cha'i mjug ma rdzogs gong bstan 'dzin gyis‘‘da gsungs mi dgos/ ngas snga sa nas gnas tshul 'di 'dra zhig yong gi red bsams nas bsdad yod/ skad cha de nga gnyis ngo shes pa nas da bar nga'i rna 279

bar gzan shos dang sems la rgyag shos de yin zhes sbi rag bstud mar zhabs tag gsum brgyab/ de rjes phu shor shor ngang yar langs te‘‘phar ri'i lcang ma gug gug tshur ri'i glang ma gug gug gug na phar gug tshur gug ma gug rang rang so so/ da ngas khyed rang la u tshugs zhus mi yong / bzhugs gdan 'jags dgos mizhes de nas kha gyes/ pad dbyangs kho'i rjes la rgyugs te‘‘bstan 'dzin lags/ sngon la nga'i skad char gsan dang’’zhes rjes 'ded nas bos kyang khos phyi ltas tsam med par shar rer song /char pa sim sim zhig 'bab bzhin yod pas nam mkha' 'thibs la khor yug dben zhing 'jam/ ma gzhi gnas tshul gyi mjug 'bras de 'dra zhig yong rgyur thog ma nas bsam tshod thub na'ang mo'i byis blos ma bzhag par gcig byas na khos bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu'i re ba byas/ 'on kyang bstan 'dzin phyi bltas tsam med par srang lam gyi zur nas yal bas mo yi thang chad nas mgo bo smad cing phrag pa glod/ gom pa dal bus nyal khang du log mo nyalakhri'i zur du hon 'thor rer bsdad yod pa'i skabs zla sgron las ka grol nas phu shor shor ngang log slebs pa dang cog tse'i steng gyi tshal mthong bas‘‘a tsi/ nga'i grogs mo la mngon shes yod pa 'dra/ de ring nad pa mang bas nga grod pa ltogs nas shi grabs byed kyi 'dug tshal gra rgyas po 'di 'dra zhig gis nga sgug nas yod 'gro snyam pa ma byung zhes pad dbyangs la lta tsam ma byas par tshal sna kha re nas kha gang re za bzhin‘‘lag rtsal yar thon ha cang chen po byung 'dug ’ ces bsngags brjod byas/ 'on kyang pad dbyangs ci yang mi smra bar 280

nyal khri'i zur du bsdad yod pas da gzod zla sgron gyis mo'i bzhin la lta bzhin‘‘ga re byas song ngamami zhes dris/ pad dbyangs kyi 'dren byed gnyis las mchi ma'i mu tig gi thag pa chad 'go tshugs pa dang skad cha ci yang ma bshad par mgo bo nyal chas la btsugs te ngus / zla sgron gyis lag nang gi kho'e tse phar bzhag nas mo'i khris su bcar te‘‘ga re/ khong gis brnyas bcos bshad e byung’’ pad dbyangs kyis ngu gin du gnas tshul gyi mgo mjug tshang ma bshad/zla sgron gad mo chen po shor nas‘‘nga'i sems la gnas tshul chen po ga re lhags pa yin nam bsam byung / de ni gnas tshul yag po zhig red/ da thengs kyi gnas tshul de ni bstan 'dzin lags khyed rang la kha zhe gnyis med kyis brtse po yod pa'i rtags red/ blo bde po gyis/ nyin gcig kyang mi 'gor bar khong tan tan 'tshol bar yong gi red/ 'on kyang phangs pa zhig la nga la da bar skyes pa 'di 'dra zhig ma thug pa ga re yin nam/ hu/ de tsho bshad nas ci byed/de las sngon la kha lag za bar shog ces mo'i lag nas bzung ste cog tse'i mdun du 'then nas u tshugs kyis kha lag za ru bcug pa dang sbi rag kyang zhabs btags rgyag res byas te re zhig song mtshams grogs mo gnyis rags tsam bzi nas chang gzhas gtong bzhin mchis/—2—nyin shas 'das na'ang bstan 'dzin gyis pad dbyangs la kha par tsam yang rgyag mkhan med pas pad dbyangs sems 'tshab nas slar yang kho skad gtong bar 'dod/ 'on kyang de ltar byas na kho la mgo btags zhus pa dang 281

'dra bas rang nyid slob chen du 'gro rgyu'i bsam 'dun de 'gog srid pas 'brel ba byed ma phod/ dus kyi 'gros dang bstun nas mo'i sems nang bsam rgyu bstan 'dzin las med pa dang / dran rgyu yang kho las med pas las shag gi kha par thir sgra sgrog skabs lam seng blangs te kho'i yin pa'i re ba chen po bcang yang kha par 'byor thengs re res mo yid thang re chad du bcugasngar bzhin kho'i skad kyi brag cha tsam thos rgyu med la lus kyi grib ma tsam mthong rgyu med pas mo'i sems la dogs 'char sna tshogs skyes pa dang smra ba nyung la 'gul rgyu med pa byi'u chung la rdo phog ltar chags nas las ka'i thog tu'ang sems mi gnas par gyur/ ‘‘em rje lags/ de ring sman brjes pa red dmarimind pa'i skad cha de go ba dang dran pa nang du khug nas lta skabs nyal khri gsum pa dang bzhi pa'i sman sprod stangs nor ba shes pas 'tshab 'tshub ngang‘‘dgongs pa ma tshom’’ zhes dngangs skrag gis rna rtse yang dmar por gyur/dpon phebs nyes dang g.yog sdod nyes kyi dpe ltar de dus tag tag sman g.yog gi 'go 'dzin nad khang du lta skor la yong ba dang 'khel bas nad pa'i mdun du mo la skyon brjod phog pa ma zad tshogs 'du'i thog ming 'don skyon brjod byas/mtshan mo'i las res byas nas zhogs pa'i las res rtsis sprad rjes nyal khang nang log nas gnyid nyal rtsis byas kyang snga rjes kyi gnas tshul de dag mo'i klad pa'i nang dra ba 'dzing nas mgo bo gas grabs yod pa ltar gyur nas gnyid dzi ma gang ma khug mo yar langs nas ngo gdong a cor rlon pas 'phur tsam 282

byas te a ma'i sar loga.a mas bzhin ras skya bor gyur pa'i bu mo mthong ba dang ha las nas‘‘a tsi/ pad dbyangs/ khyod mi bde ba 'dug gam’’zhes mo'i ngo gdong la zhib par bltas pas pad dbyangs kyis‘‘a ma lags ni de 'dra ma gzigs dang /nga mdang nub las res 'khel nas gnyid med pas yin gyi redami’ces g.yol thabs byas/ a mas brel 'tshub ngang mo la ja blugs/ dkar g.yol nang rtsam pa dang mar phyur 'debs bzhin‘‘byas na ja 'dur tsha po zhig bldags nas gnyid nyol shog de ring ngal gso yin na nga bu mo rang la skad cha cig shod dgos yodami’ces smras/ pad dbyangs zhogs zas za 'dod ma byung yang a mas chung dus ltar 'khris su srung nas bsdad/ ji ltar na'ang dang ga gtan nas med pas ja 'dur dkar yol nang a log rgyag gin bsdad/ zhogs zas grub rje sa a snu/sa lam seng pad dbyangs khang pa sbug tu nyal bar 'gro dgos zhes nyal sa bzo ru phyin/ pad dbyangs a ma'i rjes la 'gro gin‘‘spo ma lags/nga da lta nyal 'dod mi 'dug de las gyon pa bkru rgyu 'dra med dam’’zhes dris/a mas‘‘a ma mi gcig gi gyon pa so sos bkru mi thub pa mi 'dug’’ces bshad/ma smad gnyis mnyam du khrom gzigs sgang nas tshal phran tsam nyos pa dang sbrags bar skor la skor ba zhig rgyag zhor nye dus kyi 'tsho ba dang las ka'i skor gleng mol byed bzhin yud tsam song rjes a mas‘‘ngas pad dbyangs rang la skad cha zhig 'dri rgyu yod/ khyod rang dang bu bstan 'dzin gyi 'brel ba de yang snying ji 'dra bya rtsis yod dam/ bstan 'dzin gyi pha ma yong nas slong chang yang 283

btang byung / 'on kyang khyod kyis nga la gsal po ma bshad pas ngas thag bcad med/ gal te bu mo rang gi blo la yod na khong tsho mi rgyud yag po red/nga'i sems la'ang bu mo rang chung dus slob grwar phyin tshar ba dang da cha khyim so zin pa'i dus la slebs pas mu mthud slob grwar song na cho e yod snyam gyin 'dug’’ces kha ta byas/ pad dbyangs kyis der yin min gyin lan ci yang ma btab kyang sems nang a mas kyang de ltar bsam gyin yod pa red snyam/ nyin gung lto chas grub rjes pad dbyangs rig pa lhag par nyob pas khang pa sbug ma de'i nang gnyid du yur/mcho stod ngang pa ser po/—1—nam mkha' g.ya' dag la sprin dkar phang phung lang ma ling du g.yo ba'i zhogs pa zhig mos bod chas gsar rkyang zhig gyon te grung sha dod pos srang lam mang po zhig brgyud rjes thang sder yangs po zhig tu slebs pa dang / thang sder nub ngos kyi khang brtsegs mthon po zhig gi gyang ldebs su ming tho bkod pa'i shog bu dmar po chen po zhig sbyar nas yod pa de'i 'khris su grog tshang rdol ba lta bu'i mi tshogs 'tshang kha brgyab ste ci zhig la lta bzhin yod pas mos kyang rkang pa'i rting ka bkyag ste u tshugs kyis ga re yod min e mthong bltas/'on kyang mo rang gzugs stobs chung drags zhing 'tshang kha'i dkyil du gtan nas mi thar bas dngangs skrag chen po langs/ mtshams der mi tshogs khrod 284

nas phyu pa dkar po gyon pa'i pho gsar zhig gis mo zur du 'then te‘‘pad dbyangs/ bkra shis bde legasami’zhes mo'i lag tu gzengs bstod lag khyer 'dra ba'i dngos po zhig sprad/ mos kha phye nas lta skabs de ni slob bsdu'i brda tho zhig yin pa dang da gzod rang nyid de gar slob bsdu'i brda tho sgug par yong ba dran/ mgo bo yar btegs te lta skabs mi de gar song cha med du gyur pa dang 'khris kyi 'tshang kha rgyag mkhan mi tshogs kyang mi 'dug mos mi de btsalanas thugs rje che zhu dgos snyam pa dang dmigs yul med par kha shar phyogs su gtad de rgyugs/ glo bur du mo ri mgo mthon po zhig gi steng la slebs yod pas kha gnam la gtad de‘‘dkon mchog gis gzigs nas nga'i bsamadon 'grub songamimizhes dga' mchongs brgyab/ ‘dkon mchog gis gzigs nas gzigs nas ’’mo'i skad kyi brag cha zhig mtho sa nas dma' sar khyab pa dang je ring nas je ring du song ste mthar ci yang thos rgyu med par gyur/ glo bur du rlung 'tshub zhig langs te mo'i lag nang gi shog byang de lhags pa nag po zhig gis hab 'phrog byas pa ltar lag pa nas shor ba dang rdul rlung gi khrod du 'dres nas 'phur bzhin yod pas mos nus shugs gang yod kyis ded pa'i tshe mo yang dal bu dal bus sa nas 'phags pa dang re zhig 'phur rjes 'phur rtsal rdzogs nas gcong rong zhig tu lhungs/ mo dngangs skrag gis rab tu mnar nas dus nam zhig sa steng du lhung gi red dam snyam pa dang sa steng du lhung tshe sha 'thor rus 'thor 'gro nges red snyam pa'i skabs bstan 'dzin la gshog pa yod pa ltar mo'i mdun du 285

'phur yong bzhin‘‘nga yong gi yod mices pa'i skad sgra ma rdzogs gong mo rang dal bur kho'i pang du lhungs/ da lta'i dngangs skrag zhogs pa'i na bun la nyi ma phog pa bzhin gar song cha med du gyur pa dang mo bde bas rab tu myos te 'dren byed kyang btsum/ re zhig song mtshams slar yang mig gdang skabs bstan 'dzin gar song med par so so sngar bzhin mkha' dbyings nas gangs kyi 'dab ma bzhin sa ngos su dal bus lhung bzhin yod pas/ skad gcig tsam gyi yun thung nang mo'i snang ngor de ni rmi lam 'dra la mngon sum yang yin pa'i rnam rtog skyes pa dang dngangs skrag langs nas gnyid las sad/ lus yongs rngul chus brlan pa dang lag pas nyal chas dam du bzung nas bsdad yod pa rtogs/ da lta'i gnas tshul de rmi lam mam yang na mngon sum ci yin dran pa nang du bkug nas dran gso byed pa'i skabs‘‘thag thag’’ces sgo brdungs pa'i sgra zhig thos pa dang a mas sgo phye nas ci zhig bshad pas mo'i bsam par a ma'i ngo shes shig yin gyi red snyam/ 'das ma thag pa'i rmi lam de ni ji 'dra'i gsal la reg tshor yang yod pa mngon sum 'khrul med du snang bas mo'i dngangs skrag da dung yang ma 'jags par mu mthud mi lam la phyir dran byed skabs rna lam du rgyus mnga' che ba'i skad sgra de thos/ pad dbyangs dga' yang dga' la khong khro yang za nas yod rnga/'i skabs der khang pa'i sgo dal bus phye nas bstan 'dzin 'dzul yong / mo'i lus sems dga' bde'i spu long g.yos kyang pha ma dang yun ring bral ba'i phru gu pha mar phrad skabs re zhig ngo ma shes bltas nas yus shod pa bzhin/ mos kyang kho la lta tsam yang ma byas par 286

'dren byed btsum nas 'gul tsam yang ma byas/khos ci yang mi bshad par mo'i 'gram sha mnyen po der so so'i gdong sbyar tsam byas pa dang lag pas mo'i gzengs mtho la 'drong ba'i snom byed steng nas bzhur bzhin pa'i mig chu ring po de phyis/ de ltar byas kyang mos kha ya mi byed pas khos nyal chas bshus te mo pang du btab pa dang mo'i gdong la 'o tsha po sbyar/ skabs der mo'i brang kha'i 'o 'dzin zung mgar ba'i sbud pa ltar 'phar lding byed pa dang glo bur du kho la dam du 'khyud pa'i tshul de ni 'jigs pa las thar ba'i bu chung ma yi pang du log pa dang gnyis su ma mchis/khos mo'i rna lam du‘‘pad dbyangs lags/ ngas khyed rang thar par gtong gi min zhes lab myong / gzigs dang’’zhes pad dbyangs nyal khri'i steng du bzhag pa dang ko ba'i khug ma'i nang nas lag 'khyer dmar po gnyis bton te mo'i lag tu sprad/ mos der snang 'jog med par chu ris shig shig gi 'dren byed gnyis kho'i gdong la cer nas bltas/ bstan 'dzin gyis‘‘khyed rang gi 'dren byed kyi me dbal gyis nga bsreg grabs byed kyin 'dug de las sngon la 'di la gzigs dang’’zhes ngo gdong nas rgyal kha thob pa'i dpa' nyams mngon yong / de ni gnyen sgrig lag 'khyer yin zhing / de'i thog kho gnyis kyi 'dra par sbyar ba dang ming bkod nas lcags the'u yang brgyab yod pas mo hang sangs te‘‘'di 'di/ ngas mos mthun ga dus byas pa red dam/ngas ma shes pa ga re yin nam’’zhes dngangs skrag chen po langs/kho la grogs po mang po yod pas sman khang gi lus dpyad spa se dang 287

dmangs srid las khungs kyi gnyen sgrig lag khyer gyi thel tse tshang ma grogs po tsho brgyud nas 'gro lugs gnyer/ kho'i sems la gal te gnyen sgrig gi lag khyer blangs grub na pad dbyangs kyis u tshugs mtha' skyel byed mi srid la byed phod kyi ma red snyam mod/ mo'i tshur snang lan cha lhag tu drags pas rang gi rmongs tshod kyi byed stangs la 'gyod pa cung skyes pa dang / gnas tshul bsam 'dun las ldog nas dge mtshan med pa'i phyogs su 'gro dogs kyi sems khral langs/‘‘nga'i sems la khyed rang mi spro ba 'di 'dra yong gi red bsam ma byung / gal srid khyed rang mos mthun rtsa ba nas med na a ne+es btsugs pa'i zam par a rna so so thar ba bya rgyu red/ lag khyer shog 'dzar tsam yin pas don ngo ma'i gnas tshul gsal bshad gang yang thub kyi ma red/ ngas phyir slog chog ’ces bshad/ pad dbyangs kyis‘‘khyed rang blangs chog chog dang slog chog chogabasam blo sngon nas ma btang bar ci byed/ khyed rang rang shed che thag chod nas nga la bsam blo gtong ba'i dus tshod kyang sprod kyin mi 'dug ces kho'i sgal par khu mtshur yang por gzhu bzhin gces su 'os pa'i spor gcus kyi rnam 'gyur zhig bstan/mtshams der bstan 'dzin gyis kyang rang gi sla yos tsha ba'i phru gu zhig gi ngo bsu ba bzhin mo slar yang pang du blangs nas bzhin ras thog gi dbang po gang yod la 'o byas/ pad dbyangs kyis‘‘lkugs pa u tshugs tsha ba'i khyed rang dang mnyam du gnyen sgrig bya rgyu byung ba de yang nga'i bde ba zhig dang bskos skal zhig yin pa red ces mos mthun yod pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/288

bkra shis pa'i gnas tshul de phyogs gnyis kyi pha mar lam seng bshad pas tshang ma da gzod blo bde po byung / gnyen sgrig rten 'brel de nang khul du rags tsam byas rjes a gsar zla ba jide/ rgya nag tu yul skor spro 'cham la 'gro rgyu gtan 'khel bas/ som nyi dngaphangs sems kyis langs long du g.yo ba'i pad dbyangs kyi sems pa'ang lang long du 'khol bzhin pa'i ja la chu grang mo blugs pa bzhin da gzod zhi 'jam dang lhing 'jags su gyur/ kho gnyis khyim nas rdog thon byed pa'i zhogs pa zla sgron yang skyel mar thon zhing / mos pad dbyangs zur zhig tu skad btang nas gso rig slob grwa chen mo zhig gis bsdus pa'i slob tshud brda tho de sprod bzhin‘‘a cag rang 'di 'dra zer 'gro mkhan yin nam/ de ni rang gis yun ring re sgug dang 'bad brtson byas pa'i 'bras bu ma red dam’’zhes som nyi'i mig gis grogs mo la lta bzhin smras/ pad dbyangs kyis brda tho de lag tu blangs nas brang khar sbyar tsam byas pa dang ko ba'i khug ma'i nang blugs pa dang zla sgron la dam por 'thams pa las smra ba tshig gcig kyang ma bshad/ ‘‘pad dbyangs lags gra sgrig tshar song ngam mo ṭa 'byor songami bstan 'dzin gyis skad brgyab yong gin yod pas pad dbyangs kyis‘‘tshar song tshar song ’zhes blo thag chod pos lan btab/ skabs de'i pad dbyangs kyi byed stangs las mo'i sems nang gi 'gal zla drag po de zla sgron la'ang tshor ba shugs chen byung ba dang‘‘tshar song tshar songami’zhes pa'i skad cha de grasgrig tshar song zhes brjod pa min par don dag gzhan zhig la brjod kyin yod pa'i snang ba byung na'ang ci yang smra ma shes/289

da 2da mi lam zhig dang 'dra bar dgung sngon dbyings nas nam 'phang bcad de khren tu'u ru 'byor ba dang de rjes slar yang chu thog dang skam thog nas le dbar mang po zhig brgyud rjes grags che la re smon byed myong ba'i rgya nag gi lho phyogs su 'byor nas mig gis yul ljongs gsar pa'i ltad mo mi nyung ba zhig mthong ba dang rna bar bstan 'dzin gyi snyan pa'i snying gtam mang po zhig go yang mo'i lag tu brda tho 'byor ba'i nyin nas bzung lhing 'jags sems kyi mtsho mor slar yang drag po'i rlung gis skul nas nyin shas gong gi spro snang de 'dra med par dbugs ring yang yang shor/ 'on kyang bstan 'dzin gyis mo'i re ba de gtan nas skong mi srid pas kho la brda tho 'byor ba'i skor tsam yang ma bshad/ de bas brda tho de gzugs dang grib ma bzhin rang lus dang 'bral med 'khyer/ skabs re kho med pa'i dus tshod phran bu re byung na khyo bo'i lkog tu zur brten snying sdug gi 'dra par la lta ba bzhin yang nas yang du bltas nas sems kyi stong cha gsab thabs byas/dgong mo zhig kho gnyis nyal khar pad dbyangs kyis lag khyer khug ma'i nang las ci zhig 'don rtsis byed skabs slob tshud brda tho de sa steng du zagabastan 'dzin gyis snang ba de tsam med pa'i sgo nas‘‘ga re red dam’’zhes sgrug rtsis byed skabs pad dbyangs kyis gsang ba gal chen zhig mis shes par dogs pa bzhin mgyogs po sgrug nas khug ma'i nang 'jug bzhin‘‘spyir btang gi gsal bshad deb chung zhig red ’ces snang med du bzhag don dngos thog 290

mo'i slob tshud brda tho de bstan 'dzin gyis snga sa nas mthong zin na'ang ma shes pa'i khul byas te bsdad/ bstan 'dzin gyis lag gnyis ltag khung du snol mar bzhag nas yud tsam khu sim mer bsdad/ re zhig song rjes khos‘‘khyed rang gis nga la gsang mi dgos/ de ngas snga sa nas shes byungari’ pad dbyangs kyis der lan ci yang ma btab par bsdad/ khos mo'i gdong la byug byug byed kyin‘‘pad dbyangs lags/ bud med cig gi ngos nas bshad na rang la khyo ga yag po zhig dang khyim tshang bde skyid ldan pa zhig byung na de phal cher bya gzhag gang 'dra zhig las kyang gal che/ nga'i sems la ga dus yin na'ang nga bstan 'dzin gyisakhyed rang sdug tu mi 'jug pa zhig byas ang snyam gyi yod/ yin na yang khyed rang slob grwa chen mor 'gro rgyur zhen chags 'di 'dra yod pa mthong dus ngas nor pa min nam snyam sems pa skyid po gtan nas mi 'dug da res bza' tshang gi a gsar zla ba'i nang mnyam du yul skor la yong nas khyed rang gi sems lhod la babs yod shag byas kyang blo phangs pa zhig la ngas khyed rang la bde skyid kyis snang ba gang yang byung yod bzo mi 'dug ’ces blo pham chen po byas/ der mos lan ci yang 'debs ma shes par mgo bo smad pa dang khug ma la lag rtsed rtse bzhin mu mthud kho'i skad char nyan nas bsdad/ bstan 'dzin gyis‘‘rjes su go skabs yod pas ngas ’zhes skad shugs kyang che ru btang nas shod rtsis byed skabs mos kho'i kha bkag nas‘‘bstan 'dzin lags/ de khyed rang gis lan pa ga la yin/ nga dngos gnas 'gyod pa gang yang med/da nas nga'i byed stangs la sgyur bcos btang chog khyed rang la nyes pa gang 291

yang med pas blo bde po gyis dang zhes kho la sems gso kyin dam du 'khyud/skabs der gnyis ka'i sems la so sos gcig shos la ci zhig chad pa'i snang ba dus gcig tu shar ba dang kha nas ma smras kyang gnyis ka'i sems nang tshor snang byung /na so gzhon pa'i khyo shug gnyis sems pa'i nang gi som nyi'i mdud pa grol bas slar yang bde skyid kyi kho lag yangs por grol/ kho gnyis hong hran ri bo'i mgron bsu'i som shing mdun du dran rten gyi 'dra par brgyab pa dang /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i brag la gnyis ka'i ming brkos te tshe 'dir mtsho stod ngang pa ser po'i rnam thar bzung nas za rgyu 'dam las med kyang mnyam za mnyam 'thung bya rgyu dang tshe phyi mar yang mnyam 'dzoms yong ba'i smon lam btab/mi gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi 'tsho ba'i a gsar ma yal gong pad dbyangs la gzugs po 'khor/ mo'i 'dod blo ltar na phru gu 'khor rgyu snga drags na'ang bstan 'dzin gyi 'dod thog la rta rgyugs pas/ pad dbyangs la gzugs po 'khor ba shes pa nas bzung khos nang las tshang ma 'gan gtsang blangs te mo chu la mdzub mo btsugs tsam byed du ma bcug par/ las khungs kyi las ka grol rjes tshe dpag lha khang la skor ba gsog par ma song na rbad de brnyan 'phrin bltas nas sdod du 'jug gi yod pas/ pad dbyangs kyi sems la sngar byung myong med pa'i dro skyid dang byams skyong gi tshor snang dpag tu med pa thob pa dang da gzod rang nyid kyi gdam kha nor mi 'dug ang snyam ste mi tshe la gdeng tshod dang yid ches kyis khengs/ 292

bstan 'dzin ni zhib tshags pa'i skyes pa zhig yin pas bu rdzi mar lto thengs 'di la bya sha'i thang dang / lto thengs rjes mar nya sha'i thang la sogs 'tsho bcud kha gsab dang snyoms sgrig la do snang byed pa dang / lto dus mi re ngo rer shing 'bras rgyun 'khyongs za ru 'jug gin yod pas mo'i lus khams rab tu rgyas te bzhin ras kyang lto ba dang mnyam du je sgor dang je rgyas su song nas dkar nag dwangs la kri ka mdzes pa'i 'dren byed gnyis kyang chung du song ba'i snang ba ster/ pad dbyangs gyi a mas snang tshul de mthong skabs blo yid rab tu tshim nas lkog tu pad dbyangs la skyid tshor dang chog shes byed dgos zhes bslab bya byed pa dang / bstan 'dzin gyi a mas‘‘nga'i bu 'di la pā lags kyi gshis ka ngan pa'i shul tsam mi 'dug’ ces pad dbyangs kyi mdun du phrag dog dang dga' snang gnyis ldan gyis bsngags brjod byed pa dang / khos skyes dman la tshad las 'das pa'i byams skyong byed pa mthong dus cung blo ma bde na'ang / bstan 'dzin bza' tsho gnyis kyi ngo shes dang grong pa khyim mtshes tsho'i khrod du bstan 'dzin ni bud med tshos rang gi khyo ga la ma 'grig ma 'thus shod skabs kyi tshad gzhi 'dzin sar gyur/ zla ba dgu dang ngo bcu shar rjes mo la phru gu gzig phrug 'dra ba zhig skyes pa ma zad/ ma bu bde grol byung ba des kho tsho'i khyim tshang chung chung der sngar las lhag pa'i spro bas khengs/bu la ming gzhan dang mi 'dra la spyir btang min pa zhig 'dogs ched du bstan 'dzin gyis tshig mdzod mang po zhig bsngogs nas ming sna tshogs gra sgrig byas pa dang / de dag 'phrod las blo la babs pa zhig 'dogs rtsis yod kyang 293

rgan rgon tshos khas mi len/ de ltar bu skyes nas zla ba gcig song mtshams la bod zla dang po'i tshes bco lnga 'khel gyin yod pas/ de nyin rgan rgon tsho dang mnyam du bu 'khrid de sngon la rta mgrin zhabs dbang zhus pa dang/ de rjes se ra'i mkhan rin po che'i sku mdun nas bu la ming zhus pas bu'i ming la bstan pa chos grags zhes btags/gzhon nu bza' mi gnyis la khom pa byung tshad bu hab thob kyis pang du 'debs pa dang / mgo bo rub rub byas te kha khyed dang 'dra/ bu'i mig nga dang 'dra po 'dug ces phru gu'i dbang po lnga la zhib tshags pos dpyad pa byed pa dang / so so 'dra sa 'tshol skabs bus kyang rang gi brtse ba'i pha ma gnyis kyi byams brtse shes pa bzhin mig nag hrig hrig gis rang gi pha ma la blta bzhin kha nas‘‘u/ u zhes 'bod pa'i ngang tshul de ni kho gnyis la ci zhig shod bzhin yod pa ltar du snang / yud tsam nas bu pha yi pang du kha khu sim pos gnyid du yur bas khos dal pos bu nyal khri'i thog tu bsnyal rjes skad chung ngus‘‘rnam pa nga gnyis su 'dra yang skyon med/ 'on kyang nga'i re ba la sems brgyud dang gshis ka khyed rang 'dra po zhig byung na de rang gis blo kha khengs songamimizhes bshad/ da cha kho gnyis kyi gtam spyod tshang ma bu dang 'bral du med pa dang bu rang dgar gtan nas ma bzhag par pang par 'debs kyi yod pas rgan 'khogs tshos‘‘phru gu nga tshos kyang gsos nas yong ba red/ phru gu 'o mas grod pa rgyags pa dang rkub skam po byung na gnyid tshu tshod mang po nyal gi red ’ces nyams myong bshad kyang bstan 'dzin gyis skabs re bu gnyid yun ring tsam 294

byung na'ang rkang btsugs nas bu'i sna khug gi 'khris la spu drud de gnyid las slong ba dang / de rjes pang du btab te mi rgan par shod pa ltar skad cha rdzogs rgyu med pa cig shod kyi yod/thengs shig bu bstan pa chos grags tsha ba rgyas nas mtshan gang gnyid ma khug pas khos phru gu pang du btab ste sig sig byed kyin ngu 'jags thabs byed/phru gu'i kha skam pa mthong skabs mar gsar mchu la byugs pa ma zad chu khol grang mo yang yang blud/ yang skabs 'gar a cor chu grang mo'i nang sbangs te bu'i dpral bar sbyar te tsha ba 'jags thabs byas/ de ltar byas kyang tsha ba ma 'jags pas kho thabs zad de 'khyags sgam nang nas 'khyags pa bton te bu'i rkang pa dang / gzugs por phur te bu'i tsha ba 'jags pa dang / yud tsam nas grung du phyin te mig gnyis kho la bltas te‘‘u/ u/’’zhes skad rgyag skabs/ dgun dus kyi mtshan mo ring po de rdzogs nas skya mda' gtong bzhin mchis/ da gzod kho rang blo bde po byung te mig gnyis btsum nas gnyid du yur/ skabs der pad dbyangs yar langs nas bstan 'dzin gyi gnyid du yur pa'i gdong la lta bzhin/ ma gzhi nga rang sman g.yog yin pas phru gu'i g.yog ngas byed dgos kyang / khong nga las zhib tshags pa yod pa dang gnas tshul chung tsag kha shas ngas ma dran par khong gis dran pa 'di 'dra dngos gnas khag po red snyam nas/ kho'i gdong la lta bzhin lta bzhin de bas snying nye ru phyin pa dang rang gi gdam ka dang kho'i u tshugs nor mi 'dug snyam/295

—2—de nas lo shas 'das rjes kyi nyin zhig gi dgong mo bu rdzi ma lha mos thug pa bag thug zhim po zhig bskol yod pas dgong zas tshar rjes kho gnyis 'cham 'cham la phyin/ gnam gshis tsha ba je cher 'gro ba dang bstun nas dgong mo phyi la 'cham 'cham du 'gro mkhan je mang du 'gro bzhin yod cing / la la rgyug shar glod pa dang / la la khyo shug lag gdang sbrel nas 'gro ba/ la la kher rkyang yul yul pos 'cham 'cham byed bzhin yod/ kho gnyis kyis rgyun gtan ltar gang tsam phyin rjes lam zur gyi me tog ldum ra'i sgrom skyor thog bsdad de bsil khug thabs byas/ skabs der pad dbyangs kyis bstan 'dzin gyi lag nas 'jus te‘‘bstan 'dzin lags/ khyed rang gis lo gsum gyi gong la nga'i mdun nas bzhag pa'i dam bca' zhig dran gyin 'dug gam’ 6‘khyed rang ni/ mi ro skam po chu la sbangs nas lo rgan drug cu'i rtsis rgyag mkhan yin nam/ ma gzhi nas ngas khyed rang la dam bca' mang dag bzhag yod pas yang snying ga re'i skor yin nam mibastan 'dzin gyis de ltar shod kyin ya mtshan gyi snang ba zhig skyes te mo'i gdong la lta tsam byed skabs/ mo'i 'dren byed gnyis nas zhu ba 'then pa lta bu'i 'od 'tsher pas khos‘‘dran dang dran/ de ni ngas khyed rang tshe gcig sdug tu mi 'jug rgyu'i dam bca' bzhag pa de yin/ de ngas nam yang brjed mi srid’mices bshad/ pad dbyangs kyis sla g.yos shod bzhin‘‘de nga la yid ches yod/ da dung gzhan zhig dran gyin e 'dug zhes dris pa dang khos mgo bo phred du g.yug tsam byas/ pad dbyangs 296

kyis skad shugs dma' pos‘‘da cha bu yang hra tag tag chags zin pas nga slob grwa chen mor slar yang rgyugs sprod dgos bsam gyin 'dug ces bshad/ skad cha'i mjug ma rdzogs gong nas kho rmongs gnyid las glo bur du sad pa lta bu byung nas‘‘ga re/ da dung sems shi med dam ’zhes rang dbang med par skad cor shor/lo gsum gyi bde skyid ldan pa'i 'tsho ba'i nang pad dbyangs blo bde bag phebs/ su gyur ba dang / tha na slob tshud brda tho de yang rang gi khug ma'i nang nas sa/ dus med par gyur min shod rgyu cang med/ 'on kyang nye dus las khungs kyi sgrig gzhi bcos sgrig dang mi mang po zhig khu bsdu byas/ lhag par du las gnas lag rtsal gyi go ming thob thang dpyad 'dems byed skabs slob rgyus dma' po de rigs la bsam blo yang gtong gin med pas/ lo mang bag la nyal ba'i slob grwa chen mor 'gro rgyu'i bsam tshul la skul slong byung nas yun ring tsam 'das pa dang / de ring bstan 'dzin la shod skabs gra sgrig yun ring byas pa zhig yin pas mo'i sems nang skrag snang med par gyur/ pad dbyangs kyis gnas tshul de'i skor gleng skabs bstan 'dzin gyis‘‘khyed rang ri bong gnamanib kyi sdug bsngal byed dgos ma red/ srid jus dang lam lugs de dag tshang ma rgya nag la ltos nas bton pa yin pas bod du ma mthar yang lo bcu rjes su lus kyi red’’ ces rang gi myong ba dang / bsam tshul rnams dbugs thengs gcig la bshad/pad dbyangs kyis‘‘ngas da lta bar rang re'i khyim tshang 'di 'dzugs ched 297

thams cad blos btang ba yin/ da cha mu mthud de dka' las khag la btsog pa'i sman g.yog byed 'dod mi 'dug de las ngas gso rig slob grwa zhig 'grims/ lo gnyis gsum gyi rjes la khyed rang gi a ce sman g.yog ma yin par sman pa zhig tu 'gyur skabs dga' spro skye ba mi 'dug gam’’‘‘red/ red/ slob grwa chen mo thon pa'i lag 'khyer de nga dang bu las rtsa che ba red/ nga rang u tshugs tsha la rang shed che bas ma gtogs da byed dus nga gnyis gnyen sgrig byas rjes khyed rang slob grwa chen mor 'gro ba'i go skabs shor bas 'gyod gdung kho na'i ngang mi lo hril po gsum bskyal ba red/ de ni don du ngas khyed rang la mnar gcod lo gsum byas pa dang khyad ci yod ’ces bshad/ 'on kyang pad dbyangs kyi sems shugs dang chod sems la bstan 'dzin yang ha las pa dang / mo'i re ba de ma 'grub phyin mi tshe gcig gi 'gyod sems dang sdig nyes su 'gro nyen che bas mthar kho'i 'gog srung gi gyang mkhregs po der kha sho phran bu bton nas mo'i re ba khas ma blangs ka med byung /‘‘'on kyang da res yig rgyugs ma lon tshe de'i skor nam yang gleng rgyu med pa yin no’’zhes bshad pa dang mos kyang de ltar bya rgyu'i khas blangs te ngag thog gi chod don bzhag de ni than pas bzir ba'i me tog la glo bur sbrang char zil ma 'phrad pa ltar byung nas mo'i sems kyi 'dab rgya lhug par grol bas/ sa mchong gnam mchong byed kyin‘‘bstan 'dzin lags/ nga'i sems la'ang khyed rang gis gang ltar mos mthun gnang gi red bsam nas bsdad yod/ dngos gnas nga pad dbyangs gis mi 'tshol stangs nor mi 'dug ces kho'i mjing 298

par 'khyud de dpral pa'i steng 'o zhig byas/mcho la lhags pa ldang song /—1ge pad dbyangs kyis phyi nyin der dpe tshong khang nas bskyar sbyong gi deb cha tshang zhig nyos/ las khungs grol nas kha lag za ba'i dus tshod phud gzhan gyi dus tshod stong pa yod tshad la khang pa sbug tu 'dzul te slob sbyong byed kyin bsdad/ thog ma'i dus su khos mo la chu'am ja gang rung zhig blugs te mo'i 'khris su slob sbyong byed tshul la bltas nas sdod skabs/ mos‘‘bstan 'dzin lags/ khyed rang nga'i 'khris la bsdad na nga'i sems la slob sbyong gtan nas zug gi mi 'dug ’ces bshad pas kho khang pa mdo ru bu la rtsed mo rtsed kyi bsdad/'on kyang chu tshod phyed ka tsam re nas don dag yod med la ma ltos par sgo re brdungs te‘‘sngon la ngal gso tog tsam gyis/ rang gis rang la sdug po btang nas cho yod pa ma red/ yig rgyugs ma lon pa lta zhog tha na mi sna hrag sgrug nang ma tshud na'ang ngas khyed ma bu gnyis gso mi thub pa ga re yod dam mizhes brjod/mo u tshugs tsha bas kho'i gtam la mi nyan par mu mthud dus tshod dam 'dzin gyis sbyangs te kho la kha ya de tsam bya rgyu yong gin med la tha na kha lag za skabs kyang deb kha phye ste lta bzhin yod/ thengs shig nyin dgung lto chas za skabs/mos em rje'i ched las deb la lta bzhin kha lag za gin bsdad pas bstan 'dzin gyis mo'i mdun gyi tshal tshang ma phyir 'then te ji ltar byed min blta 299

skabs/ de mos ma tshor bar mig deb la lta gin kho'e tse sgrog tse'i steng brgyab/bstan 'dzin dang lha mo hab cha chen po shor ba dang go don mi rtogs pa'i bus kyangagad mo bgad/ bstan 'dzin gyis dgod bzhin‘ da khyed rang la deb byung na gzhan gang yang dgos kyi med pa 'dra/ bus a ma zer bos kyang kha ya byed kyi mi 'dug’mices smras pas/ pad dbyangs kyis‘‘bstan 'dzin lags/deganas skabs tsam zhig red/ deng sang las thog slob sbyong gis slob grwar 'gro 'dod yod pa nga gcig pu ma yin par tha na zla sgron yang dbyin skad slob sbyong byed bzhin 'dug’ ces bshad/ bstan 'dzin gyis de la ha las snang mi byed par‘‘de phal cher yang mgo ser kho'i ched du yin gyi red ’ces bshad/pad dbyangs kyis‘‘khyed rang gis de 'dra gsungs mi nyan/ da thengs zla sgron gyis sems nus yod rgu bton nas sbyong thag chod red/ deng sang 'khyams rgyu yang nyung du zhe drag phyin 'dug’ ces zla sgron gyi ched du dag sel byas/ de ltar khos bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan las mos bshad pa'i gnas lugs mang bas khos brnyan phab dpar gzhi mang po zhig g.yar te khang pa gzhan zhig gi nang lta bzhin bsdad/ltad mo'i nang gi sgrung gi 'phel rim ngo mtshar shin tu che ba'i skabs kho'i sems g.yengs nas khang pa sbug gi sgo brdungs te‘‘mgyogs po blta bar shog dang / dgod bro po zhig 'dug le'u 'di tshar song na mu mthud deb blta chog gi red ’ces skad gtong rkyang byed/ de ltar byas na sems rnal du mi 'bab pa dang shes tshad kyang 'gor bas/ pad dbyangs slob grwa zhig gi nang 300

gnyer bzhin pa'i dgong mo'i dus tshod dang res gza' spen pa'i zab sbyong 'dzin grwar zhugs pa dang bstan 'dzin gyis kyang 'khang ra gang yang med par spro ba chen pos pad dbyangs skyel bsu'i 'gan blangs/ dgong mo zhig khos pad dbyangs bskyal te sbag sbag bzhon nas log yong ba'i lam bar du/ las khungs nas phyir 'then byas te tshong rgyag bzhin yod pa'i grogs po dge legs zhes pa zhig yod pa de dang thug yun ring po ma thug pa'i dge legs ni de sngon dang mi 'dra bar lus sha tsho ru song yod pa dang gyon gos gon stangs kyang 'gyur 'dug dge legs kyis bstan 'dzin gyi gnas tshul go ma thag kho gad mo rang dbang med par shor te mgo bo phred du g.yug g.yug byas/ khos‘‘grogs po rang rnam kun thug rgyu mi 'dug do dgong ngas sbyin bdag don chog nga gnyis sa cha skyid po zhig la khyug tsam lhod lhod byas te sdod par 'gromi’zhes bstan 'dzin u tshugs kyis khrid/ kho gnyis srang lam a kyog pa kyog kha shas brgyud rjes phyi ngos nas bltas na sgo dang sge'u khung la sham bu legs po zhig brgyab yod pa dang / sgo yol sngo khra zhig gi steng pa ṭa dkarane po brgyab pa'i ha cang bab chags pa'i bod zas khang zhig gi sgo khar 'byor/ dge legs kyis sgo yol phye ste rgyus mnga' chen pos‘‘sbyin bdag sku khams bzang zhes 'dri mol btang / bod chas spras pa'i bud med bltas bzo dod mdog kha po zhig sbyin bdag gi gnas su langs yod cing / bud med des kho gnyis yong ba mthong 'phral 'dzum dmul dmul ngang tshur yong nas‘‘dge legs lags/ dus tshod ring po zhig phebs ma byung / ngas khyed rang gi lag 'khyer kha par brgyab kyang 301

ga dus yin na'i kha phye mi 'dug phyag dngul lag thogs nas lus pa ni e yin nam/ a tsi sku rtsed zhus/ khyed rang gi phyag rogs rnying pa tsho thog khar yod ces kho gnyis thog khar gdan 'dren zhu rtsis byas/ khos‘6de ring grogs po nga gnyis sbi rag phran tsam btung ste ci gros mol gros bshad de sdod dgos yod/ khyed rang gis lan ta'e lcags krin bcu bsnams phebs dang zhes zur gyi sdod sa zhig bdams nas gdan la 'khod/yud tsam nas bud med des zhabs zhu ma zhig la sbi rag lcags krin blugs pa'i shing khrol zhig bskur/ 'dzum shig shig ngang gcam bsag gi 'gros dang bcas yong nas/ kho gnyis la gsum sgron zhabs tag re bkyags te dge legs la da bar ma yong ba ci yin zhes ku re dang sbrags 'khang ra byas/dge legs kyis nye char rgya nag tu tshong zog 'then par song nas dus khom med lugs dag sel byed kyin dngul khug nas sgor mo brgya lor gcig bton nas shingakhrol nang 'jog rtsis byed skabs/ bud med des kho'i lag pa phyir phud bzhin‘‘'di dag ngas sne len zhus pa yin/ khyed rnam gnyis lhod bzhugs gnang zhig 'on kyang thugs ra ma bad gong la khyed rang gi zhal par ang grangasade mo'i skad cha'i mjug ma rdzogs gong dge legs kyis‘‘ngas khyed rang la zhu rgyu brjed pa red/ nga'i kha par kha sngon rgya nag tu 'gro skabs rkun la shor 'dug deng sang ang grangs gsar pa zhig bed spyod byed kyin yod ‘‘byas na lam seng 'di'i steng bris dang / phar phyin nas deb kyi sgang la 302

bshu gi yinami zhes sha rtsa dkar la rid pa'i lag ngar zhig kho'i mdun du brkyangs/ de rjes bstan 'dzin la bltas te‘‘dge legs lags/ khyed rang gi grogs po da dung ngo sprod gnang ma byung ngo ’zhes bshad pa dang dge legs kyis thod par lag pa gzhu tsam byas tedzi'o tag tag ngas zhu rtsis rang yod/khong nga'i grogs po yag shos bstan 'dzin red/ khong mi dmangs dngul khang las gnyer pu'u yi kho'o krang red/ 'jon thang che la a ce la byams pa/ phyi nang gnyis kar blos thub pa'i mi zhig red mices ngo sprod byas/ de rjes bstan 'dzin la bltas te lag gis brda ston bzhin‘‘sgrol dkar lags/ sems skyid bod zas khang gi sbyin bdag red/ khong gis bod zas khang 'di btsugs nas lo shas phyin pa red/ khong tshong rgyag mkhas drags nas da cha 'byor pa can red domi zhes ngo sprod byas/ thog mar mo bltas bzo dod po zhig mthong na'ang 'khris nas lta skabs dkar dmar byug rdzas mthug po'i 'og nas lo zla'i shul ris gsal po mngon yong pas/ phyi'i bzo lta 'don stangs dang lo tshod bar la ho bag nges can yod par tshod dpag thub/ bud med des5khyed rang nga la 'phya lad bskyon pa ma gnang / 'di dag tshang ma khyed rnams tsho'i lta skyong 'og nas byung ba red/ da dung mu mthud lta skyong zab mo gnang ba'i re ba byed kyi yod7ces slar yang chang dkar btegs nas zhabs tag re zhus rjes sku mgron gzhan la sne len zhu bar song / sgrol dkar rgyab slog ma thag dge legs kyis‘‘ltos dang / ster bzo gang 'dra mi 'dug gam/ skyes pa mang po rkub tshag shor 'gro gi red do ces ha lam rang 303

nyid kyi rgyu rtsa chen zhig ngom so byed pa ltar ngo sprod byas/kho gnyis sbi rag 'thung bzhin tshong gi skor dang / las ka'i skor/ bud med kyi skor/ de bzhin khyim tshang gi skor mang po zhig gleng gin bsdad pas bstan 'dzin yang lhod shig shig dang snang ba skyid po zhig byung /gang tsam nas khos pad dbyangs zab sbyong 'dzin grwar yod pa dran nas chu tshod la lta skabs mo slob tshan grol nas skar ma bcu tsam yol yod pas khos rtab rtob por yar langs te‘‘grogs po/ nga 'gro ran song / a ce slob tshan grol tshar bzhag rjes ma ngas kha par rgyab yong zhes rang gi 'bod brda'i ang grangs bzhag te brel 'tshub ngang nas kha gyes/ bstan 'dzin slob grwa'i sgo khar 'byor skabs glog 'od rab rib kyi 'og tu pad dbyangs gnas bzod mi bde ba'i ngang tshul gyis sgug bsdad yod pas khos‘‘dgongs pa ma tshom de ring nga yun ring ma 'phrad pa'i grogs po zhig dang thug byung bas nga gnyis chang khang zhig tu sbi rag phran bu 'thungs kyin bsdad pa yin/ khyed rang yun ring po sgug dgos ma byung ngam ’zhes brtse ba chen pos dris/ pad dbyangs kyis‘‘nga ni lam bar la ga re byas pa yin nam bsam nas bde 'jags la sems khral byung ma gtogs nga phran bu sgug par skyon ci yod’’ces sbag sbag gi rgyab tu bzhon pa dang kho'i sked par dam du 'khyud de khyim du logakho gnyis mnyam du lhod por sdod pa'i dus tshod nyin gung lto chas za skabs las med pa dang / pad dbyangs sman khang du las res 'khel skabs nyin dgung yang khyim du log thub kyi med/ res gza' spen pa'i nyin la'ang mo 304

slob tshan nyan par 'gro dgos pas mo'i ngos nas bshad na dus tshod ha cang 'gro mgyogs na'ang bstan 'dzin gyi ngos nas bshad na dus tshod thag pas btags pa bzhin 'khyol dka' ba ma zad/ pad dbyangs bskyar sbyong 'go tshugs pa nas bzung khyim gyi de snga'i spro snang gi rnam pa thams cad btsan gyis 'phrog pa ltar gyi snang ba 'char nas/ dgong ltar pad dbyangs slob grwar bskyal rjes khyim du sems rnal la bab nas sdod mi chags par bsdad tshe phyin na bsam/ phyin tshe bsdad na bsam nas g.yo ba'i sems kyis rab tu mnar/—2—gnas tshul de ni 'char gzhi dang gra sgrig gang yang med pa'i gza' nyi ma'i nyin zhig gi zhogs pa nas 'go tshugs/ de nyin zhogs pa pad dbyangs yar langs skabs bstan 'dzin gnyid stug po zhig khug pa'i tshul gyis zhogs nyal brgyab nas bsdad yod pas/ mos nyal chas g.yog skyor zhig byas rjes lto chas bzos te snga tsam slob grwar phyin/ mo khyim nas thon ma thag bstan 'dzin yar langs te zhogs zas bzas/ de rjes dge legs la kha par zhig brgyab/sked pa nas 'bod brda bkrol te cog tse'i steng du bzhag pa dang bu'i 'gram pa'i steng du 'o zhig byas rjes blo thag chod pos sbag sbag bzhon te phyir thon/pad dbyangs slob tshan grol skabs kho bsu bar slebs yod shag gis dus rgyun sgug sar blta skabs kho lta zhog kho'i sbag sbag gi grib ma tsam yang med pas mo rang ya mtshan skyes/ pad dbyangs yud tsam sgug kyang kho ma yong pas sems la phal cher las brel zhig thon pa yin gyi red snyam bzhin khyim du 305

61gasgo rwa'i nang sbag sbag mthong rgyu med pa dang bu'i lag tu kho'i 'bod brda de 'khyer nas rtse mo rtsed bzhin bsdad 'dug pad dbyangs kyis bu pang du blangs nas 'o zhig byas pa dang bu'i gdong la byugs byugs byed kyin‘‘bu/ pā lags ga par phebs song ngamami zhes dris/ bus mgo bo phred du g.yug nas mi shes pa'i tshul bstan/ thab tshang nang lto chas bzo bzhin pa'i lha mo phyir thon yong bzhin‘‘de ring khyad mtshar/ co cog lags da nangs snga mo nas phyi log la sbag sbag bzhon te phebs song / gar 'gro gang yang gsungs gin mi 'dug ’ces snang 'jog de tsam ma byas par thab tshang nang du 'dzul te mu mthud lto chas bzo gin bsdad/gnyen sgrig byas pa nas bzung da bar de ring lta bu'i gnas tshul byung myong med pas mo dngangs skrag chen po skyes kyang 'brel ba byed thabs med pas ngang sgug byas te bsdad/ lha mos lto chas bzos tshar kyang bstan 'dzin ma slebs pas yun ring po bar sgug pad dbyangs kyi ngos nas bshad na nam rgyun dus tshod ha cang 'gro mgyogs kyang de nyin gyi dus tshod 'khyol khag po byung bas deb lta khul byas kyang sems la zug thabs bral/ sa dal bus rub pa dang / grong khyer gyi mtshan mo'i mkha' dbyings su glog bzhu'i 'od mdangs kyis khyab na'ang kho da dung log med pas/ pad dbyangs thabs zad de sngon la khyim gnyis la kha par brgyab ste kho slebs min skad cha dris kyang / phyogs gnyisaka nas slebs ma byung zer ba las de tsam gyi do snang ma byas/ bstan 306

'dzin 'gro srid pa'i sa gang yod la kha par brgyab nas skad cha dris kyang tshang ma stong par gyur/ mo rang thabs zad 'u thug nas ngu sdub rgyag bzhin zla sgron bstan 'dzin 'tshol rogs la skad btang / zla sgron gyis kha par nang nas‘‘a cag lha sa chen po 'di 'dra la ga par 'tshol bar 'gro'am/ ma gzhi nas mi tshoskyid skyid la phyin pa yin 'gro/ sems khral ma byed/ nga lam seng slebs yong zhes kha par bzhagayud tsam nas zla sgron slebs pa dang / skabs der mtshan mo'i chu tshod bcu gcig zin kyang pad dbyangs kyis da dung nyin dgung lto chas kyang bzos med pa shes skabs/ zla sgron gyis 'khang ra byed bzhin lto chas u tshugs kyis za dgos pa'i kha ta byas rjes khyim du sgug nas bsdad pa dang / de'i ring zla sgron gyis rang gi dga' rogs gsar pa h+phe le spru yi skor mi nyung ba zhig bshad/chu tshod bcu gnyis zin grabs yod pas pad dbyangs sems 'tshab nas bstan 'dzin gyi pha mar kha par rgyag rtsis byas/ 'on kyang zla sgron ni mtshan mo'i 'tsho bar rgyus mnga' yod pas mu mthud sgug nas kha par rgyag tu ma bcugaskabs der zla sgron gyis mu mthud de rang gi dga' rogs kyi skor mi nyung ba zhig bshad kyang / nyan mkhan gyi sems mo'i dga' rogs steng med pas cho med pa lta bur mngon nas bshad mtshams bzhag skabs der rgyus mnga' che ba'i sbag sbag gi sgra thos pa dang bu rdzi ma dang bcas pa kho tsho tshang ma sgo khar thon/bstan 'dzin sgo 'gram du slebs rjes sbag sbag gi me bsad/ gom pa brtan pos spo khul byas kyang chang gis bzi ba'i gom pa 'khyor de spos/ kho mthong 307

bas pad dbyangs dga' thag chod nas kho'i mdun du phyin te‘‘bstan 'dzin lags/ khyed rang gis lan tsam ma bzhag par nga ni sems khral gyis shi grabs byas te bsdad yod’’ces bskyor rtsis byed skabs khos mo phar 'bud nas‘‘nga ra bzi med’’ces khang pa'i nang du 'dzul/zla sgron gyis rang gi grogs mo la‘‘ngas bshad ma byung ngam/ mi tsho dngos gnas skyid skyid la phyin pa red/ de'i ming la sems chung bar chag sgo zer/a cag rang dang nga la re ba rgyag mkhan rig 'dzin smyon pa kho gcig pa red/kha gdangs tshad la shes bya yon tan rtsa chen yin lugs dang / don snying ldan pa'i mi tshe gang 'dra ze skyel dgos min gyi stong gtam bshad de sdod kyi redami’ces bshad/ bstan 'dzin gyis hab dgod chen po zhig byas pa dang de nas‘‘khyed rang gis gsan byung ngam/ zla sgron gyis bshad pa de rang red/ dus deng sang deb la bltas te phyug po chags pa su yod dam’ zhes ldab ldib kyi ngag gis bshad/ der pad dbyangs kyis lan ci yang ma brgyab par lha mo la dung ban nang chu dang a cor 'khyer yong du bcug pad dbyangs kyis ngang rgyud ring pos kho'i ngo gdong gtsang mar phyis/ kho nyal khri'i steng bsnyal rjes kho'i lag g.yas pa nas dam por 'jus te ha lam kho slar yang bros par dogs pa ltar snang / bstan 'dzin dal bus gnyid du yur te sna khung nas sir sgra grags yong bas zla sgron gyis‘‘a cag da nga 'gro gi yinari’zhes bshad/ don dngos thog kho gnyid rbad de khug med pas khos mgo bo yar dgye dgye byas te‘‘zla sgron rang sngon la ma 'gro dang / de ring ngas sems skyid bod zas nang sbi 308

rag phran bu btung ba yin/ sems skyid bod zas khang de phyi nas bltas na bod zas khang spyir btang zhig red 'dug kyang de'i thog khar sbag khang skyid po zhig 'dug ngas nyin gcig zla sgron rang yang khrid chog khong di skyid po byed shes mkhan de 'dra ma red ’ces ldab ldib ngag gis bshad/ zla sgron gyis‘‘khyed rang de 'dra gsungs rgyu a yod/ a cag gis khyed rang gi ched du ’’zhes rlung ston rtsis byas pas pad dbyangs kyis‘‘zla sgron/ rang kha rog sdod dang /de las khyod log song na 'grig pa 'dugami ces khug ma sprad de sgo khar bskyal/zla sgron gyis‘‘a cag rang ni mi snyoms chung zhe po cig 'dug rang de ltar byas na gyong 'khel yong / do dgong cog gi tshul de mthong ba dang a cag rang gis dngangs skrag chen pos sgug tshul dran skabs nga khong khros bzi grabs byed kyin 'dug da nga skyel mi dgos’mizhes phu shor shor ngang de nas kha bral/pad dbyangs kyis zla sgron gyi rgyab gzugs la lta bzhin mo'i skad char 'dang rgyag byed bzhin pa'i mtshams der khang pa'i nang nas bstan 'dzin gyis mo 'bod kyi yod pas mo rang rtab rtob por kho'i 'khris su log bstan 'dzin gyis mo'i lag gnyis nas 'jus te‘‘pad dbyangs lags/ khyed rang de ring sems khral chen po byung ba ngas los kyang shes/ khyed rang gis u tshugs mtha' skyel byas nas slob grwar 'gro dgos yod —ma gsungs tshe nga gnyis mi skyid pa yong don medarto gal srid yig tshad lon na nga tsho lo gnyis kha 'bral dgos red/ lo gnyis zer dus dus tshod thung thung ma red/ mtshan zhag bdun brgya nyi shu tag tag red/ de 'dra khyed rang phru gu'i a ma zhig gis bzod thub kyang 309

nga dang bus bzod thub pa mi 'dug ces mig chu yang gtong bzhin smras/mosakho'i ngo gdong la lta bzhin rgyus mnga' med pa'i snang ba zhig shugs kyis byung bas/ pad dbyangs kyis‘‘bstan 'dzin lags/ tshang ma ngas nor ba red/ da do dgong khyed rang kha khu sim mer gzims bzhugs dang’’zhes sun snang bstan/ mo'i skad cha'i mjug ma rdzogs gong‘‘red/ red/ nga la sems nang gi skad cha shod pa'i dbang cha med/ khyed rang nam mkha'i lha mo la ngas zhu ga la phod’ ces skad cha rdzogs rgyu med pas/ mo'i bsam par mo rang 'dir bsdad na kha mchu'i rgyu red bsam te cog tse'i steng du chu grang mo ghi la si gang blugs te bzhag da dung skyug snod dung ban nang chu phran bu blugs te nyal khri'i 'gram du bzhag rjes bu pang par btab nas khang pa mdo mar nyal bar phyin/pad dbyangs nyal khri'i steng du nyal yang skyid pa'i gnyid dang bral zhing /sems nang bstan 'dzin ngo shes pa nas da bar gyi gnas tshul rnams glog brnyan bstan pa ji bzhin klad pa'i nang du wa ler gsal te sems sdug chen pos yud tsam ngus/ 'khyol dka' ba'i mtshan mo de 'das nas tho rengs kyi skya mda' gtong skabs mo gzhi nas gnyid zam zim zhig khug yud tsam song rjes bstan 'dzin mo'i 'khris su yong bas mo gnyid las sad/ nyal sa'i nang ja phor u tshugs kyis sprad nas ngo bsus/ mos kha phar slog te kha ya ma byas kyang bstan 'dzin gyis mo'i gdong la byil byil byed kyin‘‘pad dbyangs lags/ da khros ma bzhugs dang / mdang nub nga rang sbi rag btung drags nas khyed rangagi sems la phog pa'i skad cha mang po cig bshad pa 'dra/ da nangs lha 310

mos kyang nga la kha rdung gtong gi 'dug da res ma gtogs rjes ma de 'dra yong mi srid pas sems la ma 'dzin ā ’zhes ngo bsus kyang / pad dbyangs kyis‘‘chang 'thungs pa'i rjes la gzhi nas sems nang gi skad cha drang po shod kyi red/ 'on kyang nga chang 'thung mkhan dang mā cang rgyag mkhan la dga' po med pa khyed rang gis shes gsal red/ slad phyin gnas tshul de 'dra ma thon pa byed rogs zhes rang la phog thug chen po byung ba'i mig cha ring po zhig btang ༄rjes khos sprad pa'i ja phor blangs te btung / skabs der kho'i bsam blo'i nang du'ang slad phyin bsgyur bkod mthar phyin pa gtong rgyu'i dam bca' bkod/kha ba bu yug 'tshub byung /da 1da dgong mo'i slob tshan la pad dbyangs bskyal rjes/ khos rang sems ji tsam gcun yang sbag sbag gi kha lo rang bzhin gyis sems skyid bod zas kyi phyogs su shor/ mtshams der khos rang gis rang la‘‘chu tshod gnyis rang/gnyis rang’ zhes sems nang lcag skul yang se brgyab pa dang / chu tshod gnyis nang mā cang si shung gcig (res skor bzhi)brgyab tshar gyi yod pas/ de'i ringakho la thob shor gang byung yang pad dbyangs bsu bar 'gro rkyang byed kyin yod/ kho'i byed stangs der dang thog sbag rogs tshos bsam gzhigs byas kyang / dus tshod nges can song skabs kho tsho phan tshun nang tshags chags nas kho 'gro rtsis byed skabs sbag rogs shig gis‘‘las ka grol nas mā cang phran 311

tsam brgyab par a ce la 'di 'dra skug rgyu ga re 'dug gam/ khyed rang dngul khang gi mi ma red dam zhes blo khog bslabs/ de nyin slar yang sbi rag gi cung bzi yod pa dang khong tsho'i skad cha sems la gzan po byung bas/ rang nyid a ce la skrag mkhan snyoms chung de 'dra min lugs ra sprod bya ched pad dbyangs bsu bar ma song bar mu mthud mā cang brgyab nas bsdad/rang gi khyo bo'i grib nag tsam mthong sar med pas/ pad dbyangs kyi yid la glo bur du kha sngon bstan 'dzin ra bzi ba'i skabs shod myong ba'i‘‘sems skyid bod zas ’zhes pa de dran te thad kar khyim la ma log par mi la skad cha 'dri bzhin bod zas khang de 'tshol bar phyin/ srang lam gu dog po zhig zad mtha'i bod zas khang zhig gi sgo 'gram du kho'i sbag sbag de sbag sbag dang rkang 'khor kha shas dang mnyam du bzhag yod la sgo'i steng du‘‘sems skyid bod zas khang’’zhes bris 'dug mos sgo yol phye nas nang du 'dzul skabs 'og khang du sku mgron ha lam mthong rgyu med par pang ras sngon po ring po zhig dkris pa'i zhabs zhu ma zhig gis brnyan phab lta bzhin 'dug mo yar 'dzul ba dang bu mo de mgyogs po yar langs te‘‘a cag lags/ khyed rang gsol ja yin nam bzhes thug yin ’zhes skad cha dris/ pad dbyangs rkub stegs zad to zhig gi steng du bsdad nas‘‘bu mo/ nga 'dir mi zhig sgug par yong ba yin mizhes u tshugs kyis 'dzum tsam byas rjes khug ma'i nang nas deb cig bton te lta gin bsdad/ bu mo de ni sngar bzhin wu sung gi bod skad brnyan phab der rtse gcig tu bltas nas dbyings zhugs pa las mo la kha ya tsam yang mi byed/312

pad dbyangs kyis deb lta zhor chu tshod gcig tsam bsdad kyang kha lag za mkhan dang ja 'thung mkhan gcig kyang ma slebs/mtshan mo'i chu tshod bcu dang phyed ka zin yang / thog kha4ra da dung mā cang rgyag pa'i sgra grags kyin yod pas mos zhabs zhu ma der‘‘bu mo/ thog kha'i sbag rgyag mkhan de tsho sbag mtshams ga dus 'jog gi 'dug gam zhes dris/bu mo des lag 'dogs chu tshod la lta tsam byas te‘‘da lta snga po red/ snga shos la chu tshod bcu gcig la log mkhan 'dug la/ yang kha shas mtshan gang brgyab nas sdod kyin 'dug’mices lan ha cang stabs bde zhig brgyab rjes sngar bzhin rig pa rtse gcig tu sgrim nas rang gi ltad mor lta gin bsdad/ mos slar yang sdug bsran gyis chu tshod phyed ka sgug pa dang khong yang snga tsam log pa'i re sgug byas/tag tag chu tshod bcu gcig yol tsam la bud med kha shas dang skyes pa dar yol gnyis thog kha nas bab yong bzhin/ kho ga tshod shor ba dang mo la ga tshod thob lugs 'tshang kha shig shig ngang shod kyin de nas kha gyes/ bstan 'dzin sngar bzhin thon med cing khyim du da dung bu bzhag yod pa dang dgong mo nyal khar a ma ma mthong tshe gang 'dra byas kyang nyal gyi med pas/ mo rang sems 'tshab te sgug yun ma theg pas rkang pa'i 'degs 'jog thog kha'i skas khar spos te kho skad gtong tsis byas/ rdo skas phyed ka 'dzegs zin na'ang yid gnyis the tshom du gyur nas phyir log byas pa dang kha phyogs bsgyur nas gom kha khyim gyi phyogs su bsgyur/ sbyin bdag yong rgyur sgug yod pa'i sbag sbag dmar 313

po de gcig pur srang lam nang bsdad yod pas/ pad dbyangs kyis de mthong ba dang don med skyo snang zhig 'char nas rang dbang med par mig chu shor/pad dbyangs khyim du 'byor skabs mtshan mo'i chu tshod bcu gnyis zin grabs yodakyang / bu da dung ma nyal bar lha mo'i pang du nyar yod pa dang / lha mo yang gnyid lcog gis mgo lcog ldem kyin bsdad yod pas khang pa'i sgo phye ba yang ma tshor/ pad dbyangs kyis skad chung ngus‘‘lha momi’zhes 'bod pa bus sngon la goste‘‘a ma zhes lha mo'i pang nas mchongs pa dang pad dbyangs la 'khyud yong / lha mo 'tshab sha langs nas mgyogs po yar langs pa dang mig phur gyin‘‘a cag lags/ bu da lta gzhi nas nga'i pang kha'i nang gnyid lcog phran bu brgyab pa ma gtogs ngus ngus par bsdad song mi zhes dang / yang pad dbyangs kyi gdong gshis yag po med pa dang bstan 'dzin mnyam du med pas skad cha 'dri ma phod/lha mos rnam kun ltar thug pa tsha po rlangs pa tshub tshub cig khyer yong nas pad dbyangs la sprad pa dang / a ma slebs pas blo bde thag chod nas de ma thag gnyid du yur ba'i bu bsnyal rjes pad dbyangs kyi 'khris su bsdad de‘‘co cog lags deng sang sdug tu sdug tu 'gro gin 'dug a cag lags khyed rang yang ha go mkhan zhig yin pas co cog lags 'di ltar skyag langs gtong rgyu mi 'dug’’ces bstan 'dzin la 'khang ra byas/ mos‘‘lha mo/ ngas shes song/sang nyin snga po langs dgos pas snga tsam nyol shog ngas khong sgug chog khong nang la ma bsdad pa'i thad nga la yang lan pa yod/ nga rang u tshugs tsha drags 314

pas lan pa redami ces kha nas de ltar bshad kyang / sems skyo drags te skad cha'i mjug ma rdzogs gong slar yang rang dbang med par mig chu shor/ lha mos‘‘a cag lags/ khyed rang gnyis kyis nga nang mir brtsis te yag po zhe drag gnang gi yod/ nga'i sems kyi gting nas khyed rang gnyis 'cham mthun dang spro po byung rogs byas na ci ma rung bsam gyi 'dug khyed rang gnyis 'di 'dra ze spro po ma byung na nga yang sems skyid po mi 'dug na ning gzhes ning nga tsho tshang ma spro po ga tshod med dmami zhes blo pham chen pos bshad/ lha mo'i skad cha de go rjes so sos slob grwar 'gro rgyur u tshugs de lta bu byas par gnong 'gyod thengs dang po skyes/lha mo nyal rjes hra h+pha steng du bsdad pa dang glog bsad nas gnyid phran tsam khug thabs byas kyang mo'i dran shes kyi me long ngos su kho stes dbang gyis ngo shes pa dang / ngo shes nas dga' po byas/ de rjes gnyen sgrig byas pa sogs bya ba'i go rim bzhin lham mer gsal ba dang / lha mos bshad pa'i‘‘na ning gzhes ning nga tsho skyid po gang 'dra med dam zhes pa'i skad cha yang rna lam du brag cha bzhin yang yang 'khor/ khong gis kha sngon 'gro rgyu med pa'i khas blangs zin yang khong dngos gnas 'gyur ba yin nam/ dus tshod kyi 'khor lo mtshan phyed kyi gnyis pa'i steng slebs skabs bstan 'dzin skad sgra gang yang med par log slebs/ khos khyim du ma 'byor gong sbag sbag gi me bsad de ded yong ba dang sbag sbag dal pos bzhag rjes sgo yang sgra med par phye/ khang pa'i nang yar 'dzul skabs lham gnyis phud de rkang rjen mar rkun bu 315

zhig dang 'dra bar khang pa sbug mar 'dzul rtsis byed skabs‘‘tshag’ sgra dang bcas pad dbyangs kyis glog sgron spar/ ‘‘sdug shi/ nga zhe po gcig 'drog byung / khyed rang da dung gzim med dam zhes bstan 'dzin gyis lce bsnar tsam byas shing / de ni sgrig lam las 'gal ba'i slob ma zhig 'dzin grwa'i kru'u renagyi mdun du langs pa dang ci mi 'dra/ mos sgam pos‘‘khyed rang log phebs rgyu dran pa red’’ces ha cang ma mos pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis smras pas/khos‘‘lcam sku zhabs/ ci drag do dgong yang 'phyi tsam byas song bas dgongs pa dang ba zhig ’ ces ku re dang sbrags te ngo bsus kyang / pad dbyangs hra h+pha steng nas yar langs te khang pa sbug mar 'gro zhor la‘‘nga la dgongs pa ma tshom zer dgos don med/ de las gzim sa sbag khang nang spos na tag tag redarimices nyal bar phyin/ ma gzhi de nyin khos sbi rag phran bu btung yod kyang so sos nor ba shes pas/ sems chung gis khang pa spug tu phyin nas pad dbyangs kyi ngo bsus kyang / mos kho la kha ya tsam ma byas par nyal chas gdong la bkab ste nyal/ kho'i sems glo bur du chu grang mo bshos pa ltar gyur pa dang da lta'i ngo tsha kha skyengs kyi 'du shes de skad cig nyid du khong khror gyur pas skad shugs chen pos‘‘red/ red/ ngas sbi rag phran bu btung/rtsed mo yud tsam rtsed pa de khyed rang gi mig la 'gro gi med pa red/ 'on kyang khyed rang gis nga la bsam shes byed kyi yod dam/ khyed rang gi sems la nga sbi rag la dga' drags pa dang / sbag khang nang la 'gro 'dod langs te phyin pa red bsam gyi 'dug gam/ don du las ka grol de khyim la yong rim bzhin 316

dang ngal gso yin rim bzhin/ nang mi tshang ma mi kun dang 'dra bar tsha rub rub tu sdod rgyu byung na snyam yang nga dang phru gu gcig pu khang pa srung nas sdod skabs dus tshod ring po gang 'dra yod med dang / 'khyol khag po gang 'dra yod med la khyed rang gis bsam blo gtong myong yod kyi ma red ’ces bshad pa dang / da dung rdzogs rgyu med pa shod bzhin yod pas/ skad cha de dag mo'i rna bar go skabs rang gi mdun la yod pa'i skyes pa kha bde po de rang gi khyo bo yin nam bsam nas had de lus/ kho dbugs lhom lhom ngang hra h+pha steng du bsdad pa dang / de sngon mthong ma myong ba'i mig dmar po zhig 'bur tshugs su bltas nas bsdad yod pas mo rang dbang med par khog 'dar shor ba dang mig chu shor/ pad dbyangs kyis lag gnyis kyis ngo gdong bkab te‘‘dkon mchog gis rma khyen/ ngas mig bltas te g.yang la mchongs 'dug’’ces sdug yus chen pos ngus / bstan 'dzin gyis sems thag chen po zhig bcad pa bzhin mo la sems gso bya rgyu lta zhog de las ldog te rna ba sun mdog kha pos‘‘byas na de dus khyed rang dbang po skyon can yin pa red/ hen ’ zhes sna shu 'then nas khang pa mdo ru nyal bar phyin/ mo'i sems la gtam a phas gtong rgyu a mas/ khyi bdag pos 'gog rgyu mgron pos/ ma gzhi byas na ngas do dgong kho la yus shod dgos kyang khos ngan byas ngo 'khyer 'di 'dra byed kyi red snyam pa ma byung bas sems pa skyo thag chod nas ngus/ pad dbyangs da dung gyon chas ma phud par nyal khri'i steng du ngu gin bsdad nas khos ngo bsu bar yong rgyu'i re ba byas kyang / kho rang hra h+pha steng du kam pa li zhig gyon nas 317

sir sgra dang bcas te gnyid du yur 'dug pad dbyangs ngu shum gyi 'khun sgras lha mo gnyid las sad pas yar langs te kha ta dang sems gso mang po zhig byas pas/ mo la yang sems gso phran bu byung ste ngu mtshams bzhag pa dang gyon gos phud de nyal/ lha mo slar yang gnyid du yur/ 'on kyang pad dbyangs gnyid rdzi ma gang khug rgyu phar bzhag da lta byung ma thag pa'i kho'i rgyun gtan ma yin la bsam yul las 'das pa'i byed stangs dag yid la 'khor nas/ ma/tshan gang yid sems skyo ba'i mig chu chad med btang nas sngas mgo'i a cor yang rlon pa chags/nyinaganyis par mo snga po nas langs te sems mi skyid bzhin du ngo lag gtsang mar bkrus te shel sgor lta skabs/ mig gnyis star kha tsam re skrangs yod pa dang mig mtha' dmar po chags pa ma zad gdong gshis kyang lhag par zhan/ mos zhogs zas ma zos par ko ba'i khug ma phrag par bkal/ gnyid la yur ba'i bu'i ngo gdong la 'o zhig byas rjes nang las byed bzhin pa'i lha mo la'ang gang yang ma bshad par thad kar las khungs la phyin/zhogs pa khyim nas thon skabs khong khro zhi med pa ma zad phan tshun gnyis ka bsam gzhigs nan po zhig bya rgyu'i ched du nyin shas ring a ma'i sar log rtsis yod kyang / nyin dgung las ka ma grol gong nas bstan 'dzin sbag sbag la zhon te pad dbyangs bsu bar slebs shing / kho'i rnam 'gyur la bltas na mdang nub gnas tshul gang yang ma byung ba ltar snang/ pad dbyangs kho dang mnyam du 'gro 'dod gtan nas ma byung yang nang bkra mi shis pa'i gnas tshul 318

phyi mi la gsang ba'i ched du kho'i sbag sbag gi rgyab tu bsdad nas lag pa yang rgyab ngos kyi dngos po bsdam sa'i lcags sgrom la 'jus pa las kho la reg ma 'dod/ lam bar du khos ci bshad kyang mos kha ya tsam ma byas/ khyim du slebs rjes bstan 'dzin gyis pad dbyangs kyi lham phud de hra h+pha steng du bzhag padang rang ngo mas ja phor sprod bzhinaslopad dbyangs lags/ ngas dngos gnas nor zhag rjes su rtsa ba nas mi 'gro/ mdang nub kyi gnas tshul de dag khyed rang gi sems la ma 'jog rogs zhes zhu ba 'then pa'i tshul gyis bshad/ pad dbyangs kyis‘‘ma gzhi nas khyed rang la 'gyur ldog de lta bu ji ltar byung ba red dam/ khyed rang gis dngos gnas mi gnyis 'khrab thub kyin 'dug mices rang nyid nas go ba lon dka' ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan/ bstan 'dzin gyis‘‘de'i nang 'gro mkhan mi yag po min pa ngas kyang shes pas rang sems rang gis gcun gang thub byas kyang skabs 'gar rang dbang med par gom pa de'i nang thal gyin 'dug mtshams rer ngas kyang rang nyid ngo ma shes pa'i snang ba yong gin 'dug khyed rang gi sems la ngas khyed rang la bsam blo gtong gi mi 'dug bsam yod kyi red/ don dngos thog nga khyed rang la brtse drags pa dang khyed rang la snang 'jog che drags pas mthar da lta'i gnas tshul 'di 'dra chags pa red/ khyed rang lkugs pa u tshugs tsha po de 'dra med par spyir btang gi skyed ma zhig yin na gnas tshul 'di 'dra yong don med/ 'on kyang ngas rjes su sgyur bcos mthar phyin pa gtong ma thub na nga bstan 'dzin gyi ming nas ma 'bodami ces sems thag bcad/ kho'i skad cha dang khas len de 319

dag go skabs thog ma'i khong khro rim bzhin 'jags pa dang don de rang nyid la'ang lan pa chen po yod pa'i ngos 'dzin zab tu phyin/nyin gnyis pa'i dgong dror las ka grol ma thag bstan 'dzin khyim du log nas sngar rgyun ltar pad dbyangs slob grwar skyel rtsis byas/ skabs der pad dbyangs brel 'tshub med par da dung 'drud lham zhig gyon te lha mo la dgong zas gra sgrig byed rogs byed kyin yod pas kho ya mtshan skyes nas‘‘pad dbyangs lags/ 'gro ran 'dug go’’zhes dran skul byas/ pad dbyangs kyis‘‘da res yang khyed rang la rgyal kha thob song / de ring nas bzung slob grwar 'gro rgyu'i skor nga'i sar ma gleng rogs’’zhes bshad/ kho'i sems la pad dbyangs kyis ku re rtse gin 'dug snyam nas‘‘da de 'dra gsungs ma gnang / da dung ma phyin na rjes lus thebs pa 'dug go’’zhes sngon la sbag sbag bzhon nas thon chog ang gsar byas/ pad dbyangs dang lha mos kho'i rjes nas bltas te gad mo shor ba dang lha mos‘‘co cog lags/ nga tsho'i khyim tshang gi bde skyid ched du a cag lags kyis slob grwar 'gro rgyu'i phugs bsam dngos gnas blos gtong rgyu yin gsung gi 'dug nyin de ring nas bzung cog lags khyed rang yang sgyur bkod mthar phyin pa ma btang tshe khong snying rje gi red’’ces bshad/da byed dus ngo mtshar che ba'i phugs bsam dang rang ngo mas gnyer skyong byas pa'i khyim tshang gi mig mdun gyi bde skyid gdam ka byed dus/ khyim tshang gi bde skyid med na phugs 'dun zer ba'ang tshe phyi ma'i bde ba can gyi zhing khams dang gcig mtshungs su mthong bas/ mos da bar rgyun 'khyongs byas 320

pa'i phugs bsam gyi brag ri de rmang nas bshig ste khyim tshang gi bde skyid kyi rtsig rmang du bting ba gzhi nas rtogs/ 'on kyang bstan 'dzin rang gi rna bar yid ma ches pa ltar re zhig sbag sbag gi steng du hon thor te bsdad/ don dngos thog pad dbyangs kyi thag gcod de ni kho'i ngos nas bshad na mdongs mtha' can gyi rna bar 'brug sgra thos pa las kyang lhag pas/ de nas bzung skabs shig ring khos kha par ma nyan pa ma zad 'bod brda de yang kha ma phye bar bzhag bstan 'dzin tshul ldan du gyur nas las ka grol ma thag khyim du log yong ba mthong skabs pad dbyangs kyi sems la so so'i gdam ka nor mi 'dug ang snyam bzhin rang gis phugs bsam blos btang par 'gyod sems gang yang ma byung / pad dbyangs nyin ltar las ka grol rjes khyim du log nas kho'i re ba ltar sdod kyi yod na'ang / gza' 'khor kha shas song rjes kho'i snang bar 'tsho ba'i nang da dung ci zhig nyung drags pa'i snang ba 'char ba dang / sngar bzhin nang du sdod mi 'dod pa'i snang ba zhig rgyun mar yong gi yod pas kho'i grogs po de tsho dran du dran du song ba dang / dam bca'i mdud pa rang zhig tu song nas sngon la khong tsho dang spyir btang gi 'brel ba thengs kha shas byas/dus de nas kho'i sked pa'i 'bod brda brel ba langs nas lhod du mi 'jugaskabs der grogs po de tshos kho la ku re dang 'phya smod 'dra min byed kyin yod pas kha par 'byor rim bzhin kha par gyis lag pa 'tshig gi yod pa bzhin len mi phod la/ khong tsho dang kha par thog nas 'brel ba byas kyang dngos su 'gro ma phod/321

da 2da de nyin yang res gza' nyi ma zhig yin/ pad dbyangs ngal gso yin pas snga dro bstan 'dzin gyi pha ma gnyis la blta ba dang phyi dro pad dbyangs kyi a mar lta bar 'gro rgyu'i kha 'cham/ zhogs pa bstan 'dzin langs khar kha par zhig 'byor rjes kho tshag gi tshig ger gyur nas sdod pa'i gnad med pas pad dbyangs kyis lam seng dzi rig khos pad dbyangs la mo'i a ma'i sar 'gro skabs nyo dgos pa'i lag rtags mang po bshad pa dang / da dung kha mkhas tshig snyan mang po zhig brjod kyin yod pas kho'i byed stangs la lta bzhin khong khro za la snying rje yang skyes/ mos‘‘ngas khyed rang gang du 'gro rtsis yod min shes kyi yod/ de ring gcig purano song zhig rjes su gtong rgyu min nomi’zhes dgongs pa ma zhus gong la dgongs pa 'khrol/ khos‘‘de ring nga'i grogs po tshang ma pha gir 'dzoms rgyu yin pas nyin gcig rang gtong rogs/ ngas snga tsam log yong chog da res mtha' ma de yin zhes khyim nas 'tshab 'tshub ngang thon pa'i tshul de ni nyin gang khyim du sbyong tshan bzo ru bcug nas da gzod gzhi nas rtsed mo rtse ru 'gro rgyur pha ma'i chog mchan thob pa'i byis pa dang gnyis su ma mchis/de nyin kho phyi la thon rjes khyim du mo rang gcig pur lus nas yul yul po'i snang ba byung bas bstan 'dzin la'ang khag mi 'dug snyam/ dgong zas za ba'i dus tshod ran grabs yod pas rnam kun bstan 'dzin gyis dga' shos byed pa'i sha 'bras rlangs pa 'tshub 'tshub cig bzos te kho yong rgyur sgug nas 322

bsdad/ sa rub na'ang kho yong mkhan med pas mo sems 'tshab langs 'on kyang zhogs pa bstan 'dzin thon khar‘‘ngas snga tsam slebs yong zhes bshad pa de rna lam du yang yang grags pas mos bu dang lha mor lto chas sngon la za ru bcug lha mosadzi.a cag lags/ khyed rang gis cog lags khong skyag langs gtong gin 'dug snga sa nas spo bo lags khong tshor gsungs dgos red’’ces dran skul byas/ pad dbyangs kyis‘‘lha mo/ phru gu longs nas pha ma la phan 'dogs ma thub na'ang rgan rgon la sems khral thol pa bzo mi rung’mizhes sngar bzhin 'gan 'khri tshang ma rang gcig pu'i phrag par 'khur rgyu'i bzo bstan/mtshan mo'i chu tshod dang po zin yang kho da dung yong mkhan med pas mos sgo 'gram nas kho yong min thengs 'ga' bltas/ lta thengs rer rgya lam steng du 'gro mi je nyung du 'gro ba ma zad brdal gtong rlangs 'khor yang rim bzhin nyung du song te mthar thar thor las ma lhagade nub bu bstan pa chos grags gnyid har bsad yang se brgyab nas ngu ba dang‘‘pā lags’ zhes yang se 'bod kyi yod pas/ mo blo ma bde bar kho'i 'bod brda lan mang brgyab kyang rgya mtsho rdo dbyugs kyi dpe ru song / mtshams der lha mos‘‘a cag lags/ ngas khong 'tshol bar phyin chog tan tan bod zas der bsdad yod kyi red ces 'gro rtsis byed skabs pad dbyangs kyis‘‘lha mo/ khong 'gro sa ngas shes kyi yod/ 'on kyang 'tshol bar song na khong mi'i mdun du nyams chag nas dga' po yong gi ma red’’ces bkag 'gog byas kyang lha mos ma nyan par shor/ pad dbyangs kyis mtshan gung lha mo gcig pu 323

gtong blos mi bzod pas mnyam du song nas de gar slebs rjes lha mo khang pa'i nang btang ba dang rang nyid sngon la log yong / mo khyim du slebs nas yud tsam las ma song gong lha mos kho tag tag khyim du khrid yong /de nub kho sbi rag gis rab tu myos yod pas khong khro tshad med langs te 'khyar re 'khyor re'i ngang pad dbyangs kyi sna la mdzub mo btsugs nas‘‘red/'di tsho tshang ma byed mkhan khyod rang red/ do dgong yang lha mo mi'i dkyil la nga 'bod par btang / nga mi la gdong gang 'dra zer ston dgos bsam/'jig rten 'dir 'tsho sdod byed mkhan song tsang khyim gyi bza' zla bu phrug phud da dung grogs po dgos kyi 'dug khyod kyi sems la khyod rang yod pas nga'i grogs po tsho dang yang 'brel ba ma byed zer gyin yod dam/ da cha mi'i dkyil du slebs dus nga ni gang ltar da de dag bshad kyang cho ga re yod ’ces ldab ldib ngang bshad pa dang 'khyar 'khyor ngang yar langs te phyir 'gro rtsis byed skabs/ pad dbyangs kyis bkag te‘‘ma gzhi nas khyed rang pho khyo ga zhig gis khas blangs zin par cha 'jog sa med dam zhes skad cha'i mjug ma rdzogs gong bstan 'dzin gyis pad dbyangs la mig 'bur tshugs su bltas te‘‘ga re'i pho khyo ga tshang ma khyod rang gis kha lo bsgyur nas nga la pho khyo ga'i dbang cha ga re 'dug gam/ da cha nga khyod rang gi rnyog gra nyan 'dod mi 'dugakho tshos de ring nga a ce la mgo sgur mkhan nyams chung pho khyo ga'i la rgya mi 'dug zer/ 'on kyang nga mi de 'dra min/ nga lam seng ra sprod byed par 'gro gin yin’’zhes yang bskyar thon rtsis byed skabs mos bkag kyang bstan 'dzin gyis 324

shugs kyis 'bud nas pad dbyangs sgo'i 'khris su 'gyel/ lha mos gnas tshul yag po med pa shes te don de rang nyid la lan pa yod lugs lce brgya sprul te bshad kyang phan thogs ma byung bar shor phyin/ pad dbyangs ngu gin kho'i rjes ded de‘‘bstan 'dzin lags/ gnas tshul gang yod kyang sang nyin nyi ma shar rgyu yod pas gsungs chog gi red/ rab byung na do dgong ma 'gro rogasami zhes u tshugs ga tshod byas kyang kho ni de dag ma go ba ltar gom pa g.yas 'khyor g.yon 'khyor ngang de bas mgyogs su btang te song bas/ grib gzugs nag po de je 'gyangs je 'gyangs su song nas srang lam nang las ma yal bar bltas rjes/ mthar mo yang ra bzi ba zhig dang 'dra bar gom pa mtho dman spo bzhin 'khyar 'khyor ngang nang du ma log ka med byung / sgo 'dzul ma thag lha mos mo la 'thams te ngu bzhin‘‘a cag lags/ da ngas chag sgo bslangs song /de 'dra bsam yul las 'das/ ma gzhi nas do dgong cog lags la gdon zhugs pa'i bzo 'dra zhig 'dug’mices gnong 'gyod chen pos bshad kyang /pad dbyangs kyi gdong la dga' skyo'i rnam pa gang yang med par gdan thog tu bsdad rjes‘‘dngos gnas gdon zhugs pa yin gyi red/ lha mo rang nyal bar song / da nas bzung nga'i 'tsho ba 'di 'dra'i ngang 'gro rgyu yin pa red ’ces bshad/ lha mos sngon la sems gso gang drag byas kyang kha mi grag pas pad dbyangs la pho khebs shig g.yogs te mo rang gnong 'gyod kyi mig chu gtong bzhin nyal bar song /sems skyid bod zas khang du slebs skabs kho'i grogs po dge legs 325

sogs sbag rogs tsho log zin te zhabs zhu ma bu mo gnyis kyis bsdu gsog rgyag bzhin 'dug khos ngag ldab ldib kyis‘‘bu mo/ khong tsho log song ngam zhes 'dri skabs bu mo des sun snang che mdog gis‘‘da nam phyed yol 'dug pas ma log par ga re byed kyin sdod kyi red dmami skad cha de sbyin bdag sgrol dkar gyis go nas‘‘khyod kyis sku mgron la skad cha gang 'dra zer shod kyin yod dam/khong tsho ga dus phebs kyang nga tshos sne len zhu ba'i 'os 'gan yod/ ngas khyod rang tsho la gla sprad de las ka 'di ma byas na nga'i za khang 'di dge gtong khang red snyam gyi 'dug gam ’zhes bu mo der gshe gshe btang rjes 'dzum 'dzum dmul dmul ngang kho la sne len zhus/ bu mo des‘‘yang do nub mtshan gang nyal rgyu yong gi ma red’ ces lkog tu dmod mo rgyag gin mu mthud rang gi las ka byed kyin bsdad/ kho rang yang cung 'tsher snang byung bas‘‘khong tsho tshang ma log song ngam mizhes shes bzhin du de ltar dris/ sgrol dkar gyis‘‘mi skyid po byas te sdod du mi 'jug mkhan khyed rang gi a cag lags red ’ces bshad/ khos‘‘'o na nga yang log 'gro rgyu yin zhes log rtsis byed skabs/ mos‘‘yong ni yong ba red/ da lta nga gnyis las lhag med pas zhabs tag kha shas rgyag do’ zhes kho'i mos mthun la ma sgug par zhabs zhu ma de sbi rag len du btang / sgrol dkar rang nyid kyis brel 'tshub ngang chu rul lhag ma tsha po bzos pa dang spag brdzis/‘‘deng sang gi a ce lo chung chung de tshos rang gi khyo bo gcun rgyu kho na las khyo bor byams po byed shes kyi ma red/ do dgong yang phar bskong ste sbar thag yag 326
