thag chod bzed nas tshur log yong ba yin gyi red/ ho he zhes snying tshim dang bcas te smras/ kho la u tshugs kyis mtshan zas za ru bcug pa dang / de nas ghi la si gtug res kyis sbi rag zhabs tag yang yang bkyag dug chus rab tu myos pas‘‘sprod dgos thams cad len dgos 'char/ rtsig pa'i gsing yang nor la phyin zhes pa'i dpe ltar lus la tsha drod 'phel/ sems nang sngar na med pa'i blo khog cig rnyed/ gdong gi pags pa yang mthug tu song bas/mtshams der kho gnyis kyi sems kyi bar thag je nyer phyin pa'i snang ba byung ste phan tshun gyi snying gtam lhug por shod res byas/sgrol dkar gyi de snga'i khyo bo de ni 'jon thang gang yang med pa zhig yin na'ang chang rag la dga' zhing gshis ka tsub pas/ kho gnyis bar bsam pa gcig mthun gtan nas yong gi med pas yun ring ma song bar kha bral/ phru gu bu mo zhig yod pa de las khungs shig gi bzo pa yin pa dang deng sang dga' rogs shig yod pas mo'i sar yong ba nyung / mos‘‘ nga bud med cig gis phyi nang tshang ma byed dgos dus khag po zhe drag 'dug ces mig chu rkang kha shas gtong bzhin rang gi skor ngo sprod byas/ bstan 'dzin gyis‘‘ma gzhi nga la snying du sdug pa'i bu zhig dang lo chung la mdzes sdug ldan pa'i bza' zla zhig yod/'on kyang mi sgrol dkar gyis kho'i skad cha'i bar du 'tshang nas‘‘yag po de 'dra yod na khyed rang ma skyid pa de 'dra gnang dgos don ga re yod dmami ‘‘khyed rang gis mkhyen gyi ma red/ khong gshis ka gyong drags te rang gi 327

lta tshul mkhregs 'dzin mtha' 'khyongs byed pa dang / rtag par deb kho na las bsam rgyu med pas da lta nga gnyis kyi bar thag je rgyang du 'gro ba ma zad/ gang nas gang yong med pa'i 'gal ba zhig kyang slebs song zhes rgyu mtshan bshad pas/ mos‘‘byas na khyed rnam gnyis kyi las 'phro zad pa yin 'gro/ 'on kyang khyed rang gi a cag lags dngos gnas bsod nams yod mkhan zhig red/deng sang khyed rang 'dra ba'i a ce la bsam pa rnam dag byed mkhan ha cang dkon po red/ yin dā/ khyed rang gi a cag lags mdzes ma de'i ched du ngas khyed rang la zhabs tag cig btegs pa yin’mizhes phan tshun zhabs tag 'gyogs res dang sems gso byed res byas/ yang skabs 'gar hab dgod byed pa dang gzhas btang nas bsdad/ kho sngar bzhin log rgyu'i bsam blos dran skul byed kyi yod pas‘‘da nga log ran song’’zer 'gro rtsis thengs 'ga' byas kyang mos‘‘da lam seng nam langs grabs 'dug do nub khyod rang dang mnyam du skyid gtam sdug gtam bshad de ha cang skyid po byung / da brel ba ma byed dang ’zhes dang / gnyid lcog rgyag bzhin pa'i zhabs zhu mar nyal bar 'gro chog pa'i snang ba sprad pas/ zhabs zhu ma ni dga' thag chod de skad cha'i mjug ma rdzogs gong‘‘lags so’’ zhes skas ka nas brel stabs ngang bab/bstan 'dzin gnyid shor grabs byed kyi yod pas mos kho skyor te mo rang gi nyal sar bsnyal/ mo da dung de tsam bzi med pas kho'i gdong la lta skabs de ni mi blos thub po zhig dang rang gi a ce la shin tu dung ba zhig tu mthong bas sems la ma rung ba'i bsam pa zhig glo bur du skyes/ lhag par du dus tshod ring po 328

zhig la rang gi 'khris la skyes pa khyo ga 'khor med pas mo 'dod pas rab tu myos nas kho'i gyon pa phud 'go tshugs/ kho ra bzi yang cung zad ha go nas‘‘de 'dra ma gnang ’ces dor ma yar 'then/ sgrol dkar gyis g.yem ma'i rtsal nus ji yod bton te kho la 'o byas pa dang phur mnyed gtong ba sogs byas te rang gi 'dod pa'i me lce gsod thabs byas/ de ltar rmi lam mam mngon sum gang yin ma shes pa dang pad dbyangs dang sgrol dkar su yin ma shes par rang gi bza' zlar rgyab gtod thog ma de byas/kho ra dwangs skabs rang nyid ngo shes tsam gyi bud med cig dang mnyam du gcer bur nyal yod pa dang / bud med des blo yid rab tu tshim pa'i nyams kyis kho'i ske la 'khyud yod pas kho ngo tsha la kha skyengs nas mgyogs po rang gi gyon gos btsal te gyon gin‘‘dgongs pa ma tshom/ mdang dgong smyo chu 'thung rgyu mang drags nas gang yang shes ma byung zhes gsal bshad byed skabs/mos slar yang kho'i mgrin par 'khyud de‘‘gnas tshang g.yar bas ma tshad gnas mor tshad tshad/ a tsi ku re ma gtogs khyed rang 'drogs 'go ma langs dang /de bas khyed rang gis dran gsor 'os pa'i mtshan mo 'di thugs la bzhag ste nga'i sar khyug trem khyug tsam bzhugs par phebs na de rang gis blo kha khengs song’’zhes snying bton pa'i skad cha mi nyung ba zhig bshad pas kho rang yang blo cung bde ru phyin/ 'on kyang da ni rang gis pad dbyangs la rgyab gtod dang khrel med tshad med byas par gnong 'gyod drag po byung bas da nas pad dbyangs ma thug rogs byas na ci ma rung bsam pa dang / yang mgyogs nas 329

myur du 'phrad de mo'i mdun la pus mo btsugs te ngos len zhu bar 'gro 'dod pa sogs bsam blo'i nang du 'gal ba'i ri rab chags te mtha' mjug khyim du log ma phod/mcho kha dar gyis bsdams song /—1—lha mo la kho rang grogs po'i sar yod lugs kha par brgyab ste nyin shas grogs po'i sar gnas tshang g.yar nas bsdad/ bstan 'dzin gyis don de dge legs la shod skabs khos ya mtshan gyi snang ba spu tsam med par de las ldog te‘ skyes pa pho la gnas tshul de 'dra yong srid pa zhig red/ 'on kyang khyim la ma log na mi 'grig dus deng sang phyi la zur mo yid 'phrog lha mo 'dra ba zhig yod kyang khyim tshang blos gtong mkhan ga par yodami ces nges par du khyim srung dgos lugs kyi kha ta byas/ bstan 'dzin gyi mig lam du pad dbyangs kyi chu ris shig shig gi 'dren byed gnyis 'char ba dang / rna lam du‘‘khyed rang gis nga tshe gcig la sdug tu bcug mi yong zhes bshad med dam ’zhes pa'i skad yang yang grags pas sngar bzhin log ma phod/ da ni pad dbyangs la gus sems gnas pa las sems thag je ring du 'gro ba dang mos nam yang gu yangs gtong mi srid par sems thag chod pas/ kho'i sems la sgrol dkar gyis bshad pa bzhin nga gnyis dbar gyi las 'phro dngos 'brel zad pa min nam snyam/ de ltar log sa med pa ltar yod pas sems skyid bod zas khang nang 330

slar yang gom kha thal zhing / sgrol dkar gyis kho la gcen mo zhig dang 'dra ba'i sems khur dang byams skyong byed kyi yod pa'i snang ba byung bas kho'i sems khams gu je yangs su song ba dang / skabs 'gar skyed ma'i 'du shes kyang 'char/ lan gcig chu la brgal bar gting la ring thung mi 'dug ces pa'i dpe ltar kho gnyis kyi 'brel ba de bas je zab tu song ba dang tha na sbag rogs tshor yang tshor snang byung / de ni sgrol dkar gyi 'dod thog la rta rgyugs pas mos brgya cha gcig gi re ba las med kyang brgya cha stong gi nus shugs bton te kho'i blo 'gug thabs byas/res gza' pa sangs shig gi phyi dro/ pad dbyangs bstan 'dzin gyi las khungs kyi sgo khar langs nas khor sgug bsdad/ dang thog pad dbyangs mthong skabs kho'i ngo gdong mgar khang nang du 'dzul ba ltar gyi tsha shar brgyab pa dang skad cha yang ma thon par mgo bo dud/ nyin shas las song med na'ang kho ngo ma shes pa lta bu chags yod kyang mos rang 'gul ngang‘‘bstan 'dzin lags/ nga dang bus khyed rang sgug nas bsdad yod/ da phru gu'i snang ba ma byed/ nga dang mnyam du log 'gro zhes bshad/khyim du slebs rjes pad dbyangs kyis 'dri gcod bya rgyur sgug na'ang /mos nyin de dag nang kho gar 'gro ma dris par de las ldog te kho thag ring zhig la las kar song nas da lta rang khyim du 'byor ma thag pa bzhin sngon la kho lhod por sdod du bcug pa dang ja mngar mo zhim thag chod bzos te blugs pas/kho rdel ril steng du bsdad pa ltar bzod mi bde bas tha na mo la thad kar lta 331

yang ma phod/ khos‘‘bu da dung ma yong ngam’ zhes dris par mos‘‘bu bcol khang nas log rgyu red/ nyin de dag nang bus khyed rang zhe drag sgug song / ngas bu la khyed rang phyi la gzhung don sgrub par phyin pa red ces rdzun gtam bshad pa yin’’zhes bshad/ khos‘‘byas na nga bu bsu bar phyin chog’mi ‘‘lha mo snga sa nas phyin song / yun ring rmotshobo lags kyi sar slebs med pas bu dang lha mo phar btang ba yin’’zhes bshad/pad dbyangs kyi skad cha de dag go skabs kho ri byi'u gzeb nang bcug ma thag pa ltar dngangs skrag chen po langs/ pad dbyangs sngon la a spam pos kho'i kha sprod du bsdad pa dang kho la ja gang blugs/ rang gis kyang gang btungs/ de'i yun ni skar cha kha shas tsam yin na'ang bstan 'dzin gyi snang bar bskal pa zhig gi yun ltar ring po byung ba dang / rang gi mgo thod nas brag rdo zhig lhung la nye yang 'bro sa med par rdo de lhung rgyur sgug nas sdod pa ltar gyi tshor snang byung / pad dbyangs kyis‘‘da nga gnyis skad cha yag po zhig byed dgos kyi 'dug da cha khyed rang ga re bsam gyin yod med ngas shes kyi mi 'dug ngas khyim tshang gi bde skyid ched du slob grwar 'gro ba'i go skabs re re bzhin blos gtong byas pa yin/ da dung nga pad dbyangs la mi 'dang sa ga re 'dug gam’ skad cha shod mtshams der slebs skabs mo'i sems kyi rba rlabs 'gog thabs med pas 'dar skad thon pa dang mig chu zham zham du lhung yong / kho re zhig smra ba med par bsdad pas pad dbyangs kyis‘‘khyed rang kha mi grag pa ga re red dam/ khog pa sus brgyangs byung ngam’’zhes bshad/ bstan 332

'dzin gyis sngar bzhin mgo bo dud de‘‘pad dbyangs lags/ da ngas khyed rang la ji ltar zhu dgos sam/ gang ltar ngas khyed rapre la dgongs dag zhu rgyu yin/ tshang ma ngas nor song / nga gnas bab 'di 'drar lhungs dus khyed rang la'ang 'tshig pa za gi 'dug khyed rang u tshugs tsha po de 'dra min par slob grwar 'gro rgyu'i bsam blo de snga tsam blos gtong byas yod na da lta'i gnas tshul 'di 'drar gyur don med/ da lta ga re bshad kyang tshang ma 'phyi drags song’’zhes bshad/ skad cha de go skabs tshor ba skyen pa'i pad dbyangs la slar yang 'grel bshad bya ba'i dgos pa med par tshang ma rang gi dogs pa ji bzhin mngon sum du gyur pa tsam las ma 'das pas/ mo re zhig had de lus/ kho la kha rtsod rgyag mkhan med la ngu mkhan med/ yag sdug gi skad cha tsam yang med pas bstan 'dzin sems khral byung ste‘‘pad dbyangs lags/ nga'i ched du de 'dra gnang rin med/ nga dngos gnas rgyu 'bras med pa'i mi zhig red’’ces rang gis rang la kha rdung btang ste mo'i khong khro 'jags thabs byas/ yud tsam song rjes mos glo bur du skad chen pos‘‘a ma/ nga'i las dbang la gzigs dang / ngas tshe sngon ma las ngan pa ga re bsags pa yin nam’’zhes ngus/ kho ci bya gtol bral du gyur pa'i skabs sked par btags pa'i 'bod brda grags nas‘‘ngas khyed rang sgug nas yod pas mgyogs po log shog’’ces 'khod yod pas/ rmi lam tsub po zhig gtong bzhin pa'i skabs phyi nas khyi skad grags pa ltar byung bas pad dbyangs la‘‘dgongs pa ma tshom/ nga 'akro ran song’mizhes sgo'i phyi la thon/ bstan 'dzin gyis sdug bsran theg thabs bral ba'i dbang 333

yodadang thub tshod 'di lta bu bshad yong snyam pa gtan nas med pas 'jig rten ma lus glo bur mun pas 'thibs pas mdun gyi ca dngos kyang rab rib tu gyur la/ da lta rang mi sus kyang mi shes pa'i sa cha zhig tu 'gro ba'am/ yang na rang gi dran pa yongs su nyams te gang byas da lta nyid du brjed par gyur na ci ma rung snyam/ 'on kyang 'jig rten 'dir rang nyid gcig pu min par da dung byams brtse che la nad kyis mnar ba'i a ma dang / snying nas brtse ba'i bu yod pas sems sdug ma lus rang nyid gcig pus khur du bzod de mi sdod ka med byung /da 2da gnas tshul de gnas skabs rang gi a ma la gsang yang / bstan 'dzin gyi pha ma gnyis la ma bshad na mi 'grig pas mos dus tshod zhig btsal te kho'i pha ma gnyis kyi sar phyin/ mo khang pa'i nang 'dzul yong skabs gdong gshis yag po med pa dang gnas tshul bden min mang po zhig rna bar thos myong bas/pha rab rgyas kyis mo mthong ba dang mgyogs po gdan las langs te‘‘bu mo log yong ngam/ mgyogs po yar shog dang / khyed gnyis dus tshod ring po zhig slebs med pas nga'i tsha bo yang dran byung mizhes bstan pa chos grags rang gi 'khris la 'then nas mgo bo la byil byil byas/ cog tse'i 'og nas rtsed chas mo ṭa chung chung zhig bton te kho la sprad/ bstan pa chos grags kyis mo ṭa phar blangs rjes‘‘spo bo lags thugs rje che/ da res kyi mo ṭa 'di kha sngon gyi de las rdzig pa 'dug ’ces rtsed mo rtse bar song / pha rab rgyas kyis khang pa gzhan zhig 334

tu nang las byed bzhin pa'i a ma skyid 'dzoms skad btang te pad dbyangs la jablug tu bcug a ma'i kha nas‘‘bstan 'dzin gang du song ngam mizhes 'dri bar thal/ pad dbyangs de ma nyid du mgrin pa brnangs nas smra ba med par re zhig bsdad pa dang / pha rab rgyas kyis skyid 'dzoms la mig log cig bltas/ pad dbyangs kyis ja phor pa gang btungs rjes‘‘ma gzhi nga tsho gzhon skyes tshos pha ma la phan ma thogs kyang sems khral bzos na ma 'grig pa zhig red/ 'on kyang de ring nga rbad de 'u thug nas khyed gnyis la mi zhu ka med red ces bstan 'dzin gyi gtam spyod skor cha tshang mchi ma gtong bzhin bshad/pad dbyangs kyi skad cha go rjes pha rab rgyas ni re zhig ci shod 'di shod med par pad dbyangs la ja bshug pa dang / sngon la ma ngu dang zhes sems gso gtong rgyu las ma 'das/ a ma skyid 'dzoms kyis sna tha sen mo gang blug nas 'then bzhin‘‘nga'i bu de chung dus ya rabs tshul ldan gyi mi zhig yin pas grong pa khyim mtshes kyi nang du'ang skad grags yod pa red/ da gang shes/ ma gzhi nas phru gu'i a ma ri rgyal lhun po bzhin khyim tshang nang du a spam po byas te bsdad na nyi ma zla ba'i 'khor phyogs nor gyi ma red/ 'on kyang deng sang gi bud med khag gcig ha lam nga min na su yin snyam nas sdod tshugs kyi ma red/der brten khyo ga mgo sla po de tsho la'ang go skabs thob kyi yod pa red ’ces skor gtam bshad/dang thog phru gu ngu sa pha ma dang 'bangs kyi skyid sdug 'go dpon gyi dpe ltar kho gnyis kyis mo la rgyab skyor dang sems gso bya rgyu'i re ba bcangs nas 335

yong na'ang / bsam yul las 'das par de las ldog te a ma skyid 'dzoms kyis ngan byas ngo 'khyer gyis gnas tshul gyi 'gan tshang ma pad dbyangs la dkri rtsis byed pas/ mo'i tshig gi spu gri rno po des pad dbyangs kyi snying dum bur gtub pa'i snang ba skyes te na zug drag po bzod ma thub par 'dar skad dang bcas te‘‘a ma lags/ ngas khong gi re ba ltar slob grwar 'gro rgyu de snga sa nas blos gtong byas zin/ khyed rnams tsho yang phyi mis gang 'dra zer gyi yod min gsan tsam gnang dang mkhyen rgyu red/ skad cha drang po bshad na nga 'gyod pa skye dgos pa'i las ka gang yang byas med la bstan 'dzin lags la gang yang chad med/ ngas chad sa ni nga'i a ma lags red/ khong da lta snyun te sman khang du lus yod kyang khong la zhabs phyi zhu ba'i dus tshod tshang ma khyed rang gi bu sgug nas sdod dgos kyi 'dug’’ces ngu skad rang dbang med par shor nas thon rtsis byed skabs/ pha rab rgyas kyis pad dbyangs kyi lag nas 'jus te‘‘bu mo rang bden/ nga rgan pos khyod la dgongs dag zhus chog’’ces pad dbyangs sdod du bcug a ma skyid 'dzoms kyis‘‘spor to 'di la byed rgyu bco brgyad yod/ ngas bshad par nad mi theg pa ’’ skabs der pha rab rgyas kyi lag pa chen po de skyid 'dzoms kyi 'gram pa g.yon pa'i steng du tshag sgra dang bcas te bab pa dang sbrags‘‘khyod kyi kha de ga dus yin na'ang zum thub kyi med’’ces bshad/ phru gu chen po chags pa nas bzung rab rgyas kyis mo la lag pa 'gyogs thengs dang po yin pas/ skyid 'dzoms yud tsam smra ba med par kho'i gdong la bltas nas lus pa dang de rjes‘‘hen/ bu mo rang blo yid tshim e 336

byung / da cha nga gnyis rgan rgon yang 'khrug dgos byung song’’zhes rab rgyas la mig log cig bltas te phyir bud/ pad dbyangs kha rab tu skyengs nas ngu mtshams chod pa dang pha rab rgyas la dgongs pa ma tshom zhes bshad de sgo nas thon rtsis byas/ pha rab rgyas kyis‘‘bu mo/ rang sems khral ma byed/ kho nga'i phru gu yin pas ngas kho am cog nas bzung ste khrid yong chog kho skyid gdan steng du rkub na ba red’’ces khas len byas/phyi nyin/ rgan rgon gnyis sems skyid bod zas khang gi sgo 'gram du kho sgug bsdad/ phyi dro'i las ka grol mtshams kho der slebs pa dang / khos sngon la pha ma gnyis de gar yod kyi red snyam pa med pas khong gnyis mthong ba 'phyi drags te g.yol dgos bsam yang g.yol ma shes/ khos pha ma gnyis zur zhig tu skad gtong rtsis byed skabs pha rab rgyas kyis kho'i am cog nas 'jus te‘‘mi rgyud re la rkang 'dren re ces sngon gyi gtam dper yod/ nga tsho'i khyim gyi rkang 'dren khyod yin pa red/ khyod a ce yag po de 'dra zhig bzhag te da dung ga re dgos kyi 'dug gam/ pad dbyangs la rnam pa dgos na rnam pa/—'jon thang dgos na 'jon thang / khyod char mun 'thibs nas rdzab dong nang la mchongs pa red’’ces dbugs hal hal byed/ khos pha ma gnyis kyi mdun la pus mo btsugs te‘‘pā lags/ a ma lags/ gal te khong yag po de 'dra med na ngas khong dang mu mthud 'tsho ba skyel srid kyang / da cha nga khong gi mdun du nyes can zhig dang mi tha shal zhig yin pa'i snang ba 'dug pas mgo bo 'degs pa'i go skabs yong gi ma red/ nga'i bsam par gcig byas na nga 337

gnyis kyi las zad pa red bsam gyi 'dug 'on kyang ngas khong gnyis kyi 'tsho ba'i thad ’a ma skyid 'dzoms kyis kho yar slong bzhin‘‘bstan 'dzin rang lkugs pa de 'dra ma byed/ pad dbyangs la a mas zhu ba 'then rogs byas chog’ ces bu'i blo khug re byas/ khos mgo bo phred la g.yug bzhin da ni sngar song gi lam la phyir ldog bya thabs med pa'i bzo bstan pas/ skabs der de gar mi tshogs je mthug tu song ba dang sgrol dkar ni za khang sbug nas phyir thon ma phod par dngangs skrag chen pos yib nas bsdad/ kho'i byed stangs la pha rab rgyas khong khro chen po langs te‘‘khyod rang da cha phru gu'i pha chags zin pas bsam blo thongs/ ngas 'chums mi 'ong’’zhes re thag chad pa'i dbugs ring gtong bzhin a ma skyid 'dzoms khrid nas logade nas bzung pad dbyangs kyis gza' 'khor gcig lhag tsam ngang sgug byas kyang / kho'i grib gzugs tsam yang 'khor rgyu med pas yang ngal gso'i dus tshod cig la kho'i las khungs su kho 'tshol bar phyin/ yun ring po zhig sgug rjes kho gzhi nas las khungs nas thon yong ba dang / pad dbyangs kyis rang nyid la sgug yod pa mthong bas nye sngon gyi bslab bya yid la dran nas kha la nyan pa'i phru gu bzhin mo'i rjes la yong / khyim du slebs rjes pad dbyangs kyis rang ngo mas khos dad shos kyi lto chas bzos te drangs/ rgyun du dngul blugs pa'i cha sgam de'i lde mig mos bdag po byed kyi yod kyang kho'i sems khug phyirakho la sprad de‘‘bstan 'dzin lags/ nga dang bu bzhag ste ma phebs dang /khyed rang nga gnyis la ha cang brtse po yod zer gsung gin yod/ de 'dra yin 338

na so so'i snying nye ba'i mi la sdug po 'di 'dra btang nas cho ga re yod dam/rang gi khyim tshang cha tshang po zhig bzhag nas phyi la gnas tshang g.yar te bsdad nas ci byed/ skabs re nga rang yang rang nyid la khong khro za yi 'dug gal te ngakhyed rang la sems gting nas brtse po 'di ltar med na nga la sems sdug chen po 'di lta yong don med/ de las khyed rang nga gnyis dang kha ma bral na ngas ga re byed dgos kyang byas chogami’ces zhu ba nan po 'then/ bstan 'dzin gyis mo'i mig gi sgang nas 'dzar ba'i mgo skyes dal bus byug byug byed kyin‘‘pad dbyangs lags/ khyed rang deng sang rgan bzo dod du zhe drag phyin bzhag dngos gnas dgongs pa ma tshom/ ngas tshe 'dir khyed ma bu gnyis la zhe drag chad song / gal te nga'i sems nang khyed rang spyir btang gi bud med dkyus ma zhig gi gnas bab las med na nga gnyis mnyam du mu mthud de 'tsho ba skyel yang srid/ 'on te tag tag khyed rang yin pas ngas 'dra chags po zhig byed thub pa mi 'dug ngas brtson len ma byas pa min/ kha sngon pā lags dang a ma lags phebs nas nga la bka' bkyon tsha nan gnang ba ma zad sku rlung chen po gnang gin 'dug 'on kyang gnas tshul kha shas khyed rang gis bsam pa bzhin stabs bde po de 'dra med/ bud med de ni khyed rang gi gshis ka dang yongs su kha khag red/ khong gis ci yang byed srid pas da cha thabs shes yag shos de ni nga khong dang mnyam du 'tsho ba skyel rgyu de red/ de 'dra byas na khyed ma bu gnyis la gnod 'tshe med pa zhig yong rgyu dang gnas skabs ma gtogs nga brjed 'gro rgyu red/ ma gzhi nga la grogs po dang dga' 339

nye spun mched tshang mas kha rdung btang nas rta bab bong bzhon red zer gyin 'dug la don du yang de 'dra po zhig byung song / da cha nga gnyis bar gyi las 'phro zad pa'am khyed dang mnyam du 'tsho ba skyel ba'i skal ba zad pa red/ nga khyed dang kha bral ba'i rgyu mtshan khyed rang gis mkhyen na gzhan la 'grel bshad byed dgos don mi 'dug’mices lde mig mo'i lag tu phar sprad/ pad dbyangs kyi rna bar skad cha de dag go bas/ sems nang du lhag pa'i re ba cung zad de yang ri mgo'i smrag par zhogs pa'i nyi 'od phog pa bzhin dal gyis yal bas 'dren byed gnyis rab tu bgrad/ lus yongs rengs por gyur/ gdan steng du lha sku ltar g.yo ba med par yun ring bsdad/ lha mos mig chu gtong bzhin‘‘co cog lags khyed rang dngos gnas thabs rdugs red/ a cag lags la bsam rgyu dran rgyu khyed rang las med pa dang tha na lto thengs re re tshang mar khyed rang gi dkar yol nang zas kyi phud ma blugs gong khong gis gtan nas za bar mi byed/ 'on kyang khyed rang ’mizhes pad dbyangs la ja tsha po gang bshug rtsis byas/ pad dbyangs kyis 'phrul 'khor gyi mi ltar lha mo'i lag pa phar phud pas dkar yol de sar lhung nas sing sgra dang bcas hrug chag la phyin/ sing sgra des pad dbyangs dran pa sos pa lta bu byung nas‘‘rnam rtog rnam rtog’ zhes kha nas thal/ re zhig song rjes mo smyo spo bzhin kho'i mdun du pus mo btsugs te‘‘bstan 'dzin lags/ nga gnyis da lta sha chad kyang rgyud chad med pas dngos gnas rta kha phyir skor ba'i yul med dam/ khyed rang gi phru gu yang blos gtong thub pa 'dug gam ’zhes mig chu btang / bu bstan pa chos grags kyis 340

pa pha'i sgal par khu tshur chung chung des gzhu bzhin‘‘pā lags khyed rang sdug cag cig 'dug khyed rang gis rtag par a ma lags la dbang yod bshad de ngu ru 'jug gi 'dug’ ces bshad/ khos bu pang du btab ste‘‘bu/ dgongs dag pa pha dngos gnas sdug cag cig redamimices mig gnyis mchi zhag gis khengs/ pad dbyangs kho'i 'khris nas dal bus langs/ mig chu phyis/ zang zing du gyur pa'i mgo skyes byug tsam byas nas‘‘ngas khyed rang la mtha' ma'i re ba gcig rang zhu rgyu yod/ nga'i a ma lags bsnyun te sman khang la bzhugs yod/ nga gnyis kyi skor khong la gsang ste zhus med/ em rjes gsungs na khong mi yul du bzhugs pa'i dus tshod zhe drag med pa 'dra/ khong sman khang la bzhugs ring khyed rang thengs gcig kyang phebs med pas ngas khyed rang las brel chen po 'dug ces rdzun bshad pa yin/ khong gis nga la 'khyug tsam blta ba'i dus tshod kyang med pa yin nam ces thugs pham po gnang gin 'dug a ma lags khong sku tshe 'di la las sla po ma red/ pā lags snga sa nas grongs te nga tsho gcen gcung gnyis skyong phyir sku las tshad med bskyon/ da lta skyid 'go tshugs dus skyid po byed khom ma byung ba red/ de ring gcig pu thengs gcig la nga dang mnyam du mig lta tsam byed par yong rogasami zhes smras/ mo'i skad cha de dag go ba dang kho rang yang blo pham dang 'gyod sems tshad las 'das pa byung ste‘‘byas na nga gnyis da lta lam seng khong la blta bar 'gro ’zhes sngon la las khungs su dgongs pa zhus pa dang lag rtags gya nom pa khyer nas phyin/rangagi bu mo'i khyo bo de ring gzhi nas lta bar slebs pas a ma ha cang 341

dga' po dang blo bde po byung / khong gis bstan 'dzin gyi lag nas 'jus te‘‘bu/ nga'i bu mo khyed rang la rtsis sprad yod pas nga yang blo bde po 'dugakhyed gnyis mu mthud de 'cham po byed rogs’’ zhes kha chems kyi tshul du bzhagayang pad dbyangs la‘‘bu mo/ khyim tshang tsha sob sob zhig skyong rgyu las sla po ma red/ mi'i mi tshe ring po song tsang gnas tshul 'dra min 'phrad srid pas khog rgya che tsam dang / bzod pa mang tsam sgoms/ de ni bud med kyi yon tan red ces mtha' ma'i mngags gtam bshad/ sems pa'i kho thag ma chod/—1— lo de'i ston ka ni mi gzhan gyi ngos nas bshad na ches rgyun gtan zhig yin kyang / mo'i ngos nas bshad na ngan pa dgu 'dzoms kyi ston kha zhig red ces brjod na chog rang gi khyo bo mi la shor bas ma tshad rang gi byams brtse can gyi skyed ma yang mi yul nas zhal gyes/mo la skyid po nyis brtsegs med par sdug po gsum brtsegs yong skabs/thag ring gi gnyen las khyim mtshes dgra yag pa'i dpe bzhin grong pa khyim mtshes tshang mas rogs ram gang drag byas pa ma zad/ bstan 'dzin gyi pha ma gnyis yong nas mo la sems gso btang ba dang sbrags dngul sgor khri gcig sprad de/ pha rab rgyas kyis‘‘bu mo/ 'di ni nged rgan rgon gnyis kyi bsam pa mtshon ched rang yin pas nges par du len dgos zer bzhin dbugs ring 342

zhig btang / de rjes mu mthud de‘‘nga gnyis kyis rkang mthil na na dang kha skam skam du bslab bcun byas na'ang kha lam du phyin ma byung / yin na'i rang dang bu sngar bzhin nga tsho'i mna' ma bzang po dang tsha bo red/ nged gnyis khyed rang gi skyes pa'i pha ma min kyang bskos pa'i pha ma yin pas rtag par khyim la log shogami’ces sems gso yang yang byas pa ma zad/ phyogs bzhi'i mchod thigs rgyag rgyu dang nang gi bkod sgrig yang byed rogs byas/ bstan 'dzin yang las khungs la dgongs pa zhus te mo'i rogs par yong na'ang gnyen nye du tshos kho la snying nye ba'i skad cha shod mkhan med par de bas rgyag gtam mi nyung ba zhig gtong gin yod pas/ kho rang kun dang ma 'dres pa'i pho rog dkar po ltar du gyur/nyin shas bstud mar nyin gung kha lag za bar sgrol dkar sar slebs med la/ dgong mo log rjes kyang skad cha nyung ba'i khar dka' las khag mdog kha pos rgyab bsnyes la bsnyes te bsdad/ kho'i rgyun gtan min pa'i tshul der sgrol dkar blo ma bde/ gnas tshul ga re byung min skad cha dris kyang mgo bo g.yug pa las lan gsal po mi 'debs/ de bas kho kha lag za shugs kyang chung du mngon gsal song yod pas mo yang dogs pa zos te/ kho yang snying gang du 'gro min skog nas rjes 'ded btang bas pad dbyangs a ma 'das po'i khang khyim gyi sgo 'gram du slebs/ mos bltas pa tsam gyis de ni a ce rnying pa dang 'brel ba yod pa shes pas shar rer nang du 'dzul/ gdan steng du bsdad pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi lag 343

nas 'jus te‘‘ngas snga sa nas khyed rang la nga a ce nyams chung de'i gras min zhes bshad myong / nga skyid du ma bcug na khyed rang tsho yang skyid du mi 'jug thag chod yin/ khyed rang gis nye char kho tshor sems khur de 'dra byed pa kha gsab byed kyin yod dam/ yang na 'gyod gshags byed kyin yod/ gal te khyed rang mi bzang po de 'dra yin na snga sa nas ngo tsha rgyu med pa'i las ka de tsho byed rgyu yod pa ma red’’ces khrid rtsis byas pa la/ bstan 'dzin gyis mo la 'gram lcag cig gzhus te‘‘da lta khong gi a ma lags gshegs te bdun tshigs dang po trem red/ khyod kyi byed stangs de dud 'gro las kyang sdug gi red/khong nga'i bu'i rmo bo lags red ’ces gshe gshe btang / mos 'gram par lag pa 'chang te‘‘khyed rang gis ma bshad par ngas ji ltar shes mizhes dag sel byas/pad dbyangs tshur yong nas bstan 'dzin log dgos pa'i brda btang ba dang /yang mig gnyis mo'i gdong la bgrad nas rang gi khyo bo 'phrog mkhan 'di red ang snyam nas khong khro'i me lce 'bar yang / de ring rgyag res rgyag pa'i dus min pas bzod sgom byas te bsdad/ sgrol dkar ni 'gram pa lag pas skyor ba dang mgo bo dang khar smad de 'gro sdod ma shes par lus/ dang thog phu shor shor gyis 'dzul yang rnam pa mdzes la spyod pa brling ba'i pad dbyangs kyi mdun du/ rang nyid rma bya'i 'khris kyi de mo ltar gyur pas kha skyengs nas de ring gi byed stangs la 'gyod pa skyes pa dang / rngul chu bzhur te mo'i gdong steng gi rgan nyams bkab ched byugs pa'i byug rdzas rngul chus ded nas mo'i gdong yang mes tshig pa'i shul dang gnyis su ma mchis pas/ dran rgyu rgod pa'i 344

zla sgron gyis‘‘nga'i sems la cog bstan 'dzin gyi sems 'gug mkhan de a cag pad dbyangs las mdzes pa gang 'dra zhig yod dam snyam byung yang / da byed dus de mo chu nang nas thon tshar tsamasgyu zhig dang 'dra ba'i a ye zhig red 'dug a tsi a ye khyed rang gi gdong pa mes tshig pa red dam zhes 'khris su bcar nas lta khul byas/ pad dbyangs kyi gcung mo bde skyid kyis‘‘mes tshig par brten gdong lpags mthug po de 'dra r+ṣags pa red’’ces snying tshim brgyab/sgrol dkar gyis rngul chu 'byid bzhin‘‘sus nga'i gdong pa mes tshig pa red zer gyin 'dug gam/ ug chos me tog 'dra ba ngas kyang byas/ mdzo mo rwa co 'dra ba khyod la'ang yong srid/ khyod kyi lang tsho de yang gtan du sdod kyi red bsam gyin 'dug gamami’zhes bshad/ bde skyid kyis‘‘da byed dus mo'i ngo gdong la spre'u'i gdong pags gyon 'dug ’ces bshad pa dang / yang zur zhig tu langs pa'i bstan 'dzin la gtad de‘‘da ngo tsha rgyu med pa khyed gnyis 'di nas lam seng 'gro rogs/ de ring nga la zing rgyag pa'i bsam blo med pas ma gtogs ngas khyod rang gi snying bton te sbar btsir brgyab kyang snying tshim pa mi 'dugamimiceṭasdo bshad pas/ pad dbyangs kyis mo'i lag nas 'then te‘‘bu mo 'di ni/ cog la de 'dra shod mkhan yod dam’mizhes khang pa'i nang 'phud rgyag gtong rtsis byas pas/ mos dkrug dkrug gtong bzhin‘‘a cag rang nus med sems chung 'di 'dra song tsang mi gzhan gyis mjing par bzhon nas skyag gcin btang ba red ces u tshugs kyis bstan 'dzin dang sgrol dkar sgo phyir phud/345

—2—dus de nas bzung bstan 'dzin mo'i sar slebs med la/ da ni rta kha phyir 'khor ba'i re ba yongs su rdzogs pas/ a ma'i lo mchod tshar rjes mos rang 'gul gyis kho skad btang te bza' tshang kha bral gyi 'gro lugs gnyer/de nyin kho gnyis khrims khang du slebs skabs da dung las ka dngos su tshugs med pas/ bar khyams su rkub bkyag ring mo zhig yod pa de'i steng la bsdad de phan tshun skad cha gang yang ma bshad par yud tsam bsdad/ de rjes mos‘‘bstan 'dzin lags/ nga gnyis la gnas tshul 'di 'dra yong bsam pa gtan nas ma byung/ de ring nga'i khyim nas bu bstan pa chos grags ma gtogs ga re dgos kyang khyed rang gis snoms/ nga gnyis sha khag khag gri so so byas kyang phru gu la nyes pa gang yang med pas bu'i thad la sems khral mi dgos’’zhes bshad/ bstan 'dzin gyis skad chung ngus‘‘pad dbyangs lags/ ngas slar yang khyed rang la dgongs pa ma tshom zhu rgyu yin/ ngas khyed ma bu gnyis la tshe 'dir 'jal thabs med pa'i bu lon chad yod pas da dung ngas khyim nas bgo bsha' dgos yod zer na las ga la dag rjes ma bu'i tshod la gso rten tsam ma yin par rogs pa gang thub byas chog ’ces lus la gang sbyar ma gtogs/kho gnyis kyi lo shas bskyangs pa'i khyim nas khab skud tsam yang khyer med/ de ltar kho gnyis mthar zhi bde dang lhing 'jags/ mdza' mthun dang phreng sems kyi sgo nas kha bral/phyi tshul nas bltas na pad dbyangs 'tsho ba'i nang blo rtsa brtan po dang hra 346

tag mdog kha po yod na'ang / khyim du slebs pa dang nang las tsag tsig grub nas dal khom byung ma thag kho gnyis kyi thog ma'i 'tsho ba skyel stangs de tsho yid la 'khor te dran gso kho na'i ngang dus 'da' bar byed pa ma zad/ kho'i skyon dag kyang dge la mthong nas/ nam zhig slar yang rang gi 'khris la log rgyu'i stong bsam kho na bcangs nas sdod pa dang / bu nyal rjes yid sems skyo ba'i mig chu gtong gin yod pas gdong steng du gnyer ma mang po bslebs pa dang /mig kyang rab rib tu gyur nas glo bur du lo bcu grangs 'das zin pa ltar gyi snang ba ster/mo'i sems sdug khog nang du sba gang thub byas kyang nang gi gdung ba phyi la rang shugs su mngon gyi yod pas/ zla sgron gyis gtsos pa'i las rogs tshos rtag rtu mo la sems khur dang kha ta byed pa dang / yang kha shas kyis‘‘kho khyed rang ma 'dod par song ba yin pas shi bral byung ba ltar gyi dran sems bya rgyu ga re yod dam/ mi tsho bza' tshang kha bral rgyu de deng skabs dar bzo zhig la brtsi gin mi 'dug gam zhes go ba ma lon pa'i rnam pa bstan/—2—nyin nas nyin bstud/ zla ba nas zla ba bstud/ lo nas lo bstud de mos dran gdung kho na'i ngang bu bstan pa chos grags lo bdun la bslebs te slob grwar btang ba dang lha mor yang 'gro stangs bzos/lha mo song bas las ka mang du song ba'i khar khang pa'i nang stong lhang lhang chags pas/ de bas kher rkyang gi bsam pa shugs che ru phyin pa dang kho la dran 347

gso byed rgyu sngar bas shugs che ru song nas/ mu mthud nam zhig rang gi mdun du log mi yong ngam snyam pa'i stong bsam 'char/dgong mo bu nyal khar sgrung bshad dgos pa dang / skabs re sgrung snyan pa ma dran par bus rnyog dra bshad skabs/ bstan 'dzin 'khris su yod pa bzhin‘‘bstan 'dzin lags/ bu gnyid nyal gyi mi 'dug go/ ga re/ mo ṭa nyo gi min lags/ ma red/ ma red/ mo ṭa nyo rogs gnang / bu gnyid khugs song zhes chig lab brgyab/ bus‘‘a ma lags ni khyad mtshar zhig 'dugakhyed rang gis nam rgyun nang bzhin sngon ma'i skor mang tsam gsungs na 'grigad lta nang bzhin ma gnang dang / yang khyed rang bshum rgyu red ’ces a mar sems gso byas/nyin zhig mos sngar rgyun bzhin bu'i mdun du rtsed chas bkrams te rtsed mo rtse ru bcug rang gis gyon chas 'khrud bzhin pa'i skabs/ bus shing gi rtsed chas kha shas khyer te pad dbyangs kyi mdun du yong nas‘‘a ma lags/ nga la rtsed rogs med na skyid po mi 'dug khyed rang gis rtsed rogs gyis dang mizhes bshad/ pad dbyangs kyis‘‘a ma rtsed mo rtse gin bsdad na khyod rang gi gyon gos btsog pa sus bkru rgyu red dam ’ zhes bshad/ bus rkub sa la btsugs te‘‘a ma lags/ khyed rang rgan pas nga chung bar brnyas bcos bshad kyin 'dug’mices mchu to ring po bsnar/ skad cha de go bas mo'i bsam par ngas bu la byams po ma byas na sus byed bsams te gos 'khru mtshams bzhag bu'i 'khris su bcar te bu pang du btab pa dang dpral bar 'o zhig 348

byas te‘‘bu rang ni bshad mkhas pa la/ rgan pas chung bar brnyas bcos byed kyis zer/ 'o na rang mi rgan pa gyis/ ngas chung ba byas chog rang gis a mar za chog 'thung chog bzos/ gyon pa btsog pa de tsho 'khrus/ de ltar byung na nga rang sems khral gang yang med pa'i 'tsho ba zhig skyel rgyu yong gin red/bu rang la a mas skad cha drang po bshad na a ma snga sa nas mi rgan pa byed rgyur zhen pa log te bsdad yodamimices bu la rang gi sems gting gi skad cha bshad kyang / bus ha nyid de tsam ma go bas‘‘ho/ rgan pa byed pa las sla po red/ngas a cag lha mo tshur bskongs te kha lag bzo ru bcug yang pā lags la gos 'khru 'phrul 'khor zhig nyo rogs lab na las ka tshang ma de 'dra zer thag chod pa red ces bshad pa dang / mos bu'i gdong la zhib par bltas te‘‘a ma nga gnyis la dgos pa gos 'khru phrul 'khor ma red/ rang gi pā lags redami ces slar yang mchi zhag 'khor nas bshad pas/ bus‘‘a ma lags/ pā lags kyis rtag par khyed rang ngu rgyu bzos/ da dung log ma yong na da nas bzung nga gnyis kyis khong la kha ya ma byas par 'jog to/ nga tsho'i 'dzin grwa'i slob grogs lhun grub kyi pā lags kyis kyang kho dang a ma bzhag te rgya mo'i rjes la phyin pa red zer gyin 'dug kho'i pā lags zhogs pa las kar 'gro skabs rtag par thug gi 'dug kyang khos pā lags shi tshad ba red zer gyis/ nga tsho'i pā lags kyang yod pa dang med pa la khyad gang yod mices bshad/ skabs der mos rnam 'gyur sgam pos‘‘skad cha de 'dra bshad mi nyan/ khong ga tshod sdug kyangakhyod rang gi bkrus kyang mi dag pa'i pha redami ces bshad/ de ltar rnam 349

kun yang khos ga dus kha par brgyab te thug dgos yod zer na bkag 'gog gtan nas mi byed par gtong rkyang byas te/ pha bu'i bar gyi brtse dung la gas chag mi yong ba byed kyi yod/nyin zhig bu'i lus la sgrol dkar gyis nyos pa'i tshong rtags grags can gyi gyon pa g.yogs/ lag tu rtsed chas dang / rngan pa sna tshogs bskur te kho bu skyel bar 4ོnga / pad dbyangs kyis nyin mtshan kun tu bsam gtan ltar sgom pa'i rgyus mnga' che ba'i gdong de mo'i mdun du glo bur shar skabs/ rang nyid kyi sems gnon ma thub pa dga' skyo zung ldan gyi snang ba zhig skyes te lus po 'dar sig sig byas/ rgyun gtan min pa'i tshul der kho la'ang do snang byung ste‘‘khyed rang mi bde ba mi 'dug gam/ rgyun du nas lto chas yag tsam zo’’zhes bshad/ skad cha de go ba dang mo rang gis sems mnan te‘‘khyed rang la jus gtogs 'khri rgyu ma red/ de las yun ring po zhig thug ma byung bas khong gis bka' bkyon mi gnang na sngon la 'khyug tsam bzhugs par phebs’’zhes bshad /kho rang sdod 'dod med pa min kyang mo'i rgyun gtan min pa'i rnam 'gyur la dogs zon skyes nas‘‘nga la las ka brel ba tsha po zhig yod pas sngon la log 'gro rgyu yin/ rjes ma dal skabs la yong gi yin ’zhes 'gro rtsis byed skabs/ mos bu'i mgo nas mjug bar zhib par bltas rjes‘‘red/ khyed rang la phyag las brel ba yod na nam yang phebs mi dgos/ bu dran po yod na kho yang rbad de khrid na 'grig gi red/ nga mi gcig gis phyug po'i gces phrug ltar bzo thub kyi ma red ces rlung bshad/ kho sems 'tshab langs te‘‘khyed rang ni ga re 350

gsung gi yod/ gal te 'tsho ba'i thad dka' ngal yod na nga la gsungs dang’’zhes khug ma sngog rtsis byed skabs/ mos 'dar skad dang bcas te‘‘nga la dgos pa dngul min pa khyed rang gis mkhyen gsal red/ khyed rang gis nged ma smad gnyis mi tshe gcig kher rkyang dang dran sems kho na'i ngang 'tsho ba skyel du 'jug rtsis yod pa red’ ces rang gi sems nang gi skad cha de blo khog chen pos bshad/ da bar lo mang po de 'dra 'das zin na'ang mos da dung skad cha de 'dra bshad pa thos skabs kho re zhig had de lus/ de rjes bstan 'dzin gyis pad dbyangs kyi mdun du bcar nas‘‘pad dbyangs lags/ ngas sngon nas tshang ma zhus pa yin/ da ni khyed gnyis kyi bu lon tshang ma tshe phyi mar 'jal chog ces thag chod pos bshad/ mos mig gnyis nas re thag chad pa'i mig chu gtong gin‘‘a tsi/ khyed rang de 'dra'i gsung mkhas pa la/ tshe 'di la 'phongs phyis kyi rdo bzhin dbyugs nas da dung phyi ma yin na cig ngas khyed rang la drang po zhus chog nga khyed rang la nam yang sgug nas sdod kyi yin’’zhes bu khang pa'i nang khrid de sgo brgyab/ bstan ‘radzin blo ma bde bar sgo thengs 'gar brdungs kyang / kha ya ma byas pas gom pa dal bu spo bzhin de nas kha bral/ bus sbyong tshan 'bri bzhin yod pas khang pa'i nang de bas kha khu sim du phyin pa dang / mo'i mgo thod du sbrang ma zhig‘‘wang / wang’’zhes 'phur ba'i sgra las gzhan gang yang thos rgyu med/ pad dbyangs rgyab bsnyes byas te da lta thon ma thag pa'i gnas tshul la bsam blo gtong bzhin pa'i skabs/ slar yang351

‘‘tang tang tangami zhes sgo rdung ba'i sgra zhig thos pas/ mo'i bsam par khong da dung phyin med pa red dam snyam bzhin sems kyis ma bzod par sgo phye skabs/de ni zla sgron yin pas/ mos‘‘sgo ga tshod brdungs kyang mi 'byed par ga re byed kyi yod dmami zhes yud bshad/ zla sgron khang pa'i nang 'dzul ba dang pad dbyangs kyi bzhin la lta bzhin‘‘yang gnas tshul ga re byung song ngamami zhes mgo bo 'phred du g.yug pad dbyangs kyis da lta byung ma thag pa'i gnas tshul tshang ma bshad/ der zla sgron gyis‘‘a cag rang skyes pa khyo ga zer mkhan de la zhen pa log rgyu med pa de 'dra khyad mtshar red/ mi gzhan dag yin na snga sa nas gsar pa zhig btsal tshar yod red/ nga ni rang gi gdong pa 'di ma rtsa la brtsis te mgo bo sla la 'dod sems che ba'i skyes pa de tsho'i mgo la sta re gzhu ba'i go skabs byung na gzhu rkyang byed kyin yod/ de kho rang tshos ske khyer te zhags pa nyos pa yin pas thabs shes med ces khengs pa dang bcas bshad/der pad dbyangs kyis‘‘rang nyin zhig rang nyid 'gro sdod mi shes pa zhig chags kyi red snyam skrag gi mi 'dug gam zhes sha tsha ba'i sems kyis ma bzhag par dris/ zla sgron gyis‘‘de la skug rgyu ci yod dam/ nga rang 'gro song skar gcig gtong mi dgos par zhabs bro khang dang / spro skyid khang / ar khang sogs gang du skyid sa der slebs thub pa ma zad/ nang la log 'gro dus kyang lam gla tshang ma kho tshos 'tshang kha shig shig gis 'don gyi red/ ngas kho tsho dang mnyam du chang 'thungs/ zhabs bro 'khrab pa las gzhan gyi las ka sdug pa gang yang byed kyi med/ don dngos thog bong bur lab dong rnyed pa lta bu byed 352

mkhan a cag rang sdug gi red/ dang po kha mkhas tshig snyan gang 'dra bshad ma byung ngam/ gal srid nga la gnas tshul 'dra byung yang khyed rang nang bzhin bsam blo gti thug 'di 'dra gtong gi ma red’ ces rang gi pasam tshul dang lta ba bshad/bu bstan pa chos grags sngar bas bsam shes thub la ha go don rtogs thub mkhan du gyur pa dang / slob sbyong thad sems khral bya dgos med pas/dgong mo'i lto chas zos rjes bu khang pa sbug mar sbyong tshan bzo bar song tshe kha khu lhag par sim pas/ mos slar yang sman gzhung gi dpe deb bton nas slob sbyong byed rtsis byas/ dngos gnas byas na da lta'i dus ni dpe deb la lta ba'i go skabs bzang shos de yin na'ang kho dang kha bral ba'i nyin de nas bzung deb la lag pa 'chang mi 'dod pa dang / 'chang yang lta mi thub pas deb tshang ma shog snyigs nyo mkhan la btsongs/ da cha mo snyan 'jebs rol dbyangs nyan rgyur dga' po chags yod la/ rol dbyangs nyan bzhin kho dang mnyam du rgya nag tu 'gro skabs brgyab pa'i 'dra par de tsho la yang skor bskyar skor du lta bzhin/ skabs de'i gnas tshul dran gso byed pa dang / bu la'ang yang skor bskyar skor gyis de'i skor 'grel bshad byed kyi yod pas da cha bus kyang a mas ci zer rgyu yin min snga sa nas shes kyi yod pas a mas ma bshad gong‘‘de dus bu rang skye rgyu red/ nga gnyis hang kra'u nas thon nyin ’’zhes sun snang byed kyi yod pas rang nyid gcig pus 'dra par de dag la bltas nas bsdad/de rjes sems skyid po byung na gyon pa tshang ma sgam las bton te stod thung dang /353

dor ma/ phyu pa dang 'og 'jug tshos gzhi ga re 'tsham min dang / ga re ga re mnyam du gyon na legs pa yod med me long nang la bltas te blo la 'gro ba dag cha sgrig nas sgam nang gral 'grig pos bzhag skabs 'gar gyon gos tshos gzhi spel rjes me long la lta gin rol dbyangs dang bstun nas so sos glu len bzhin zhabs bro yang 'khrab trem 'khrab tsam byas te/ ha lam slar yang mna' mar 'gro kha'i dus tshod shar grabs yod pa ltar byed/ de las ldog te sems skyid po ma byung na sgra phab 'khor lo'i gzhas skad chung chung zhig btang / nyal khri'i steng gan rkyal la nyal te thog pang la mig ce rer bltas te yun ring sdod kyi yod/—4—pad dbyangs kyi 'tsho ba rim bzhin rgyun gtan can du gyur ba'i nyin zhig bstan 'dzin gyis rnam kun ltar dus tshod nges med thog bu bstan pa chos grags bsus nas khrid/ bu log yong skabs dngul khang btsugs nas lo nyi shu 'khor ba'i dran rten gyi brtse grogs cha 'grig chu tshod du 'bod pa'i chu tshod cha re sprad pa de nas bu mo'i chu tshod de mo la bskur 'dug mos snang med ngang‘‘bu/ chu tshod de'i ya de bu rang la sprad byung ngam’ zhes dris/ bus kyang snang med ngang‘‘ya de pā lags kyi phyag la gyo na 'dug’’ces bshad/ bsam tshul ya mtshan zhig gis glo bur du mo'i sems khams yongs su gang bas/ mos lag pa 'dar sig sig gis 'od chem chem gyi chu tshod de rtsa che mdog kha pos lag ngar la gyon/ me long gi mdun du langs nas yang yang lta ba'i tshe/ chu tshod de 354

ni ched du mo rang gi lag par tshad brgyab ste bzos pa ltar ha cang mdzes/ de ni bstan 'dzin gyis mo la re ba 'don skabs gser gyi tshig khebs cha 'grig che chung gnyis nyos te chung ba de mo la sprad pa dang / che ba de kho rang gi lag par brgyus pa'i ngang tshul dang ha cang 'dra bas/ re ba'i me mdag ha lam dal la nye skabs me shing phran bu bsnan nas lhag bsil gyi grogs la brten nas rim pas gsos pa ji bzhin/ skad cig nyid du sems khams rab tu g.yos nas lus po tsha sob sob tu gyur pa dang / kho'i gzugs brnyan de slar yang mo'i mdun du dal po dal po'i ngang shar te re ba'i me chung 'bar/ mos slar yang re sgug dang / stong bsam/ kher rkyang dang yul yul po'i 'tsho ba'i rgyun mthud/ yun ring po zhig bstan 'dzin gyi pha ma gnyis kyi sar 'gro rgyu ma byung bas de nyin pha ma gnyis slar yang mo'i sar 'byor/ bstan 'dzin dang 'brel thag bcad na'ang / kho'i pha ma gnyis kyis mo la sngar bzhin rang gi bu'i mna' ma'i 'du shes bzung yod la/ mos kyang pha ma gnyis la dus tshod nges med thog lta bar 'gro gin yod pas khong tsho'i brtse dung gi khrag rgyun sla ru gtan nas song med ces smras chog mo'i kher rkyang dang yul po'i 'tsho ba skyel stangs de mthong skabs kho'i pha ma gnyis kyang sems kyis ma bzod par/ pad dbyangs la da cha bstan 'dzin sems khug thabs med lugs dang rang la mi tshe skyel rogs shig 'tshol dgos pa'i gros 'go bton/ 355

'khrag rom sbyabs kyi shang shang /—1—kho tsho'i tshan khag la slob grwa chen mo nas thon pa'i gzhon nu rdo rje zer ba zhig slebs/ kho dang pad dbyangs las res mnyam du 'khel ba mang bas phan tshun gshib pa'i nang / rdo rje pad dbyangs kyi gshis ka dang sems rgyud la mgu thag chod nas las rogs tshor‘‘ngas kyang rang gi mi tshe skyel rogs su a cag pad dbyangs dang 'dra bar srol rgyun gyi bro ba dang ya rabs gshis bzang ldan pa dang / skad cha nyung la mdzangs ma'i yon tan ldan pa 'di 'dra zhig 'tshol 'dod kyang / blo phangs pa zhig la dus deng sang bu mo de'i rigs ha cang dkon po 'dugami ces rang gi bsam tshul bshad/ las rogs tshos ku re dang bcas te‘‘de khag rgyu ci yod/ pad dbyangs 'dra po mi dgos par pad dbyangs ngo ma mig gi mdun du yod pa brtson len mi byed dam’’zhes bshad pa des kho la dran skul byung nas pad dbyangs la de bas gting zab pa'i do snang bya dgos byung / de'i rjes la kho gnyis las res 'khel skabs/ rdo rjes mo'i sngon ma'i skor 'dri ba mang yang thog mar mos‘‘de ni 'das pa'i dus kyi sems skyo dgos pa'i bya ba zhig yin pas/ nga rang dran gso byed 'dod mi 'dug’’ces bshad 'dod mi byed kyang / rim bzhin 'dris gshib byung ba'i nang pad dbyangs kyis rdo rje la rang nyid kyi sngon chad skor sba gsang med par bshad/denas bzung rdo rjes mo la sngar bas do snang dang do khur che ru song ba dang / bu bstan pa chos grags la byis pa'i klog deb dang rtsed chas nyos te 356

ster ba ma zad/ slob grwa ngal gso 'jog skabs kho khrid nas mnyam du spo lo rgyag par 'gro rkyang byas/resagaza' nyi ma'i nyin/ rdo rjes kha chad bzhin zhogs pa snga po nas bu bstan pa chos grags khrid de ri 'dzeg par phyin/ lo de dag nang bstan pa chos grags a ma'i byams skyong 'og 'tshar longs byung yang de ring lta bu'i pho khyo ga'i lus shed ngoms pa'i go skabs thob ma myong bar de ring gzhi nas rang nyid kyang pho khyo ga zhig yin pa'i 'du shes rnyed pas/ kho dga' thag chod nas rdo rje la‘‘de ring nga ha cang skyid po byung / slob grwa gung gseng btang song na 'di las mtho ba zhig la 'dzeg par khrid ang zhes snga sa nas re ba bton/kho gnyis bstan pa chos grags kyi khyim du 'byor skabs pad dbyangs kyis bro ba zhim pa'i dgong zas gra sgrig byas yod pas kho gnyis kyis 'tshang kha shig shig ngang zos/ rdo rjes lto chas za skabs bstan pa chos grags kyi phor pa'i nang sha rdog cig blugs te‘‘de ring khag ma byung ngam zhes dris/ bstan pa chos grags kyis kha'i nang gi lto chas cag cag byed kyin‘‘khag ma byung / de ring ha cang skyid po byung / da dung nga gnyis kha chad byas pa ma brjed pa gnang āmi ‘‘brjed ga la srid/ gal te bu rang mos mthun yod na ngas rtag par khrid chog ‘de 'dra byung na khyed rang nga tsho dang mnyam du bsdad na 'grig gi ma red dam 357

‘‘nga sdod 'dod yod na'ang bu rang gi a ma lags kyis mos mthun gnang e yong rdo rjes de ltar bshad pa dang pad dbyangs la mtshon don zab mo yod pa'i mig brda zhig 'phangs/ pad dbyangs kyis rdo rjegi go rgyu yod pa'i skad cha de dag thos rjes bzhin ras dmar rkyang chags/bu sbyong tshan 'bri bar song nas khang pa'i nang kho rang gnyis las lhag med pas/ rdo rjes‘‘a cag pad dbyangs/ khyed rang mgo mkhregs po de 'dra ma byed/ nga rdo rje pho khyo ga gnam sa'i bar du 'greng thub mkhan zhig yin pas/ngas a cag rang dang skyid la kha'i rtswa la mnyam za dang sdug ko long chu la mnyam 'thung bya rgyu'i dam bca' bzhag yod ’ces thad kar bshad/ pad dbyangs kyis‘‘ngas snga sa nas khyed rang gi sems shes pa ma zad khyed rang mi blo 'khel sa zhig yin pa de bas kyang shes yod/ skad cha drang po bshad na nga yang khyed rang la sems gting nas mos po zhe drag 'dug 'on kyang da lta khyed rang gis bshad pa'i skad cha de tsho de snga khong gis kyang nga la thengs mang bshad myong la mna' tshig kyang bor myong bas/ skyes pa khyo ga'i kha 'don yin gyi red snyam/der brten da lta de'i thad bsam blo gtong phod pa mi 'dug la/ gal srid gtong dgos byung na'ang bu slob grwa ma thon bar gtong rgyu med pa'i dam bca' bzhag zin/ de las khyed rang dang nga'i grogs mo yag shos zla sgron 'tsham shos red rices bshad/‘‘zla sgron khyed rang gis ngo sprod gnang mi dgos par ngas ngo shes kyi yod/ngas mig gis bltas/ rna bas nyan/ klad pas bsam blo btang nas dbye zhib 358

byas rjes/ rang gi sems la zug pa zhig dang mnyam du 'tsho ba skyel rgyu'i 'dun pa bcangs te 'bad pa byed kyin yod/ ngas da dung mu mthud 'bad pa byed nges yinami’zhes bshad/ rdo rje rang shag tu log rjes/ pad dbyangs kyi snang ngor rdo rje'i skad cha de dag yang bskyar brag cha bzhin 'khor ba dang /sems pa g.yos nas bde skyid kyi snang ba drag po 'char/ 'on kyang bsam blo ji tsam gting ring ba btang na de tsam du kho gnyis dbar gyi lo khyad kyi bar thag de mchong thabs med pa'i grog rong zhig tu mthong bas/ nyin zhig zla sgron la kha par brgyab nas rdo rje ngo sprod bya rgyu'i skor gleng / pha rol po gad mo chen po shor te‘‘sangs rgyas rang mgo ma thon par sems can gyi yar 'dren yong mdog med/ grogs mo rang gis sngon la rang la bsam blo mang tsam thongs/o/ tag tas/ red/ ngas khyod la bshad dgos bsam yang khom pa ma byung /nga dos drag lte gnas la btang ba nas bzung dal pa byung tshad la dbyin skad sbyang nas da cha skad brda 'phrod rgyur snang dogs med ’’ mos skad shugs cung chung du btang nas‘‘da dung nga dang ka na ṭa'i sman pa zhig 'khrug pa'i sgang yin/ khong de snga pe cing slob chen la slob sbyong lo gnyis byas pas rgya skad yag la sman pa'i lag rtsal de bas brjod ga la dgos/ khong gis nga kha ri kha thug dang spyang grung dod la rnam pa mdzes pa/ da dung rnyog 'dzing med pa'i gshis ka bzang po zhig yod pas nga la dga' po yod ces shod kyin 'dug rjes su nga ka na ṭa la khrid rgyur nga'i a mas kyang mos mthun byas song’ zhes spro ba rab tu 'phel ba'i ngang bshad/ pad dbyangs kyis‘‘mgo ser de tsho'i bshad tshad 359

la yid ches ma byed/ gun 'khel na khyod rang la 'khel gyi red/ kho tsho rkub brdab tsam byas te song na skabs de dus ngus kyang 'phyi drags pa red ces rang gi nyams myong la brten nas kha ta byas/de rjes rdo rje dang mnyam du las res 'khel skabs mos rang 'gul ngang g.yol thabs byas na'ang / rdo rjes de dag la snang 'jog mi byed par sngar bzhin 'brel ba byed pa dang / kho'i sems nang gi kho gnyis bar gyi 'brel ba mi gzhan la shes su 'jug thabs byed/ —2—'jig rten gyi bya ba mang po zhig nyin re bzhin bsam tshod las 'das pa'i ngang 'phel rgyas dang 'gyur ldog 'gro bzhin yod la/ de bas pho mo'i brtse dung ni tshod dpag dang kha tshon gcod dka' ba zhig red/dmigs bsal gang yang med pa'i nyin zhig ka na ṭa'i sman pas zla sgron nam rgyun kho rang gnyis 'gro sa'i phyi rgyal gyi kha lag za sa'i bza' khang du skad btang / khos sngar rgyun bzhin rgya gar gyi ja mngar mo skal dod gcig blangs pa dang mi gnyis kyi bza' chas mngags/ zla sgron slebs rjes ja mngar mo kham gang do re 'thungs/ kho rang nyid kyi rgyal khab tu log grabs yod pas/zla sgron gyi sems la de ring tan tan gtam bzang zhig shod rgyu yod kyi red snyam nas khos gtam 'go 'dzugs rgyur sgug khos nam rgyun ltar ka na ṭa'i sgrung gtam ma bshad pa dang mo'i gdong la'ang mi lta bar/ ha cang bshad dka' ba'i ngang nas4zla sgron/ da nga log ran pas khyed rang la skad cha drang po 360

ma bshad na mi 'grig 'on kyang ngas ga nas 'go 'dzugs dgos min shes kyi mi 'dug’ skad cha de go ba dang rdzi rno ba'i zla sgron la glo bur du tshor snang mi legs pa zhig 'char nas‘‘khyed rang phebs mkhan yin zer ga re gsung gi yod/ nga 'khrid thub kyi mi 'dug ces gsung rtsis yod kyi ma red/ skad cha yod na kha thug la shod dang ’zhes kho mthar bkag btang / khos zla sgron gyi lag nas 'jus te‘‘zla sgron/ rang phyi'i rnam pa mdzes la/ nang spyang grung dod pa/rangagashis yod mkhan bu mo bzang po zhig song treng ngas lag tu lon thabs byas pa yin la mtha' ma'i dmigs yul yang 'grub song / skad cha drang po bshad na/ khyed rang nga bod du sdod ring gi zur mo zhig bya rgyu de nga'i thog ma'i dmigs yul yin/ nga gnyis 'brel 'dris byung ba'i rgyud rim nang ngas khyed la brtse dung ngo ma bcangs pa dang sbrags nas nga'i sems nang 'gal ba che ru che ru song nas/ nga rang gi brtse ba'i bud med gnyis kyi bar du gdam ga ma shes par mtshan mo'i gnyid thebs kyang chag rgyu mtshan ni kho'i skad cha de dag ni so so'i nyes pa dag 'bud bya rgyu kho na'i ched du yin pa dang / don du ga re shod 'dod yod pa ma nyan na'ang rtogs thub pas/ zla sgron gyi lus po la kha'i dar lcog bzhin rab tu 'dar bzhin dbyin skad thog nas‘‘kha tshums/ngas tshang ma shes song / gnam 'og gi pho rog tshang ma nag po las dkar po med’mices rkub stegs thog nas langs te dkar yol nang gi ja tsha po de kho'i ngo gdong la byos/ ‘‘ngas snga sa nas khyod kyi dmigs yul bzang po med pa shes byung zhes za khang gi sgo nas thon te phu shor shor ngang dmigs yul med par 361

khrom lam du skyod pa dang / re zhig song mtshams rang dbang med par mchi ma'i phreng thag chad/ zla sgron thon tshar na'ang khos‘‘ ngas a ce dang khag khag byas te rang dang mnyam du 'tsho ba skyel rtsis thengs mang byas kyang ’’zhes bshad mtshams der slebs skabs zla sgron mthong sar med pas lag pa gnyis btegs tsam dang / dpung pa rong tsam/ mgo bo phred du g.yug tsam byas te thabs zad pa'i bzo bstan/ g.yas g.yon gyi mis kho gnyis kyi skad cha ra ma lug las phyed ka go la phyed ka ma go yang kho gnyis bar kha rtsod drag po zhig byung ba shes na'ang / phyi rgyal ba de dag ni ma shes pa'i tshul du bsdad yod pas/ ka na ṭa'i sman pa gdong cung zad smad de lag ras kyis gdong dang gyon pa phyis/ zas rin sgrog tse'i steng du bzhag rjes phrag pa glod bzhin de nas gyes/khrom la skor ba yud tsam brgyab rjes/ zla sgron pad dbyangs kyi sar yong nas ka na ṭa'i sman pa la 'khang ra dang dmod mo rgyags tshad byas/ da res sems la rdab rdeg chen po phog pas nyin mtshan gnyis nyal te ngus/ yar langs nas me long la lta skabs si ling ljang pa 'dra ba'i mgo skyes gzengs nas ston dus sran ma'i lo tog gi rnam thar 'dzin pa dang / gzi ltar dwangs pa'i 'dren byed gnyis kham bu ltar skrangs/ zil pa khrum khrum gyi bzhin ras kyang than pas gdung pa'i me tog ltar rab tu rnyid/ srab 'jam dmar mdangs rgyas pa'i mchu sgros la mchu dreg chags nas nad pa zhig dang mtshungs pas/mo'i sngar yod kyi mdzes pa ma lus ka na ṭa'i sman pas sdog chas dang mnyam du 362

rgya mtsho'i pha rol du khyer ba dang mtshungs/pad dbyangs kyi u tshugs 'og zhogs zas phran tsam zos pa dang sems khams cung bag yangs su song / zhogs zas tshar rjes khang pa'i nang zla sgron dang pad dbyangs gnyis las lhag med/ zla sgron gyis glo bur du‘‘a cag nga nyal khri'i steng nyin mtshan gnyis nyal te da cha gzhi nas gnas lugs rtsa chen zhig rtogs song / de snga a cag rang gis mi rnying pa bzang / gos gsar pa yag ces pa der ngas do snang bya rgyu lta zhog snang chung byed kyin yod/ da lta ngas gzhi nas skad cha de'i go ba lon song / ngas bsam blo zhig gtong dus da lta nga yang lo chung chung min pas/ dngos gnas phru gu'i bsam blo spangs te blos thub pa'i mi zhig dang 'tsho ba bskyal na bsam gyin 'dug der brten ngas bsam blo ga tshod btang yang slob grwa'i dge rgan rig 'dzin kho las 'os pa mi 'duga.a cag rang gis kho dran gyin 'odug gam’’zhes dris/ pad dbyangs kyis mo'i skra la byug tsam byas te‘‘ngas mi dran pa ga la srid/ mi blos 'khel po zhig yin tshe phyi'i rnam pa de rgyu rkyen phal pa yin pas/ rgya rgyugs bod rgyugs shig byung na gnyen sgrig byas rjes rnam par snang 'jog byed khom ga par yod dmami’zhes bshad/ zla sgron gyis‘‘de sngon khos nga la re ba yun ring byas kyang ngas mthong chung byas te kha ya byas med/ da cha glo bur du kho 'tshol bar song na stabs mi bde bas a cag rang gis kho'i rnam 'gyur la nyams tshod cig len rogs’’zhes mngags/zla sgron de nas kha bral rjes ha lam zla ba gcig tsam song rjes kyi nyin zhig363

pad dbyangs nad khang du nad par tsha ba lta bzhin pa'i skabs/ zla sgron gyi kha par zhig 'byor nas nad khang thogs brtsegs can gyi gsham du skad btang /rlangs 'khor 'jog sa'i 'khris su slebs skabs zla sgron gyis skad brgyab yong na'ang gang du yod min ma mthong bar phar lta tshur lta byed skabs‘‘nga 'dir yod ces 10twa01sartags can gyi 'jeb 'khor zhig nas zla sgron gyis lag pa g.yug pad dbyangs rlangs 'khor gyi 'khris su nye bar bcar skabs zla sgron gyi lus la ther ma'i gyon chas gsar pa grags can gyon pa dang / rna bar gser gyi a long sbom po zhig btags/ lag par gser gyi mdzub dkris nyis rtseg dang gser gyi lag gdub sgril ma zhig gyon/ ngo gdong la byi dor gtsang ma byas nas bde zhing skyid pa'i tshor snang drag po zhig sprod pa dang ha lam ngo mi shes pa tsam du gyur yod pas pad dbyangs re zhig hang sangs/ 'jeb 'khor nang kha lo ba phud da dung skyes pa stobs chen nub lugs kyi stod gos smad gos rang 'grig gyon pa zhig 'dug pa de ni bltas pa tsam gyis tshong pa chen po zhig yin bzo mchis/ zla sgron gyis‘‘khong gi ming la pad dbyangs zer/ nga'i grogs mo yag shos de yin zhes mi de la pad dbyangs ngo sprod byas pas/ mi de rlangs 'khor las bab nas mgo bo gug tsam gyis gus lugs mtshon pa byas/zla sgron gyis mgron shog sprod bzhinaslores gza' pa sangs nyin nga gnyis kyi gnyen ston yin pas nga'i mgron brda'i phud de grogs mo rang la skyel bar yong ba yin’’zhes bshad/ mi des kyang‘‘grogs mo nges par du phebs shog ang zhes khams skad dang dbus skad 'dres ma brgyab nas smras/ pad dbyangs 364

tshor 'du med pa ltar du gyur nas‘‘'o 'o’ tsam las lan slog khom ma byung bar khoganyis kyi rlangs 'khor de nas kha bral/ pad dbyangs hang sangs nas de gar re zhig langs nas rlangs 'khor mig lam nas ma yal bar bltas nas lus pa dang / de rjes gzhi nas mgron shog la lta skabs‘‘blo bzang rdo rje dang zla ba sgron ma'i gnyen ston mizhes rgya yig thog nas bris 'dug—2—de ni slar yang mo rang dga' shos kyi ston kha'i dus tshigs kyi nyin mo zhig red/ bu slob grwar song nas bsdad med pa dang pad dbyangs nyi g.yab 'og tu bzhag pa'i me tog la chu rgyag bzhin pa'i skabs sgo rdung ba'i sgra thos/ mos chu stor byed chu bum khyer khyer bar sgo phye skabs rdo rje'i gzhung drang ba'i bzhin ras glo bur mdun du 'char bas/ mo rang ci bya gtol bral du gyur pa dang lus yongs la sngar na med pa'i tsha shar dang glog 'khyud pa lta bu'i sbrid snang 'char/tag tag red/ de ni de snga bstan 'dzin dang mo dga' po byed dus bstan 'dzin gyis mo'i lag par thengs dang po 'ju ba'i skabs kyi tshor snang de red/mos‘‘a tsi/ khyed rang red 'dug go ’zhes bshad pas/ khos lam seng‘‘nga ma yin pa da dung su yod dam mizhes ku re dang go rgyu bshad/rdo rje gdan du 'khod rjes kho la ja gang blugs pa dang rang nyid kho dang bar thag chod pa'i gdan zhig gi steng du bsdad/ yud tsam zhig khang pa'i nang khakhu sim por gyur pa dang gyang steng gi chu tshod de'i thag sgra je che je cher 'gro ba'i snang ba 'char / rdo rjes ‘a cag rang de 'dra ze dbugs kyang ma btang 365

bar ma sdod dang / nga de ring 'dir yong ba gang gi ched du yin pa khyed rang gis shes gsal red/ ngas sngar bzhin kha zhe gnyis med kyis re ba 'don rgyu yin pas min ma zer rogs zhes thag chod pos smras/ kho'i skad cha de dag yang bskyar go ba dang mo sems 'gul thebs nas en tsam min na kho la 'khyud de ngu bar 'dod/ 'on kyang mos de ltar ma byas par sems mnan te‘‘rdo rje/de tsho khyod kyis kha nas bshad mi dgos par ngas sems nang nas tshor snang yong gi 'dug 'on kyang rang gi bde skyid kyi ched du mi gzhan chu la dbyugs na ga nas 'grig khyed rang da lta lo chung chung yin pas/ a ce rang las rgan pa dang snga 'dzar khrid rgyu yod pa zhig dang gnyen sgrig byas na khyed rang gi pha ma spun mched kyis mos mthun byed mi srid la/ de bas kyang dus tshod nges can song mtshams da lta'i bsam blo la gnas kyi ma red/ khyed rang la nga las cha rkyen ldab 'gyur gyis legs pa'i bu mo zhig gang nas kyang 'tshol chog chog red/de'i khar nga'i bu yang da dung lo chung chung yin pas kho'i 'tsho ba'i khor yug lam seng brjes na 'phrod kyi ma red’’ces bshad/ mo'i skad cha'i mjug ma rdzogs gong kho gdan las langs pa dang pad dbyangs kyi dpung pa gnyis nas 'jus te dkrug dkrug byed kyin‘‘de ring nga ched mngags 'dir yong te skad cha de dag nyan par yong ba min/ khyed rang gis bu la khag btags nas rang gi mi tshe stong zad du gtong ba dang don snying yod pa'i mi yul gi 'tsho ba las g.yol gyin 'dug bus nga la dga' po yod pa dang nga yang bu la dga' po yod pa khyed rang gi blo ngag sems gsal redaci/ da dung bus kha ma srong ba ma 366

gtogs snga sa nas nga dang len byas pa las ngo rgol gyi rnam 'gyur tsam ston myong ngam/ don dngos thog khyed rang gis da dung yang mi mngon pa'i grib gzugs shig la re ba bcangs nas bsdad 'dugami’ces kha nas thal/ mo'i 'dren byed las mchi ma'i phreng thag chad pa dang / mgo bo phred la g.yug bzhin kho la 'tham par 'dod na'ang rang sems rang gis gcun te‘‘nga bud med mo hreng zhig la brtse dung gi bdud rtsi dang 'tsho ba'i lag do dgos pa med pa ci la srid/ ngas de ring khyed rang la ma gsang drang gtam bshad na nga yang khyed rang la dga' po zhe drag 'dug 'on kyang ’mos skad cha mu mthud de bshad ma thub/ skabs der khos skad cha tshig gcig kyang ma bshad par mo'i skad cha bshad 'phror sgug pa ltar du yod pas/ rang gi skad cha da dung gsal po byung med pa shes te bzhin ras dang khar smad de/ skad shugs chung ngus‘6ma gzhi nas sems pa mthun pa'i mi gnyis phan tshun lhad med kyi brtse dung yod na nges par du 'tsho ba mnyam du skyel dgos pa'i nges pa med/ phan tshun sems nang gi brtse dung de nam yang sbas nas rtag tu dran gso byas na de yang bde ba zhig dang rin thang bral ba'i rgyu nor zhig red bsam gyin 'dug nga gnyis kyi brtse dung yang las 'phro yod kyang skal ba med pas thabs ci yod/ nga'i kha la nyon dang ’zhes byams sems che ba'i a cag gis gcung por 'jig rten 'gro lugs kha ta bslab bya byed pa bzhin smras/ skad cha de dag bshad tshar rjes da gzod mo'i sems nas rdog khres chen po zhig phab pa'i snang ba byung yang / rdo rje ni de las ldog te phu shor ba'i lhang phug ltar phrag pa lhod/ mgo bo smad/367

skad shugs kyang chung du song nas‘‘khyed rang khyed rang ’’ces mgo bo phred du g.yug nas bskyar zlos kyis ci zhig bshad par 'dod kyang brjod don kha nas ma grol/ de rjes khos‘‘khyed rang dngos gnas u tshugs kyis brag la mgo bo rdung mkhan zhig red 'dug khyed rang ngang rgyud ring pos mu mthud bu'i pā lags sgug bzhugs/ da nas ngas khyed rang sun po bzos mi yong mizhes phyi bltas med par sgo nas bud/stong lhang lhang gi khang pa'i nang du pad dbyangs gcig pu sems stong lhang lhang du lus/ kho thon nas yud tsam song rjes mo sgo 'gram du song nas kho'i rjes la bltas kyang kho'i grib ma tsam yang mthong rgyu med/ mo blo pham dang the tshom gyis bsgribs nas rgyal sgo'i ru bzhi la bsnyes te kho yang bskyar mdun gyi lam chung de nas tshur log e yong la sgug shing / gal te kho ltag log brgyab ste mo'i mig lam du 'char tshe kho'i pang du 'khyud ang snyam pa'i snang ba zhig skyes/nor bu rang la yod dus/ nor bu'i nor nyams ma chod/ pad dbyangs kyi khog pa'i nang nas ci zhig brlags pa lta bu'i gdung ba zhig gis mo'i lus sems gnyis kar grang shur brgyab pa'i tshor snang byung bas/ mo'i 'dren byed gnyis las slar yang mchi ma rdzing bu rdol ba bzhin zham zham du lhung yong /mos dbugs ring 'then bzhin nang du 'dzul nas sgo brgyab/ sgo ra'i nang gi spang rtswa'i steng du ston lhags kyis ded pa'i lo ma ser po kha shas lhungs yod pas mos lo ma zhig bsgrugs te de la lta bzhin bsam tshul 'dra min 'char/‘‘ka ba la mo'i rtse nas/ / bskos bzhag gsal gyi yod na/ /368

bya ba 'chug pa'i las ka/ / nga ras ma byas chog ga / ’mizhes pa'i dmangs gzhas sho lo ka de dran pas de ni dmangs gzhas sho lo ka zhig ma yin par legs bshad sho lo ka zhig yin pa'i snang ba shar/—4—glo bur du phyi logs nas sgo dal bus rdung ba'i sgra zhig thos pas/ mo 'drogs 'go chen po langs pa dang lus kyi ba spu ma lus gzengs/ khrag dron lang long du 'khol bas re zhig dbugs kyang gtong dka' ba'i snang ba byung /mo re zhig krong nger langs nas yang bskyar nyan skabs/ dngos 'brel rang khyim gyi sgo rdung mkhan yod pas mo nem nur gyi gom pa spo bzhin rgyal sgo phye bar song /2003lo'i zla11par zin bris btab/2004lo'i zla10par bzo bcos thengs dang po byas/2005lo'i zla6par bskyar bcos kyis gtan la phab/369
